chapters.title: Chapter 1554: Three Months Passed
paragraphs: With the changing situation in the Paradise Realm, all domains became calm and peaceful as all cultivators were busy with their respective domains, as were the people at the Moonlit Passion Temple.

Since they didn’t yet have information about the distances between the domains, and Zhang Fei and Qing Qiu’er had forbidden them to leave their domains until the situation in the Paradise Realm stabilized, the disciples of the Moonlit Passion Temple and the Blazing Union Sect were fully focused on their activities: cultivation, dual cultivation, and training.

A month passed quickly in the outside world, which was equivalent to four months in the training space. Even though Zhang Fei was busy with his seclusion, he always made time to check on his soul world, which was increasingly filled with beasts and nature. He also repeatedly checked the Sealed World Pearl, but he was disappointed because the other four areas were still not open, and he had no idea how to open them. In the end, he decided to move all the beasts inside the Sealed World Pearl into his soul world, allowing them to live more freely than inside the pearl.
Yue Xuelian came to the Moonlit Passion Temple to look for Zhang Fei, and he coincidentally sent one of his clones out of the training space to complete one of the four daily quests.

Yue Xuelian was embarrassed to meet Zhang Xiaolong [3], especially after she listened to his conversation with Zhang Chen a month ago about his interest in her, plus he also saw her naked at the Yin Lake at that time.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was still unaware of his connection with Yue Xuelian, which allowed her to see and hear all his activities inside the training space with all his women because of Feng Yao’s actions.

Yue Xuelian informed Zhang Xiaolong [3] that over 90% of the Celestial Moon Sect members had agreed to move to the Twin Flames Domain, and she would leave the rest in the Celestial Moon Domain to join other sects.

Lu Shaqing and Gong Wei also came to see Zhang Xiaolong [3], and they informed him that members of the Spring Breeze Pavilion and the Zenith Sect had also decided to move to the Twin Flames Domain because they had no future in the Sun-Moon Main Domain. Additionally, the two sects decided to merge because their total number of disciples was not large, and they thought it would be troublesome to establish two new sects.

After discussing with Yue Xuelian, Lu Shaqing, and Gong Wei, Zhang Xiaolong[3] summoned members of the natural race, especially the giant race, to discuss the construction of new buildings for the two sects. Since they were still busy with the construction for the clans of the Sky Pillar Domain, they asked for two months to start the construction of the two sects.

After their discussion, Yue Xuelian, Lu Shaqing, and Gong Wei returned to their respective three sects to begin preparing for their move. They also informed Zhang Xiaolong [3] that they would send members of their sects from time to time to expedite the construction of their new sects so they could move into that domain ahead of schedule.

Since all the domains were separated by a large distance, the people of the Divine Samsara Sect had not heard about the three sects’ plans for a move at all, making their activities unnoticed by anyone.

After they left, Zhang Xiaolong [3] met Serpentera and Tian Kui, and they told him that there were no other domains for hundreds of miles from the Twin Flames Domain. The only domain closest to the Twin Flames Domain was the Frostwind Tundra Domain, but the distance between the two was about 700 miles, and there were not many inhabitants in that domain due to its rather extreme weather.

After Zhang Xiaolong [3] discussed the situation with Serpentera and Tian Kui, he went to Chi Hongchen and Guang Yue to talk about all the sects in their domain. They told him that all the small sects were willing to merge with theirs and with the other large sects.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was not satisfied with that, and he wanted to reduce the number of dual cultivation sects in their domain until there were only three or four sects left, so he asked Chi Hongchen and Guang Yue to lobby those sects again, to which they agreed.
Thereafter, Zhang Xiaolong [3] went to finish the daily quest before returning to the training space, where he helped his two wives, Ba Shuxiang and Xie Jingxian.

Another month passed quickly; Zhang Fei and his five clones were busy in seclusion with all of his wives, but one of the clones occasionally left the training space to check on the progress at the Moonlit Passion Temple and the Twin Flames Domain.

As per his promise with Shang Luohu, Zhang Xiaolong [3] contacted her and brought her to the Ashen Lotus Monastery, located in the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain, to gather with Shang Xueli. Since her husband had not shown any signs of coming out of his seclusion, and the situation in the Slaughter Blood Domain was much safer after the changes in the Paradise Realm, she agreed with him and went to the domain to reunite with her daughter.

Zhang Fei stopped his seclusion temporarily and took Luo Yunxiao away to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary in the Empyrean Domain, mainly because Bing Xingying was about to give birth to her child with Luo Zhenyu.

When they arrived there, Zhang Fei did not see the five Luo Ancestors, who were still in their seclusion since they returned from the Ashen Lotus Monastery. They didn’t care about the affairs of the outside world, and they were completely focused on their cultivation.

Bing Xingying eventually gave birth to a son, whom she named Luo Huxiao. From Mei and the system’s information, Zhang Fei learned that the baby boy was half human and half void spirit, which wasn’t too surprising. After all, his father was an ordinary human, and his mother was the void spirit.
Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi were delighted with the birth of their first grandson, and they eagerly awaited the birth of their second grandson, the child of Cheng Mengyao and Luo Jiaxuan.

Luo Huxiao’s birth brought a breath of fresh air to the Luo Clan and the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary. Luo Fenghan decided to hold a grand celebration to celebrate the birth of his first grandson and invited all the cultivators in the Empyrean Domain.

However, Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao decided not to join them because they wanted to focus on their seclusion, but they promised to come visit them from time to time. Although Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi were disappointed by this, they could understand their daughter and son-in-law’s desire to become stronger, especially after the significant changes in the Paradise Realm.
After he left some pills with Bing Xingying, which she could use for her son, Luo Huxiao. Zhang Fei took Luo Yunxiao back to the training space, continuing their training and seclusion.
Another month passed quickly; Zhang Fei and the others stood in front of the cocoon that had been wrapped around Zhang Lin’s body for more than two years since she started upgrading her demon rank.

Soon, Zhang Lin opened her eyes, and they became an even darker blue. Her expression softened when she saw her family gathered waiting for her, and she hugged them one by one. "I’m back."

paragraphs: "What should we do now, Demon God?"
"Can we break the seal?"

"All the tunnels were created automatically along with the creation of the barrier that separated the Paradise Realm and the Three Mortal Realms in the past, so I’m not sure our strength is sufficient to destroy it."
"Who actually created the barrier in our universe?"
"This barrier is really troublesome."

Mo Shentian didn’t listen to his five subordinates, and he tried to touch the seal. However, crimson flames immediately came out of the seal and attacked him. He tried to get rid of the flames with his ability to bend reality, but it had no effect, and the flames continued to shoot toward him. "Move!"
The five demons immediately moved after hearing Mo Shentian’s shout, and the crimson flames flew past them, causing them to frown.
"Demon God, what kind of crimson flames are those? Your ability isn’t even useful to dispel them."
Mo Shentian shook his head slightly. "It seems like the universe doesn’t want us to descend to the Three Mortal Realms."
"The universe?"

"Hmm." Mo Shentian nodded slightly. "According to my ancestors and master, the Paradise Realm and the Three Mortal Realms were connected in the past, but this barrier suddenly appeared and separated the two. They’ve tried investigating it, and they strongly suspect that the universe created the barrier, but they’ve never found any solid evidence for it."
"Does that mean this barrier is indestructible?"

"Let alone this barrier, no one can destroy those mysterious gates. Long Wuzhao and I once tried to destroy them, but our efforts always ended in vain because our attacks could never hit them." The five demons knew about the incident, but they didn’t know the sturdiness of those gates. "Sigh! We had traveled for months to reach this place, but the results were in vain."
"Are we going back to the Paradise Realm, Demon God?"

"Maybe we should join forces to breach this seal?" Mo Shentian looked at one of his subordinates. "Demon God, we’ve been gone for months, so I think we should try everything possible to break this seal. Those crimson flames just now were indeed powerful, but they didn’t attack us directly, and we can still avoid them."
"That’s true." Mo Shentian looked at the seal again, but a female figure appeared inside it, shocking him and his five subordinates. "Who are you?"
"I don’t need to introduce myself to lowly beings like you."
Mo Shentian frowned at the mysterious woman, but a powerful pressure suddenly pressed down on them from above, causing them to fall to their knees.

No cultivators from that realm are allowed to descend into the Three Mortal Realms, so this is my first and final warning, and I will kill you all if you insist."
Mo Shentian and his five subordinates breathed heavily after the mysterious woman entered the seal again, making the pressure that oppressed them previously disappear by itself.

Mo Shentian clenched his fists tightly, and his expression was filled with anger. Yue Xuelian sat up and straightened her dress, but her body heated up again as the activities of Zhang Fei’s five clones resurfaced in her mind, causing her previously subdued lust to flare up. "How long will I continue to be connected to him and his five clones? It’s been almost eight months since I connected with them, and I will fall into his arms if this continues."

After leaving the Celestial Moon Sect, Zhang Fei went to several other domains to meet with Feng Yao’s subordinates and replenish the pill stock in all his alchemy shops. He didn’t stay long in any of the domains, leaving immediately after chatting with Huo Lanyin and the others for a few minutes.

In the Azure Cloud Domain, Zhang Fei intended to meet Xiao Jingyi or Ye Jingyi to discuss something with her, but the woman was in her seclusion because the situation in the domain was under control, and Huo Yu’er protected his alchemy shop, so he did not disturb her and left the domain.

Thereafter, Zhang Fei went to the Heavenly Mistveil Domain to check out his shop there, where he met Feng Shanxi and Ren Xiyi. He didn’t think much of the shop since the female phoenix could handle everything, and he simply replenished his dwindling stock of pills. He didn’t go to meet the demihumans there, but he installed a teleportation device in his shop, allowing his people to return to his domain.

Zhang Fei wanted to go to the Divine Samsara Sect to look for alchemist ingredients, but Feng Yao told him not to go there because the situation there was still unstable after all the domains were separated from each other, and those powerful cultivators were monitoring the situation in the domains from their seclusion.

Zhang Fei agreed with Feng Yao and canceled his plan to go to the sect because he didn’t want to look for trouble with the powerful cultivators, and he still had an abundant supply of herbs for concocting pills in the Sealed World Pearl. After all, he always brought Jessica, Lillea, and Shi Wu there from time to time to nurture and increase their numbers.

Zhang Fei didn’t visit the other domains and returned to the training space to continue his seclusion. Since then, he hasn’t left the training space anymore, but his third and fourth clones occasionally go out to complete the daily quest. His two clones took turns going to the Ashen Lotus Monastery, located in the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain, to assist the Giant Yin-Yang Lotus.

After traveling for several months, the four perils finally arrived at the end of the tunnels connecting the Paradise Realm with the Three Mortal Realms. As their subordinates reported months ago, they couldn’t leave the tunnels because all the exits were sealed.

Taotie and the others attempted to destroy the seals, but four mysterious women emerged and confronted them. Unlike Mo Shentian, they arrogantly challenged the four women, which resulted in their defeat and severe injuries.

Taowu and the others were confused about the origins of the four mysterious women, especially since their powers surpassed theirs. They were completely powerless against the four women, something they had never experienced in their lives, except for their defeat by the Primordial Nihility Beast in the past.

After their crushing defeat by the four mysterious women, Qiongqi and the other three decided to turn around and return to the Paradise Realm. However, their severe injuries significantly reduced their speed, which would require them to spend significantly more time returning to the realm.

Four months passed in the outside world, equivalent to a year and a few months in the training space. Some women finally reached the 2-Sun Celestial Lord Realm, and Zhang Fei asked them to stabilize their cultivation first while he helped his other wives break through to that stage.

Nine and a half months have passed since the changes in the Paradise Realm, and several human domains have regained their stability, including the Heavenlight Domain, the Sky Pillar Domain, the Empyrean Domain, and several others.

As per the orders of the ancestors of the Divine Samsara Sect, Liang Huizhong formed several groups of cultivators and sent them to explore the current Paradise Realm, with their main destination being domains directly affiliated with their sect, such as the Celestial Moon Domain and several other domains.

Since they needed assistance from other domains, human cultivators from various regions sent many individuals to map the current situation in the Paradise Realm. However, this task was challenging because they had to proceed without a clear direction or destination, and it would take them years to map everything in a random manner.

From the beginning, the domains of the beast races, natural races, winged races, and demon races were unaffected by the changes in the Paradise Realm because their races were highly independent. After such a long time, the leaders of all races began sending their subordinates to map the situation in the Paradise Realm and locate all the domains.
Long Wuzhao sent Long Xukong and members of the Void Dragon Race to assess the situation in the Paradise Realm. The natural races didn’t send anyone to do so, instead focusing on their own domain.

Tian Qiye didn’t make any moves because she wasn’t concerned about the situation in the other domains, especially since her own domain was still divided into two camps. Instead, she asked all the grand elders under her command to focus on their seclusion so that she could get rid of Tian Yizu’s group and gain full control over her race.

Unlike other races, all demon races were unconcerned about the changing situation in the Paradise Realm, especially since their domains were completely safe. Despite this, several demon gods, such as Sha Mo, Ku Shenzu, and Qian Yan, still ordered their subordinates to map it out.

Since Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe were still in seclusion with Zhang Fei, Ye Futian and Nalan Huanzi decided to send some people from their two demon races to explore and map out the situation in the Paradise Realm, especially the locations of the other demon domains.

Since the Seven Emotions Demon Domain and the Faceless Demon Domain were close together, Qi Qingxiu did not order her subordinates to do that; instead, she relied on Wu Mian, who had other bodies in other demon domains.
Another month passed; Mo Shentian and his five subordinates finally arrived at the end of the portal to the Paradise Realm, but they discovered that their exit was sealed.
They work together to destroy the seal, but all their efforts are in vain as it remains intact, even though they have used all their strength.

Mo Shentian tried to contact Mo Zainan and asked her to send the other demons to the portal’s location, but his wife told him that she didn’t know its location. He didn’t believe her, but she told him that the Paradise Realm had changed after those gates disappeared, leaving all the domains separated by vast distances.
"What happened, Demon God?"

"My wife just told me that those gates disappeared eleven months ago, and all the domains are now separated by a great distance, so she doesn’t know the location of this tunnel." Mo Shentian’s reply shocked his five subordinates. "The situation in the Paradise Realm is chaotic right now, and she has ordered our people to track its location, but it won’t be easy because the whereabouts of this portal are unknown."
"How can those gates disappear by themselves? Didn’t you and Long Wuzhao try to destroy those gates to no avail?"

Mo Shentian immediately thought of the mysterious woman who had prevented them from descending into the Three Mortal Realms. "I don’t know that woman’s identity, but I’m certain that she deliberately blocked our exit, and she may be the one behind the disappearance of those gates."
"So, what should we do now?"

Mo Shentian looked at the exit again. "I don’t know how long it will take our people to find the location of this tunnel, but we must continue working to break this seal; otherwise, we’ll be trapped here indefinitely."

Mo Shentian’s five subordinates sighed helplessly in their hearts as their strength was clearly insufficient to break the seal, making them curious about the mysterious woman’s identity and her purpose for locking them in the tunnel.
In the end, they followed Mo Shentian’s wishes and used all their strength to break the seal, even though they knew that their efforts would be in vain.
Unbeknownst to them, the mysterious woman was watching their actions from a distance. "No matter what you do, you will never be able to leave this tunnel, and I will release you when the time comes."

Some women finally reached the 2-Sun Celestial Lord Realm, and Zhang Fei asked them to stabilize their cultivation first while he helped his other wives break through to that stage.

Nine and a half months have passed since the changes in the Paradise Realm, and several human domains have regained their stability, including the Heavenlight Domain, the Sky Pillar Domain, the Empyrean Domain, and several others.

As per the orders of the ancestors of the Divine Samsara Sect, Liang Huizhong formed several groups of cultivators and sent them to explore the current Paradise Realm, with their main destination being domains directly affiliated with their sect, such as the Celestial Moon Domain and several other domains.
Since they needed assistance from other domains, human cultivators from various regions sent many individuals to map the current situation in the Paradise Realm.
However, this task was challenging because they had to proceed without a clear direction or destination, and it would take them years to map everything in a random manner.
From the beginning, the domains of the beast races, natural races, winged races, and demon races were unaffected by the changes in the Paradise Realm because their races were highly independent.
After such a long time, the leaders of all races began sending their subordinates to map the situation in the Paradise Realm and locate all the domains.
Long Wuzhao sent Long Xukong and members of the Void Dragon Race to assess the situation in the Paradise Realm.
The natural races didn’t send anyone to do so, instead focusing on their own domain.
Tian Qiye didn’t make any moves because she wasn’t concerned about the situation in the other domains, especially since her own domain was still divided into two camps.
Instead, she asked all the grand elders under her command to focus on their seclusion so that she could get rid of Tian Yizu’s group and gain full control over her race.
Unlike other races, all demon races were unconcerned about the changing situation in the Paradise Realm, especially since their domains were completely safe.
Despite this, several demon gods, such as Sha Mo, Ku Shenzu, and Qian Yan, still ordered their subordinates to map it out.

Since Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe were still in seclusion with Zhang Fei, Ye Futian and Nalan Huanzi decided to send some people from their two demon races to explore and map out the situation in the Paradise Realm, especially the locations of the other demon domains.

Since the Seven Emotions Demon Domain and the Faceless Demon Domain were close together, Qi Qingxiu did not order her subordinates to do that; instead, she relied on Wu Mian, who had other bodies in other demon domains.
Another month passed; Mo Shentian and his five subordinates finally arrived at the end of the portal to the Paradise Realm, but they discovered that their exit was sealed.
They work together to destroy the seal, but all their efforts are in vain as it remains intact, even though they have used all their strength.
Mo Shentian tried to contact Mo Zainan and asked her to send the other demons to the portal’s location, but his wife told him that she didn’t know its location.
He didn’t believe her, but she told him that the Paradise Realm had changed after those gates disappeared, leaving all the domains separated by vast distances.
"What happened, Demon God?"

"My wife just told me that those gates disappeared eleven months ago, and all the domains are now separated by a great distance, so she doesn’t know the location of this tunnel." Mo Shentian’s reply shocked his five subordinates.
"The situation in the Paradise Realm is chaotic right now, and she has ordered our people to track its location, but it won’t be easy because the whereabouts of this portal are unknown."
"How can those gates disappear by themselves?
Didn’t you and Long Wuzhao try to destroy those gates to no avail?"
Mo Shentian immediately thought of the mysterious woman who had prevented them from descending into the Three Mortal Realms.
"I don’t know that woman’s identity, but I’m certain that she deliberately blocked our exit, and she may be the one behind the disappearance of those gates."
"So, what should we do now?"
Mo Shentian looked at the exit again.
"I don’t know how long it will take our people to find the location of this tunnel, but we must continue working to break this seal; otherwise, we’ll be trapped here indefinitely."

Mo Shentian’s five subordinates sighed helplessly in their hearts as their strength was clearly insufficient to break the seal, making them curious about the mysterious woman’s identity and her purpose for locking them in the tunnel.
In the end, they followed Mo Shentian’s wishes and used all their strength to break the seal, even though they knew that their efforts would be in vain.
Unbeknownst to them, the mysterious woman was watching their actions from a distance.
"No matter what you do, you will never be able to leave this tunnel, and I will release you when the time comes."

chapters.title: Chapter 1560: End Of Seclusion II
paragraphs: Three months passed quickly; Zhang Xiaolong [3] stood in front of the newly completed building for the new Celestial Moon Sect. "Are you satisfied with your new sect?"
"Yes." Yue Qianrou nodded to him. "Although this sect isn’t as large as our original sect, at least everything is new, and it’s more than enough to accommodate all our disciples."
"What about the formation you promised us?" Yue Yuling asked him.

"Elder Yuling, you don’t need to worry about that because Liao Hanxue has already prepared several formations for your sect, and the residents of this domain won’t be able to disturb you." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately contacted Liao Hanxue and asked her to come to their location. "She will be here soon, and you can all help her set up those formations. Once everything is in place, you can immediately move into this new sect and start your new lives in this domain. You guys may not get used to the new situation right away, but I’m sure you’ll be fine, and you can cultivate faster with the help of the Yin Qi from the Yin Lake."
"What about the other dual cultivation sects?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Yue Wanxian. "There are still a few sects left, but most of them have merged with the Sun Moon Sect and several other sects. I don’t have time to take care of them all, so I asked Chi Hongchen and Guang Yue to take care of them. However, you don’t need to worry about them, and I guarantee that they won’t bother you all. If they dare to do that, I will capture them and throw them into other domains. By the way, where is Sect Master Xuelian? Why doesn’t she join you guys?"
"My big sister locked herself in her private room several months ago, and she hasn’t responded to our calls since then." Yue Qianrou answered him.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow because that was the last time he went to see Yue Xuelian, and she had kissed him passionately that time. "You can tell her that your new sect building is ready, so she can arrange for you all to move here."

"Sigh." Yue Qianrou let out a heavy sigh after she contacted Yue Xuelian. "She just told me that she will continue her seclusion, and she asked me to take care of everything for now. I don’t know what happened to her, but she’s been acting strange since we decided to move to this domain over a year ago."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] naturally knew about it because Yue Xuelian had always avoided eye contact with him since then, but he still didn’t know about the reason behind her strange attitude. He was sure her strange behavior was because of Feng Yao, but the female phoenix was unwilling to tell him anything. "I will go to check on the construction of another sect, and I will return to seclusion afterward."
After Zhang Xiaolong [3] disappeared, Yue Wanxian spoke to the others. "That kid’s aura has grown stronger, and he seems like he’ll break through to the Celestial Emperor Realm soon."
"I knew that dual cultivators could cultivate quickly, but that kid’s cultivation speed is simply unbelievable," Yue Qingyi commented.

"I don’t know how he can cultivate so quickly, but he’ll probably catch up to our cultivation in the next few years. If he doesn’t bother with trivial matters and focuses completely on his isolation, he might reach our level much sooner." Yue Qianrou looked towards the distance. "Moreover, he has so many powerful cultivators by his side, including Empress Huo and Emperor Long, so I’m sure he and the Moonlit Passion Temple will surpass the Divine Samsara Sect in the future. As long as we are on his side, I’m sure the safety of our sect and members will be guaranteed."
"I hope so," Yue Wanxian sighed. "We have been under the pressure of the Divine Samsara Sect for too long, which has caused our sect to continue to decline."

Yue Qingyi looked at them. "After our sect moves to this domain, we need to start recruiting new disciples. Since Zhang Xiaolong [3] can move freely between domains regardless of distance, we should ask for his help with that."

"Yes," Yue Qianrou agreed with her. "However, we must be careful when recruiting new disciples from other domains, as the Divine Samsara Sect could learn of our presence here and likely send people, which would create problems for Zhang Xiaolong [3] and his sect. Let’s go back now; we must bring them all to move to this domain."
"Let’s go."

After he inspected the construction of the new sect for the Spring Breeze Pavilion and the Zenith Sect, Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not return to the training space; instead, he went to the Celestial Moon Domain and activated his invisibility ability to avoid Yue Qianrou and the others.
When he arrived there, Zhang Xiaolong [3] saw Yue Qianrou in front of Yue Xuelian’s seclusion room.
At first, Yue Xuelian didn’t want to see her, but she eventually opened the seal on her seclusion room, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately snuck in.
Yue Qianrou didn’t stay there for long, and she left again after reporting everything to Yue Xuelian, who asked her to take care of everything while she was in seclusion.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not directly deactivate his invisibility and observed Yue Xuelian, who suddenly took off her dress. She groped her body, especially her two private parts, as she muttered his name.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was truly confused by Yue Xuelian’s behavior because he had never used his demon abilities on her, but she acted like a woman infatuated with him. ’What really happened to her? Why did her character become like this now?’
Some time later, Zhang Xiaolong [3] saw that Yue Xuelian was already getting more and more lustful, and he heard something that a woman like her would never have said, leaving him dumbfounded.

After waiting and thinking for some time, Zhang Xiaolong [3] appeared in front of Yue Xuelian, making her gaze like a female wolf ready to pounce on him. He sighed softly, activated his light domain, and channeled his light elements into her body.
Slowly, Yue Xuelian’s lust disappeared, and her mind became clear again. She froze as she stared at Zhang Xiaolong [3], and her cheeks flushed red as she realized she was naked.

"What actually happened to you, Xuelian?" Yue Xuelian became nervous and awkward when she heard Zhang Xiaolong [3] call her name directly without her honorific title. "Although I don’t know you very well, I know this isn’t the character of a respectable woman like you. You masturbated while calling my name, which made me feel strange about your behavior."

Yue Xuelian did not immediately answer Zhang Xiaolong [3] and instead put on her dress, even though she realized it was too late since he had already seen her completely naked. "I don’t know what happened to me, but I can see all your activities and your five clones with all your women."
"Huh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was stunned by her answer. "Can you really see everything?"

"I can see everything as you all train and dual cultivate there." Yue Xuelian nodded slightly. "At first, I kept fighting my lust, but I couldn’t fight it anymore after you came to see me last time. That’s why I locked myself here; I didn’t want Yue Qianrou and the others to see me like this, as they would think I was a lowly woman."
"When did this start happening?"
"One year and three months ago."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised his eyebrows and tried to recall the events from that time; he clearly remembered that Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou visited his sect, but he did not do anything to her at that time. "How could this happen?"

Yue Xuelian wanted to mention Empress Huo’s name, but she immediately swallowed her words and shook her head at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I don’t know how this happened, but I can see the activities of all of you since then, which ultimately affected me to this extent."
"What do you want now?"
"I don’t know."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] sighed softly and walked over to Yue Xuelian’s side, extending his hand to her.
Yue Xuelian looked at him in confusion. "What do you want to do?"

"Honestly, I’m interested in you, and I want you to be my woman." Yue Xuelian froze after Zhang Xiaolong [3] said that. "I won’t force you to become one, and I want to give you a chance to improve yourself. You’ve seen my training ground and watched us train there for so long, so you should already know that the facilities there are useful for you. Moreover, the time flow in that place is four times faster than the outside world, and you have already told Yue Qianrou that you will continue your studies, so I think there is no problem if you train there."
"What—"

"You’ll see everything for yourself after this." Yue Xuelian felt hesitant about accepting Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s offer. "After you train there for a few years, you will become stronger than the ancestors of your sect who joined the Divine Samsara Sect, and they will not be able to suppress you anymore."
"Can I really surpass them?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "You’ve seen some of my abilities, and you’ve also seen them train, so you don’t need to doubt that. When you emerge from your seclusion, I guarantee you’ll be stronger and faster. So, what’s your decision?"
"Alright." After Yue Xuelian took his hand, Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought her into the training space directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1561: End Of Seclusion III
paragraphs: After they arrived inside, Zhang Xiaolong [3] explained to Yue Xuelian the functions of his training ground, especially the device in the middle of the room. "You can train with them for now, and I will return to my wives."

Yue Xuelian simply nodded and watched Zhang Xiaolong [3] leave for the pavilion. Since she had been watching all his activities for so long, she knew that he, his clones, and all their wives lived inside. She also knew that his two clones often took their wives to the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain to assist with the Giant Yin-Yang Lotus.
"I didn’t expect that he would bring you here, Sect Master Xuelian." Yue Xuelian turned to Tianshi Shengjie and Helian Xun’er. "Has he done anything to you?"

Yue Xuelian was naturally embarrassed to admit the truth. "He didn’t do anything to me, and he offered me to train in this place. After thinking about it seriously, I chose to accept his offer so I could protect my sect from the Divine Samsara Sect."

’Haha! She’s lying!’ They had lived with Zhang Fei for years, and they had gotten to know him better, so they could see through Yue Xuelian’s lies. "He was right about this place, and we’ve both felt its effects now. If you train here for a few years and adapt to the high level of gravity, the people from the Divine Samsara Sect won’t be able to resist you. Moreover, your cultivation is already at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, so I’m sure you can adapt much faster than us."

"Yeah," Yue Xuelian looked at all the women who were busy with their training, but she only saw two female demons there, who were none other than Nalan Shizhe and Shang Xueli. Since she often saw them, she immediately knew that Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu were in the pavilion.

"In this place, the gravity feature isn’t the only one, but the device still has several other functions. The Comprehension feature is useful for us to learn new techniques, the Battle Simulation feature is helpful for honing our fighting skills, and the Suppression feature can help us increase our soul power." Yue Xuelian nodded to Tianshi Shengjie. "Since Zhang Fei brought you here, you must not waste this opportunity, and you must make the most of your time here to improve yourself. Once you adapt, you’ll be one of the strongest cultivators in the Paradise Realm, surpassing your sect’s ancestors who joined the Divine Samsara Sect."

"Let’s start your training, Sect Master Xuelian." Helian Xun’er led her to the training area. "Time always passes quickly, and all the cultivators from the Paradise Realm will adapt to the changing situation soon, so we can’t waste time relaxing. When that happens, we will face many new problems, especially the people from the Divine Samsara Sect, so we must prepare ourselves well."
"Yes," Yue Xuelian inwardly sighed as her lust became uncontrollable again, but she quickly suppressed it and focused herself on practicing with the others.

"Haha," Luo Yunxiao laughed after Zhang Fei explained to them about Yue Xuelian. "I don’t know what happened to her, but I think her situation is favorable for you, and you will have another powerful cultivator by your side in the future."

Zhang Fei didn’t deny it, but he was still curious about the reason behind Yue Xuelian’s strange behavior. He was certain that Feng Yao was the mastermind, even though she wasn’t willing to admit it. "It’s been over a year and a month since the changes in the Paradise Realm, which means over four years here. However, only a few of them have broken through to the 2-Star Celestial Lord Realm, and some still need several more years to reach that stage."

"I doubt that’s a problem, right?" Ye Mingran asked him. "They might still need a few years to break through, but your cultivation is getting closer to the Celestial Emperor Realm because of our Yin Qi. I think that by the time they all reach the 2-Star Celestial Lord Realm, your cultivation will already be close to breaking through to that stage."
"Moreover, all of us have our avatars of the Nine Heavens Illusory Avatar Technique, so you don’t need to think about that and focus completely on yourself while helping them." Qi Qingxiu spoke.
Yao Qilin hugged Zhang Fei from behind. "If you feel lacking, you can dual cultivate with us as long as you like, and our Yin Qi will speed up your cultivation."

"That’s true." Fei Lian agreed with the others, as Zhang Fei had rarely dual cultivated with them in recent years, especially since he focused on helping all his wives, whose cultivation was still at the Celestial Lord Realm.

Nalan Wangzi then spoke. "You don’t need to worry about us because our cultivation is still higher than yours and that of the others; instead, you should focus fully on them. If you need us to help you, we’ll be ready at any time."
"Yeah," Zhang Fei immediately walked back to the room. "I’ll start helping them again, and you all can train with the others at the training ground.
Zhang Fei was preoccupied with his other wives, so Luo Yunxiao and the others immediately headed to the training ground to join the others in training.

Another month passed quickly, and all the members of the Celestial Moon Sect had settled into their new sect. However, Zhang Fei didn’t move his alchemy shop from their old sect because the Celestial Moon Domain’s turnover was quite significant, even though the population there was predominantly female.

Yue Qianrou was still confused about Yue Xuelian’s situation because she couldn’t enter her seclusion room, and she also didn’t know that Zhang Fei had already taken the sect master away a month ago. In the end, she ignored her and took over the sect’s leadership so she and the elders could settle down in their new sect.

As before, Nanfeng Yunxi continued to manage the alchemy shop, and Lin Jingxia often came to the old sect to help her. Meanwhile, Yan Yinqing and Xiao Laoshu joined the rest of the sect in moving to the new sect, and they could easily return to the Moonlit Passion Temple since both sects were now in the same domain.

Over the past year or so, the Moonlit Passion Temple itself has gained quite a number of new disciples. As per Zhang Fei’s orders, the elders didn’t recruit disciples carelessly; they only recruited those with considerable talent, increasing their number to around 300.

Despite the significant increase in the number of disciples, Zhang Fei hasn’t been able to complete the system quest because the requirement was to recruit 1,000 new disciples, and they have only recruited around 500 disciples since then. He didn’t bother with it because the quest didn’t have a time limit, like the four daily quests, and he wanted the best for his sect.

Another month passed, and the construction of the new sects for the Spring Breeze Pavilion and the Zenith Sect was finally completed. Lu Shaqing and Gong Wei contacted Zhang Fei before leading all the members of their two sects to the Twin Flames Domain, mainly because they couldn’t turn off the two teleportation devices in their two old sects.

After both sects were cleared, one of Zhang Fei’s clones immediately went to the Sun Moon Domain and took both teleportation devices so that people from that domain could not enter his domain, and he returned to seclusion again afterward.
Two months later, all of Zhang Fei’s women had reached the 2-Sun Celestial Lord Realm, with Zhang Ling being the last, as she lagged behind the others due to the process of upgrading her demon rank.

Zhang Fei’s own cultivation was getting closer to the Celestial Emperor Realm, and he was confident that he could break through to that stage before all of his wives broke through to the Celestial King Realm. If he could break through to the Celestial Emperor Realm sooner, he could assist his wives in reaching the Celestial King Realm ahead of time.
Zhang Fei wasted no time and continued to help them, while his five clones took turns working on the daily quests and training at the training ground.

Inside the tunnel, Mo Shentian and his five subordinates were truly frustrated because they still couldn’t get out, even though they had arrived at the exit six and a half years ago. No matter how hard they tried, they still couldn’t break the seal, especially since the mysterious woman kept appearing to stop them.

Sharing the same fate as the members of the Celestial Demon Race, Taotie and the other three were also unable to leave the tunnel. The avatars they left behind in the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain attempted to locate the four portals, but the changing situation in the Paradise Realm made it difficult to locate them, as the domains were now so far apart.

They tried to contact the Primordial Nihility Beast, but something prevented them from doing so. In the end, Taotie and the others chose to be patient and recover from the injuries they received from the four mysterious women, mainly because their injuries were quite heavy.

Time continued to pass quickly, and the situation in all domains in the Paradise Realm gradually stabilized. People had begun to discover several other domains adjacent to their original ones, but they couldn’t be satisfied with that. There were a total of 100 domains in the Paradise Realm, so they had to continue working to map them all.

sentences.text: After they arrived inside, Zhang Xiaolong [3] explained to Yue Xuelian the functions of his training ground, especially the device in the middle of the room.
"You can train with them for now, and I will return to my wives."
Yue Xuelian simply nodded and watched Zhang Xiaolong [3] leave for the pavilion.
Since she had been watching all his activities for so long, she knew that he, his clones, and all their wives lived inside.
She also knew that his two clones often took their wives to the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain to assist with the Giant Yin-Yang Lotus.
"I didn’t expect that he would bring you here, Sect Master Xuelian." Yue Xuelian turned to Tianshi Shengjie and Helian Xun’er.
"Has he done anything to you?"
Yue Xuelian was naturally embarrassed to admit the truth.
"He didn’t do anything to me, and he offered me to train in this place.
After thinking about it seriously, I chose to accept his offer so I could protect my sect from the Divine Samsara Sect."
’Haha!
She’s lying!’ They had lived with Zhang Fei for years, and they had gotten to know him better, so they could see through Yue Xuelian’s lies.
"He was right about this place, and we’ve both felt its effects now.
If you train here for a few years and adapt to the high level of gravity, the people from the Divine Samsara Sect won’t be able to resist you.
Moreover, your cultivation is already at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, so I’m sure you can adapt much faster than us."
"Yeah," Yue Xuelian looked at all the women who were busy with their training, but she only saw two female demons there, who were none other than Nalan Shizhe and Shang Xueli.
Since she often saw them, she immediately knew that Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu were in the pavilion.
"In this place, the gravity feature isn’t the only one, but the device still has several other functions.

The Comprehension feature is useful for us to learn new techniques, the Battle Simulation feature is helpful for honing our fighting skills, and the Suppression feature can help us increase our soul power." Yue Xuelian nodded to Tianshi Shengjie.
"Since Zhang Fei brought you here, you must not waste this opportunity, and you must make the most of your time here to improve yourself.
Once you adapt, you’ll be one of the strongest cultivators in the Paradise Realm, surpassing your sect’s ancestors who joined the Divine Samsara Sect."
"Let’s start your training, Sect Master Xuelian." Helian Xun’er led her to the training area.
"Time always passes quickly, and all the cultivators from the Paradise Realm will adapt to the changing situation soon, so we can’t waste time relaxing.
When that happens, we will face many new problems, especially the people from the Divine Samsara Sect, so we must prepare ourselves well."
"Yes," Yue Xuelian inwardly sighed as her lust became uncontrollable again, but she quickly suppressed it and focused herself on practicing with the others.
"Haha," Luo Yunxiao laughed after Zhang Fei explained to them about Yue Xuelian.
"I don’t know what happened to her, but I think her situation is favorable for you, and you will have another powerful cultivator by your side in the future."
Zhang Fei didn’t deny it, but he was still curious about the reason behind Yue Xuelian’s strange behavior.
He was certain that Feng Yao was the mastermind, even though she wasn’t willing to admit it.
"It’s been over a year and a month since the changes in the Paradise Realm, which means over four years here.
However, only a few of them have broken through to the 2-Star Celestial Lord Realm, and some still need several more years to reach that stage."
"I doubt that’s a problem, right?" Ye Mingran asked him.
"They might still need a few years to break through, but your cultivation is getting closer to the Celestial Emperor Realm because of our Yin Qi.
I think that by the time they all reach the 2-Star Celestial Lord Realm, your cultivation will already be close to breaking through to that stage."
"Moreover, all of us have our avatars of the Nine Heavens Illusory Avatar Technique, so you don’t need to think about that and focus completely on yourself while helping them." Qi Qingxiu spoke.
Yao Qilin hugged Zhang Fei from behind.
"If you feel lacking, you can dual cultivate with us as long as you like, and our Yin Qi will speed up your cultivation."

"That’s true." Fei Lian agreed with the others, as Zhang Fei had rarely dual cultivated with them in recent years, especially since he focused on helping all his wives, whose cultivation was still at the Celestial Lord Realm.
Nalan Wangzi then spoke.
"You don’t need to worry about us because our cultivation is still higher than yours and that of the others; instead, you should focus fully on them.
If you need us to help you, we’ll be ready at any time."
"Yeah," Zhang Fei immediately walked back to the room.
"I’ll start helping them again, and you all can train with the others at the training ground.
Zhang Fei was preoccupied with his other wives, so Luo Yunxiao and the others immediately headed to the training ground to join the others in training.
Another month passed quickly, and all the members of the Celestial Moon Sect had settled into their new sect.
However, Zhang Fei didn’t move his alchemy shop from their old sect because the Celestial Moon Domain’s turnover was quite significant, even though the population there was predominantly female.
Yue Qianrou was still confused about Yue Xuelian’s situation because she couldn’t enter her seclusion room, and she also didn’t know that Zhang Fei had already taken the sect master away a month ago.
In the end, she ignored her and took over the sect’s leadership so she and the elders could settle down in their new sect.
As before, Nanfeng Yunxi continued to manage the alchemy shop, and Lin Jingxia often came to the old sect to help her.
Meanwhile, Yan Yinqing and Xiao Laoshu joined the rest of the sect in moving to the new sect, and they could easily return to the Moonlit Passion Temple since both sects were now in the same domain.
Over the past year or so, the Moonlit Passion Temple itself has gained quite a number of new disciples.
As per Zhang Fei’s orders, the elders didn’t recruit disciples carelessly; they only recruited those with considerable talent, increasing their number to around 300.

Despite the significant increase in the number of disciples, Zhang Fei hasn’t been able to complete the system quest because the requirement was to recruit 1,000 new disciples, and they have only recruited around 500 disciples since then.
He didn’t bother with it because the quest didn’t have a time limit, like the four daily quests, and he wanted the best for his sect.
Another month passed, and the construction of the new sects for the Spring Breeze Pavilion and the Zenith Sect was finally completed.

Lu Shaqing and Gong Wei contacted Zhang Fei before leading all the members of their two sects to the Twin Flames Domain, mainly because they couldn’t turn off the two teleportation devices in their two old sects.

After both sects were cleared, one of Zhang Fei’s clones immediately went to the Sun Moon Domain and took both teleportation devices so that people from that domain could not enter his domain, and he returned to seclusion again afterward.
Two months later, all of Zhang Fei’s women had reached the 2-Sun Celestial Lord Realm, with Zhang Ling being the last, as she lagged behind the others due to the process of upgrading her demon rank.

Zhang Fei’s own cultivation was getting closer to the Celestial Emperor Realm, and he was confident that he could break through to that stage before all of his wives broke through to the Celestial King Realm.
If he could break through to the Celestial Emperor Realm sooner, he could assist his wives in reaching the Celestial King Realm ahead of time.
Zhang Fei wasted no time and continued to help them, while his five clones took turns working on the daily quests and training at the training ground.
Inside the tunnel, Mo Shentian and his five subordinates were truly frustrated because they still couldn’t get out, even though they had arrived at the exit six and a half years ago.
No matter how hard they tried, they still couldn’t break the seal, especially since the mysterious woman kept appearing to stop them.
Sharing the same fate as the members of the Celestial Demon Race, Taotie and the other three were also unable to leave the tunnel.

The avatars they left behind in the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain attempted to locate the four portals, but the changing situation in the Paradise Realm made it difficult to locate them, as the domains were now so far apart.
They tried to contact the Primordial Nihility Beast, but something prevented them from doing so.
In the end, Taotie and the others chose to be patient and recover from the injuries they received from the four mysterious women, mainly because their injuries were quite heavy.
Time continued to pass quickly, and the situation in all domains in the Paradise Realm gradually stabilized.
People had begun to discover several other domains adjacent to their original ones, but they couldn’t be satisfied with that.
There were a total of 100 domains in the Paradise Realm, so they had to continue working to map them all.

chapters.title: Chapter 1562: Exit Their Seclusion
paragraphs: A year and a half passed quickly in the outside world, equivalent to almost six years inside the training space. All of Zhang Fei’s wives had reached the 3-Sun Celestial Lord Realm, and his cultivation was getting closer to the Celestial Emperor Realm.

Zhang Fei was not satisfied with that, and he wanted them to reach the Celestial King Realm before they ended their seclusion. He knew that they would need more time to break through to the Celestial King Realm because the qi required was simply too great, which could not be achieved in a few years. All of them did not always rely on dual cultivation, but they also cultivated manually, assisted by their respective avatars.

For the past year and a half, two of Zhang Fei’s five clones took turns leaving the training space to restock pills in all his alchemy shops, and they also took turns assisting with the Giant Yin-Yang Lotus. Naturally, they also checked on the progress of the Twin Flames Domain and the Moonlit Passion Temple.

The presence of the Liao, You, Qiao, Wu, Tang, and Zhang clans also brought about significant changes in the Twin Flames Domain. The residents of the domain bought many new things from all the clans, such as weapons, formations, and others.

As for the pills, they could buy them at the Moonlit Passion Sect because Zhang Fei asked Lin Jingxia and Tian Shuixiang to sell them to the public. He decided to sell his pills to the public, especially general pills that he bought in the system, such as healing pills, recovery pills, and other pills. He did not sell the important pills of the system to keep their strength at a distance from his sect members, allowing his sect members to be superior to the public people.

Even though they couldn’t go to other domains to buy goods or hunt, they were truly satisfied with the changes in their domain because they could get everything they needed without having to go to others.
Zhang Fei’s two clones often brought Shang Luohu to the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain, reuniting her with her daughter, Shang Xueli.

Zhang Fei’s clones also took Yue Xuelian out of the training space several times to take care of the new Celestial Moon Sect, but she ultimately handed over all her sect affairs to Yue Qianrou and the female elders. She wanted to focus on her training in the training space, which had had a significant impact on her.

Yue Qianrou and the female elders were confused by Yue Xuelian’s decision, as she refused to reveal the location of her seclusion to them. After all, the training space was Zhang Fei’s private place, and he had no intention of bringing them inside.
The number of new disciples in the Moonlit Passion Temple increased by 300 during that time, but it was not enough to complete Zhang Fei’s quest because he still needed 200 more disciples.

The Twin Flames Domain became increasingly developed with the existence of the new Celestial Moon Sect and a new sect called the Spring Zenith Sect, which was the result of the merger of the Spring Breeze Pavilion and the Zenith Sect.

Zhang Fei’s clones also communicated with Long Wuzhao, Jia Leixuan, and several others to monitor the situation in the Paradise Realm. They informed him that there were no problems in their domains, and their subordinates had successfully mapped the locations of several other domains, both human and demon.

As for the Ice Phoenix race, Feng Shizhu and Feng Bingying had long known about the situation in the Paradise Realm because Zhang Fei’s clones had already informed them of the changes. However, they ignored it and focused entirely on cultivating at the eastern lake of the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain.

After searching for the portal for so long, Mo Zhainan’s subordinates finally managed to locate the location where Mo Shentian and his five subordinates were imprisoned, and she ordered them to help her husband destroy the seal because it was impossible for her to refuse his orders.

They couldn’t do anything because the seal was too strong, and it remained unbreakable, even though they attacked it with all their might. Every time Mo Shentian and his five subordinates tried to attack the seal from within, the mysterious woman immediately emerged from it to stop them. They were desperate with their situation, as they couldn’t wait to leave the portal, especially since they had been trapped there for so long.
Mo Shentian contacted Mo Zainan and asked her to find another way to free them, but she herself had no solution for that.

In four different tunnels, Taotie and the three evil mythical beasts had already arrived at the exit portal to the Paradise Realm, and it took them a long time to get there due to their heavy injuries. They found four exits sealed, like the ones leading to the Three Mortal Realms, which made them think twice about attacking those seals because their injuries had not fully recovered.

Qiongqi and the other three knew about the situation in the Paradise Realm because their four avatars resided in the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain. They had long since ordered their subordinates to search for the four tunnels, but they still couldn’t find them.

They tried to contact their master, the Primordial Nihility Beast, but it gave them no answer because it was still in the long slumber. In the end, Taowu and the others choose to wait for their avatars and subordinates to arrive at their location while recovering from their injuries.

Another year passed quickly, and Zhang Fei finally reached the Celestial Emperor Realm. Similar to when he broke through to the Celestial King Realm, the heavens didn’t send down his lightning tribulations. He was worried that the heavens would send down all of his lightning tribulations at once, and he wouldn’t be able to handle them all at once.

In addition to Zhang Fei’s cultivation, his body cultivation finally broke through to the Divine Body Stage after decades of stagnation, allowing him to harness and unleash the power of heaven and earth.

Zhang Fei’s Indestructible Vajra Immortal Body, the most difficult of all his body techniques, also broke through to the Immortal Core Marrow Stage after decades of stagnation. His marrow transformed into immortal jade marrow and produced boundless qi, and he also gained near-instant Qi recovery and stamina regeneration.

Zhang Fei’s soul cultivation also broke through to the perfection stage of the Divine Soul Level, making him the youngest cultivator to successfully reach that stage. However, he had no clue how to reach the Immortal Soul Level, but he didn’t think too much about it, and he was confident that his soul cultivation would break through to that stage.
Apart from his cultivation, soul cultivation, and body cultivation, Zhang Fei also managed to perfectly adapt to level 8 gravity.

A year and a half later, all of Zhang Fei’s wives finally reached the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm. He decided to end their seclusion and brought everyone out of the training space, except for Shang Xueli.

Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, and Nalan Shizhe returned to their demon domains, having been away for over five years. Although their three artificial puppets have always been in their domains, they still have to return to take care of many matters themselves.
Dong Xuanyin returned to the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain to check the situation there, but she did not detect the presence of the avatars of Taotie and the others.

Tianshi Shengjie decided to return to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain to see her family. Although her father told her that the situation in the Radiance Domain was safe, Tian Huangjin decided to return there with Tian Yaoqin, who had also decided to return after her long absence.

Yue Xuelian returned to the new Celestial Moon Sect to take care of many things, especially after she was absent for too long. Although her cultivation has not yet broken through to the Celestial God Realm, she has improved a lot after practicing in Zhang Fei’s training space.

Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling gathered all the sect elders for a meeting. Although Zhang Fei frequently sent his clones out to assess the situation, they were the true leaders of their sect, and they had been absent for too long due to their seclusion.
All of Zhang Fei’s wives returned to their residence behind the mountain, and they focused on stabilizing their cultivation after they broke through to the Celestial King Realm.

After Zhang Fei waited for so long, the quest to find 1,000 new disciples was finally completed, but he received a new quest to find 5,000 new disciples. He doesn’t bother with it because the quest has no time limit, and he will wait patiently until it completes itself.
"What are your plans now?" Luo Yunxiao asked him.
Nalan Wangzi also asked him. "Are you thinking about going to the demon domains?"

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei rubbed his chin and thought. "Mo Shentian and the four perils have returned to this Paradise Realm, but they can’t exit the tunnel because something is blocking them. The two primordial beasts haven’t shown any movement either, so the situation in this Paradise Realm is still safe for now. For now, I want to check some things in other places, and you two can return to your domains if you want."
"I’m returning to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary now." Luo Yunxiao immediately flew away.
Nalan Wangzi hugged his arm. "I won’t go back there, and I’ll accompany you."
"Alright."

chapters.title: Chapter 1563: Shadowy Creatures
paragraphs: Luo Yunxiao was already at the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary with her family. She smiled at her five-year-old nephew and niece, but they seemed shy towards her, as they hadn’t seen her since they were born. Even so, both children recognized her because their grandparents and parents often showed them photos of her.
"Huxiao, say hello to Aunt Yunxiao." Bing Xingying pushed her son forward.
Chen Mengyao also pushed her daughter forward. "You too, Xuanyao. Say hello to Aunt Yunxiao."
Luo Huxiao and Luo Xuanyao walked to the front of Luo Yunxiao. "Nice to meet you, Aunt Yunxiao."

"Nice to meet you two, Huxiao and Xuanyao." Luo Yunxiao rubbed their heads. "You two have grown up now, and I’m sorry that I’m only visiting you now because I’ve been busy with my seclusion with your uncle in the past five years."
"It’s okay, Aunty."
"Are you going to live with us from now on, Aunty?"
"I’m Zhang Fei’s wife, so I have to stay with him, but I’ll visit you two more often in the future."
Luo Huxiao and Luo Xuanyao nodded at her, but their expressions clearly showed disappointment.
"Where is Zhang Fei now, Yunxiao?"

Luo Yunxiao looked at her mother. "My husband wants to go to several domains to check on a few things, Mother. After all, it’s been more than five years since the changes in this Paradise Realm, and he’s been in seclusion all those years, so he wants to check everything out. Have there been people from other domains who came to this domain in the past five years?"

"Yes," Huang Xiaoyi nodded at her. "Since that change, everyone in the domain has gone to check other nearby domains, and they found five other domains, with the closest one being 1000 miles away and the furthest one being 3500 miles away. Fortunately, those domains are small and not the main ones in this realm, so we don’t need to worry about people from those domains."
"Have the people from the Divine Samsara Sect found the location of this domain?"

Luo Fengyan answered her directly. "Someone from the Divine Samsara Sect contacted me two years ago, but they haven’t managed to find this domain yet, so I think the distance between our domain and the Heavenlight Domain is simply too great."
"What do they want from us?"

"Nothing," Luo Fenghan replied with a shake of his head. "Since all the domains in the Paradise Realm are still connected through those gates, the people from the Divine Samsara Sect have never bothered us, mainly because of the presence of our five ancestors. Moreover, the distance between the two domains is too far now, so I’m sure they won’t have any thoughts about us."
"What about our five ancestors?"

"They came out of their seclusion several times in the past few years to check the situation, and they went back into seclusion again once they were sure that the situation in this domain and our sect was safe."
"Did they ask about my husband?"
"Ancestor Jieyi once asked about you and Zhang Fei, but I told her that you two rarely come here, and she didn’t say anything else to me."
Luo Yunxiao nodded slightly. "I don’t know what they’re thinking, but I hope they’ve forgotten their anger towards my husband."
"I hope so; I don’t want any serious problems to arise between them," Luo Fenghan replied with a soft sigh.
"Will you stay here for a few days?"

"Yes," Luo Yunxiao answered her mother with a light nod. "My husband’s cultivation has broken through to the One-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm, and my other sisters have broken through to the One-Sun Celestial King Realm. Their cultivation is still unstable now, so we won’t be entering seclusion for the next few years."

"Sigh," Huang Xiaoyi said softly. "Time flies so fast, Yunxiao. Huxiao and Xuanyao are already five years old, but you still haven’t given us a grandchild. Even though we already have them, we still want a grandchild from you and Zhang Fei."
Luo Yunxiao smiled as she listened to her mother. "Don’t worry, Mother. We’ll give you grandchildren when my husband is ready to have children, so I hope you can be patient enough to wait."
"What can I do but wait?" Huang Xiaoyi immediately stood up. "I’ll cook your favorite food now, and we’ll eat together later."
As Huang Xiaoyi walked away, Luo Fenghan also left them to take care of some matters.

Luo Yunxiao sighed inwardly as she looked at her parents, but then she looked at her niece and nephew, who were still shy around her. "Do you two want to go to the Moonlit Passion Temple? You two can learn a lot from the senior cultivators there, like Jian Kuang and the others."

"Wait." Zhang Fei listened to the message from Luo Yunxiao. "Hmm? Shadowy creatures?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1564: The Source
paragraphs: "Shadowy creatures? What kind of creatures are they? Where do they appear?"
"The Ancient Realm."

Zhang Fei took out the Demon’s Eye Orb and sent it into the Ancient Desolation Domain to inspect the place. He also created a qi screen connected to the orb, allowing them to see the situation there more clearly.

They focused on the areas of the Ancient Desolation Domain that the orb passed through and observed that shadowy creatures had already infested those areas. They overpowered the domain’s demons and beasts, who were stronger than those in the Paradise Realm.
"Where do those shadow creatures come from?"

"I don’t know," Zhang Fei answered with a shake of his head. "My sister-in-law told Luo Yunxiao that these shadowy creatures appear out of nowhere, and the Will of the Universe still hasn’t managed to locate the source, so she can’t stop them."

"Even the Will of the Universe doesn’t know the cause of the appearance of these shadowy creatures, huh?" Nalan Wangzi pointed to the screen. "Look at them, husband. Those shadowy creatures possessed those beasts and demons, and they seem to be controlling them now."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei frowned as he watched those beasts and demons become more ferocious, but strangely, they didn’t attack each other, and they seemed to be searching for a way out of the domain. "What actually happened in the Ancient Realm? Why did those shadowy creatures suddenly appear? What were they really looking for there?"

"My two souls." Zhang Fei and Nalan Wangzi turned to Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul. "I don’t have any information about the origins of those shadowy creatures, but they are clearly targeting my greed and envy souls. If my two souls fall into their hands, the next ten-tailed fox will never be born, and this universe will be headed for destruction."
"Are those shadowy creatures unstoppable, Senior?"

"I’m already dead, and I’ve already divided my power, so I can’t stop them. The cultivators living in this era, whether they’re from the Paradise Realm or the Ancient Realm, can’t stop them either." Hu Tianlang looked at Zhang Fei. "Aren’t you coming out, Shen Yuanzhi?"
Feng Yao immediately emerged from Zhang Fei’s body. "I myself have no information about those shadowy creatures, so I can’t offer any solutions to deal with them."
"You can’t give this kid a solution, but you have something that should be able to stop those shadowy creatures, right?"
"Can the Eternal Flame stop those shadowy creatures, Feng Yao?"

Feng Yao nodded to them. "Huo Ling should be able to crush them, but she can’t eradicate them completely, and they will continue to appear until we can destroy the source. The most important thing now is to secure Hu Tianlang’s Greed and Envy Souls, but both are located deep within the Ancient Realm, and we will face many obstacles in going there."

"This kid won’t be able to go there by himself, but you and Huo Ling should be able to take him to both places. If my two souls fall into the hands of those shadowy creatures, our hopes for the future of this universe will be destroyed, and our efforts thus far will end in vain." Hu Tianlang looked at Feng Yao. "I know you want this kid to try to go there himself, but we have no other choice now, so you have to take him there."

"No," Feng Yao rejected it. "There is still another solution to prevent those shadowy creatures from reaching both locations of your last two souls, and I’m sure they won’t be able to enter those two places."
"What kind of solution?"
"The Will of the Universe should be able to create two barriers to protect both places, and I’m sure these shadowy creatures won’t be able to go there."
"Are you sure about that?"

"Yes," Feng Yao nodded. "For now, you’re not ready to go to the Ancient Realm, let alone face those shadowy creatures, so the best solution is to ask the Will of the Universe for help to prevent them from entering those two places."

Zhang Fei was fully aware of his own strength, so he had deep doubts about going to the Ancient Realm with his current strength. "I’ll go to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary now, and I’ll ask Bing Xingying to take me there."
After he withdrew the Demon’s Eye Orb from the Ancient Desolation Domain and Feng Yao re-entered his body, Zhang Fei opened the gate leading to the Empyrean Domain and took Nalan Wangzi with him.
"Where do those shadowy creatures actually come from?" Hu Tianlang thought for a while before disappearing from the scene.
Not long after Hu Tianlang left, Feng Yao and Huo Ling appeared at that place. "Master, you should know the origins of those shadowy creatures, right? Why don’t you tell them the truth?"
"I don’t know the origins of those shadowy creatures, but I have some guesses about them."
"What are your guesses?"
"They come from the source of this universe’s creation."
"You mean?"

"Yes," Feng Yao nodded at Huo Ling. "The two women we met years ago came from another universe, and the older one told us that her universe also faced many problems, which forced her husband to take over control of it. If my guess is correct, the source of those shadowy creatures comes from the same source in their universe, but I can’t trace it."
"What if we meet that girl, Master? Back then, she said that she would continue to monitor Zhang Fei, so I’m sure she’s still in our universe now, and she might be in that place."

Feng Yao shook her head in refusal. "Sometimes it’s not a good thing for us to know everything, and we have to wait for the right time to find out the truth. Moreover, our universe is different from that girl’s, so she might not have the answers for us. Let’s go back; we will monitor the situation from our domain, and I will think of another way to stop those shadowy creatures."
Far away from the Paradise Realm, Xuanyuan Yue sat in front of several large screens, observing those shadowy creatures.
"What are you looking at, Yue’er?"
Xuanyuan Yue pointed at the screen. "Are you familiar with those shadowy creatures, Aunt Huang?"

"Hmm?" Aunt Huang observed those shadowy creatures. "They are similar to the darkness that appeared in our universe in the past, and it would have swallowed it if your father hadn’t stopped that person and taken control of our universe from him."

"I share your opinion." Xuanyuan Yue turned to her. "However, the situation in this universe is different from ours, Aunt Huang. Feng Yao is a higher existence than those sleeping primordials, and I suspect that she is the core of this universe that has deliberately manifested itself."
"Are you sure about that?"

Xuanyuan Yue nodded to her. "Feng Yao wouldn’t tell me the truth when my mother and I met her a few years ago, but my gut tells me that my suspicions about her are correct. I’m certain she’s the embodiment of this universe itself because she knows many things that others don’t, and she can enter the place known as the Era of the Beginning, where all the history of this universe is stored."

"If your conjecture about Feng Yao being the core of the universe is correct, then where did those shadowy creatures come from? Could she have intentionally created them to destroy this universe? Could they have come from a different source?"

"I can’t be sure about that yet, Aunt Huang." Xuanyuan Yue looked at the screens again. "However, I’m certain that those shadowy creatures came from the same source as the darkness that appeared in our universe in the past, and I’m not sure that Zhang Fei could stop them because he was different from my father. If he failed to stop them, those creatures would dominate this universe, and the giant Yin-Yang Lotus would be destroyed along with the destruction of the balance of Yin and Yang in this universe. Can you help him with something, Aunt Huang?"

"No," Aunt Huang immediately refused. "I know how you feel, Yue’er. We already made a mistake when you accidentally killed Zhang Fei, and I also made a mistake by bringing him back to life, so we can’t interfere any further in the affairs of this universe; otherwise, the situation would be even worse for them."

Xuanyuan Yue sighed heavily. "You’re right, Aunt Huang. I hope Zhang Fei will be able to handle everything like my father, but I also doubt that he will be able to do so since he doesn’t have people like you to support him."
"Doesn’t Zhang Fei have Feng Yao by his side?"

"Feng Yao is different from you, Aunt Huang." Xuanyuan Xue looked at her. "You loved our universe, and you did everything to save it from the darkness, making my father hate you for so long. On the other hand, that woman only cares about herself, and she doesn’t really care about the safety of her universe. She had often helped Zhang Fei over the years, but she did everything for her own benefit, not for him or this universe. If she continues to act like that, I’m sure this universe will be completely destroyed."

Aunt Huang nodded slightly. "I don’t want this universe to be destroyed either, but we can no longer interfere in matters here. You’ve given Zhang Fei several important things, including Mei and the system, so he must use his own power to prevent the destruction of his universe."

"I know." After Aunt Huang left, Xuanyuan Yue thought for a while before doing anything using her keyboard. "I don’t want to interfere anymore, but I can’t let you and this universe be destroyed, so I’ll help you one last time."
