If he failed to stop them, those creatures would dominate this universe, and the giant Yin-Yang Lotus would be destroyed along with the destruction of the balance of Yin and Yang in this universe.
Can you help him with something, Aunt Huang?"
"No," Aunt Huang immediately refused.
"I know how you feel, Yue’er.

We already made a mistake when you accidentally killed Zhang Fei, and I also made a mistake by bringing him back to life, so we can’t interfere any further in the affairs of this universe; otherwise, the situation would be even worse for them."
Xuanyuan Yue sighed heavily.
"You’re right, Aunt Huang.
I hope Zhang Fei will be able to handle everything like my father, but I also doubt that he will be able to do so since he doesn’t have people like you to support him."
"Doesn’t Zhang Fei have Feng Yao by his side?"
"Feng Yao is different from you, Aunt Huang." Xuanyuan Xue looked at her.
"You loved our universe, and you did everything to save it from the darkness, making my father hate you for so long.
On the other hand, that woman only cares about herself, and she doesn’t really care about the safety of her universe.
She had often helped Zhang Fei over the years, but she did everything for her own benefit, not for him or this universe.
If she continues to act like that, I’m sure this universe will be completely destroyed."
Aunt Huang nodded slightly.
"I don’t want this universe to be destroyed either, but we can no longer interfere in matters here.
You’ve given Zhang Fei several important things, including Mei and the system, so he must use his own power to prevent the destruction of his universe."
"I know." After Aunt Huang left, Xuanyuan Yue thought for a while before doing anything using her keyboard.
"I don’t want to interfere anymore, but I can’t let you and this universe be destroyed, so I’ll help you one last time."

chapters.title: Chapter 1565: System Level 9
paragraphs: [Ding.]
[Initiating the process for the system upgrade to level 9. Estimated completion time: one month.]
[New upgrades will be implemented after the process is complete.]
[Unable to generate new quests, the host’s cultivation is insufficient.]

Zhang Fei and Mei were both surprised by the notification. They had previously assumed the system wouldn’t receive an upgrade until they went to another realm, but it had suddenly upgraded on its own.

[You don’t need to ask me, Master. I myself don’t know why the system suddenly entered the upgrade process, but I think this is very good for you because the last time the system upgraded to level eight was almost twelve years ago.]
’I’m sure this is the young girl’s doing because she created the system.’
[I think so too, Master.]

Zhang Fei immediately led Nalan Wangzi to meet Luo Yunxiao and the others, who had gathered in the family garden. He smiled when he saw the two children. "They should be Luo Huxiao and Luo Xuanyao, right?"
"Nice to meet you, Uncle Zhang." Unlike Luo Yunxiao before, the two little ones were overjoyed as soon as they saw Zhang Fei.
Luo Yunxiao pursed her lips because her nephew and niece were so embarrassed by her, but they immediately got along with Zhang Fei, even though they had just met him for the first time.
Luo Yunxiao’s reaction made Chen Mengyao and Bing Xingying smile to themselves, and they were also happy because their two children immediately got along with their uncle.
"Haha," Zhang Fei carried the two boys. "You guys are big now! The last time I saw you two, your mothers had just given birth to you."
"Hehe," Luo Xuanyao hugged his neck. "Uncle Zhang, you should visit us more often in the future, okay?"

Luo Huxiao also spoke to him. "Uncle Zhang, I’ve wanted to meet you for a long time, but you only appeared today. I’ve wanted to thank you for a long time; my mother already told me that she was pregnant with me thanks to you."

"You don’t need to thank me because your parents are my family, and family should always help each other." Zhang Fei turned to the little girl. "I promise I’ll visit you two more often, and you two can also visit me at the Moonlit Passion Temple."
Luo Huxiao and Luo Xuanyao nodded to him. "Aunt Yunxiao has told us a lot about the Moonlit Passion Temple, and we can’t wait to see everything for ourselves."
"You two will enjoy being there, and you can also learn many things from all those senior cultivators."
"Yes,"
Luo Xuanyao looked at Nalan Wangzhi. "Is that auntie one of your wives, Uncle Zhang?"
"Her name is Nalan Wangzi, so you can call her Aunt Wangzi."
Luo Huxiao and Luo Xuanyao waved towards Nalan Wangzi. "Aunt Wangzi, nice to meet you."
"Nice to meet you too." Nalan Wangzi handed them two items. "You two should keep them safe, okay? If you two are ever in danger, just inject your qi into them, and they’ll protect you."
"Thank you, Aunt Wangzi."
"Have you checked that domain, husband?" Luo Yunxiao asked him.

"Yes," Zhang Fei immediately created a qi screen, displaying what had previously happened in the Ancient Desolation Domain. "As you can see, those shadowy creatures kill weak demons and beasts, but they control the strong ones. Feng Yao and Old Fox don’t know their origins, but they both suspect that those creatures are targeting his Greed and Envy Souls, which will hinder the birth of the next ten-tailed fox."
"Why do they want to stop the birth of the next ten-tailed fox?"
"No clue." Zhang Fei turned to Bing Xingying. "Sister-in-law, we will go to that place to meet the Will of the Universe now, and I will ask her to protect the old fox’s two souls."
"Okay." After Zhang Fei put the two little ones down, Bing Xingying immediately took him into the void.
"Aunt Wangzi, are you a demon?"
Nalan Wangzi squatted in front of the two children. "Are you two afraid of demons?"
"My mother said that not all demons are evil."
"My mother said that Uncle Zhang has many demon wives."
"Yes," Nalan Wangzi nodded at them. "Your uncle does have many demon wives, and you two can meet them when you visit our sect later."
"We both can’t wait to visit there, but we have to wait for them to return first."
"Yes,"

Zhang Fei and Bing Xingying were already standing before the Will of the Universe. {I already know your wish, and I have protected Hu Tianlang’s two souls from those shadowy creatures. However, their goal isn’t just his two souls; they seem to be after something else as well.}
"For example?"

{I can’t confirm their objective yet, and I’m still monitoring their movements. Right now, the situation in the Ancient Realm is getting more chaotic because they control many demons and beasts, and they are attacking other races that live there. Fortunately, they currently only appear there, and the situation would be even more complicated if they also appeared in the Paradise Realm.}
"Do you think they will appear in the Paradise Realm?"
{We can’t ignore that possibility, but fortunately, you asked me to remove those gates, so the situation in the Paradise Realm should be more under control than in the Ancient Realm.}
"Where did those shadowy creatures actually come from? Why did they suddenly appear in the Ancient Realm?"
{Unfortunately, I haven’t managed to find their origin, so I can’t stop them completely yet.}
"Is there another way for me to get to the Ancient Realm?"

{Her.} The woman pointed to Bing Xingying. {Bing Xingying is a void spirit, so she can take you there without passing through the Ancient Desolation Domain. However, I don’t recommend you go there now because those shadowy creatures are too powerful, and you will die if they attack you. Worst case scenario, they will take over your body and control you, and I won’t be able to stop them from invading all the domains in this Paradise Realm.}

Zhang Fei shuddered at the thought. He was not afraid to face those shadowy creatures, but he was afraid that they would use him to invade the Paradise Realm, which would affect his family members. "What do you think I should do now?"
{Focus on your cultivation and settle all your matters in the Paradise Realm first, and you don’t need to add unnecessary things like adding new shops.}
Zhang Fei smiled bitterly upon hearing this, as he was preparing those shops for his family’s future, particularly for his future children.

{I understand your goal in opening those shops, but it’s just a waste of your time. There are still many problems awaiting you, and the appearance of those shadowy creatures will add to your burden, so you should prioritize dealing with those issues. Moreover, you’ve already recruited several clans and sects into your domain, and you’ll recruit many more in the future, so you can focus on your own domain.}
"You’re right about that." Zhang Fei sighed softly. "Can my sister-in-law take me to the void core now?"
{Not yet, Zhang Fei. If you want to obtain new elements, you can look for the other elemental seeds first, and you can take the void elemental seed when Bing Xingying becomes stronger.}

Zhang Fei wasn’t too interested in other elements, and he wanted to get the void element faster because it would be useful for him when he traveled to other domains, including the Ancient Realm. "Hmm? I thought the metal element would be useful, and I already have the location of the metal elemental seed, so I thought I’d look for it first."

{The metal elemental seed is located in the Glazed Heaven Domain, but its location isn’t easy to reach, and you’ll encounter many battles there. You can bring all your wives to the domain, as most of them, like Zhang Chen and the others, have never been involved in actual combat. They have been training for decades, so it is time for them to get their feet wet in real combat, and the domain is perfect for their training ground.}

Zhang Fei had never allowed Zhang Chen or any other woman to get involved in the fighting, and he wanted them to always live in a safe situation without any bloodshed, but he understood her intentions. "Sigh! I’ll take them to that domain so they can practice for real combat. Since my business is finished, I will return now, and I will prepare to take them to that domain."

{Good luck, Zhang Fei.} After that, the woman sent Zhang Fei and Bing Xingying back. {Could those shadowy creatures have been created by the source that formed this universe? If that’s true, I won’t be able to stop them forever, and they might even break through my defenses one day.}

When Zhang Fei and Bing Xingying returned to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, Luo Yunxiao and the others were gathering with Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi in the dining hall, so they immediately joined them.
"Father-in-law, have you ever been to the Glazed Heaven Domain in the past?"
"Hmm?" Luo Fenghan looked at Zhang Fei. "Why are you suddenly asking about that domain? Do you want to train there?"
Zhang Fei nodded at him. "I was thinking of taking everyone to that domain to train, and I’ll also look for something there."

"I see." Luo Fenghan immediately explained to him about the situation in that domain. "You must be careful in that domain because you will encounter people from the War God Pavilion there, and the beasts there are powerful, so you must protect your people from them."

chapters.title: Chapter 1566: Training Preparation I
paragraphs: In the new Celestial Moon Sect, Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou were sparring on the training ground, watched by Yue Yuling and all the female elders. They were shocked by their master’s progress, especially her speed, which had increased several times compared to a few years ago, even though her cultivation remained at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm.

’Tch! How could her speed have increased so significantly if she had only spent five years in seclusion? If it’s like this, the distance between us will grow even further, and I can’t do anything to her.’
Unfortunately, Yue Qianrou didn’t know that Zhang Fei brought Yue Xuelian into his training space, and she trained there using the gravity feature for almost two decades.
After their spar, Yue Qianrou wiped away her sweat and steadied her ragged breaths. "How did your speed increase so much, Big Sis?"
"Please tell us, Sect Master." Yue Qingyi and the other elders also asked Yue Xuelian.

"A few years ago, Zhang Fei took me to train in a special place, but I can’t tell you about that place." Yue Xuelian’s answer shocked them, and they just realized that she had never been in her seclusion room for the past few years. "Don’t misunderstand me, okay? I didn’t train alone there because he also brought Lu Shaqing, Gong Wei, and people from several clans to train there."

Yue Xuelian was forced to lie to them, as Zhang Fei never brought those people into his training space to avoid suspicion of Yue Qianrou and those female elders. Moreover, she never did anything intimate with him, and they only talked to each other when they took a break from their activities.

Yue Qianrou and those female elders tried to observe Yue Xuelian’s body, and they found that she was still a virgin, making it difficult for them to guess whether she had a special relationship with Zhang Fei.
"Did people from the Divine Samsara Sect contact you all while I was in seclusion?"

"They contacted me several times because they couldn’t contact you, and they asked us to find the location of the Heavenlight Domain because they still haven’t managed to find the location of the Celestial Moon Domain." Yue Xuelian raised an eyebrow after Yue Qianrou informed her about it. "I told them that you were in seclusion, and we wouldn’t move without your orders. They were furious about it and forced me to find the location of their domain, but we didn’t do anything and focused on our sect."
"Did they say anything else?"
"They didn’t say anything, but eventually, they will discover the location of the Celestial Moon Domain, and they will find out that our sect moved to this domain five years ago."

Yue Xuelian informed Zhang Fei about this matter because his alchemy shop was still in the old Celestial Moon Sect, and she was worried that people from the Divine Samsara Sect would find their old domain and create chaos in his shop so he could take precautions for that. "What about all of you and our disciples?"

"Our progress isn’t bad because we’ve been cultivating at the Moonlit Passion Temple’s Celestial Yin Lake, but our progress can’t compare to yours, Sect Master." Yue Qingyi answered Yue Xuelian with a hint of jealousy in her voice, especially about her speed of improvement.
Yue Wanxian also spoke to her. "Fortunately, all the men in the sect never peek at us cultivating there, so we can cultivate peacefully without any disturbance, Sect Master."
"Our disciples also enjoy cultivating there, and they spend more time at the lake than in our sect," Yue Yuling said.

"I think our decision to move our sect to this domain was the right one, and everyone can cultivate more peacefully and faster." Yue Xuelian looked outside the training ground. "Even so, everyone remains on alert because the people from the Divine Samsara Sect will discover our location one day, and they will invade this domain to find us."
"Do you think all the defenses in this domain will be enough to stop them, Sect Master?"

"Although Liao Hanxue and the Liao Clan have created all the defenses in the domain, no defense is unbreakable. Moreover, the people from the Divine Samsara Sect are the strongest human race in this Paradise Realm, so we cannot underestimate them." Yue Xuelian paused for a moment and looked towards the floating plateau. "Although I’ve trained there, I still don’t know about Zhang Fei’s true strength, especially after he broke through to the 1-Sun Celestial Emperor Level."
"Has Zhang Fei really broken through to that stage, Big Sis?"
"Zhang Fei broke through to that stage some time ago, and his strength has increased significantly, but it’s not enough to face the people from the Divine Samsara Sect."

"Haha." They turned towards the laughter and saw Zhang Fei with Luo Yunxiao and Nalan Wangzi there. "You are right, Sect Master Xuelian. My strength is indeed insufficient to face the people from that sect, but you forget that I am not alone, and I have many powerful people by my side ready to assist me. If they dare to invade this domain, we will give them a fierce fight, and we will retaliate by attacking their domain and sect. By the way, I came here to invite some of you to join me to train in the Glazed Heaven Domain, and you must already know about that domain, right?"

Yue Qianrou nodded at him. "We’ve trained in that domain in the past because it’s like a battlefield, and we’ll encounter many powerful cultivators there, especially those from the Heavenly Trial Domain."
"Do you have any information about the War God Pavilion and their members?"

Yue Xuelian created a qi screen showing the situation in the War God Pavilion and some of its strongest members. "They are similar to the Asura Demon Race, and they possess superior physical strength and fighting abilities that surpass other humans. Moreover, they can enhance their strength by using their secret techniques, which will increase their power severalfold. They will never seek trouble with others first, but they become very fierce if others seek trouble with them, and you should avoid them because they have a strong hatred for demons."

"A strong hatred for demons, huh?" Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "So, are any of you interested in joining us? Your sect may have recently moved into this domain, but the situation has stabilized. There are many defenses within the domain to protect it, so I think you should focus on yourselves again in preparation for facing those from the Divine Samsara Sect in the future."
"What do you think about that, Big Sis?"
"I think that’s fine," Yue Xuelian readily agreed. "Moreover, your men will protect our disciples, right, Zhang Fei?"

Zhang Fei nodded at her. "My men will protect not only your sect but also this domain, and they will notify me if there is any danger threatening it. Moreover, we can return whenever we want, so you don’t need to worry too much about that."
"When will we depart for the Glazed Heaven Domain?"
"I haven’t informed my women and the people of my sect yet, so we’ll be leaving for the domain tomorrow morning, and we’ll probably be training there for quite some time."
Yue Xuelian nodded at him. "I think leaving tomorrow morning is the best option, so we can prepare ourselves today."

"Alright, you guys can get ready now, and I’ll pick you all up tomorrow morning." After Zhang Fei took the two women away, Yue Xuelian and the others immediately prepared themselves to leave for the Glazed Heaven Domain.

Zhang Fei didn’t immediately bring the two women back to the Moonlit Passion Temple, but he brought them to meet Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing, who both immediately agreed to join them in the Glazed Heaven Domain.

Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing immediately gathered the elders, asking them to prepare to leave for the Glazed Heaven Domain. As for the protection of their new sect, they entrusted it to their already constructed defenses and all the defenses in the Twin Flames Domain.

After arriving at the Moonlit Passion Temple, Zhang Fei had Luo Yunxiao and Nalan Wangzi inform all their sisters to prepare. He went to meet Jian Kuang and the others, asking them if they wanted to join him in the Glazed Heaven Domain.
Jian Kuang, the sword maniac, agreed without hesitation. Even though they had doubts about it, Han Ling, Zhuxian Sheng, and Su Shentian also agreed to go to the Glazed Heaven Domain.

Zhang Fei also offered representatives from all races the opportunity to join them, but not all of them were willing. Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha asked him to send them back to the Celestial Demon Domain because they hadn’t been back for years, so he immediately sent them back there.

Zhang Fei contacted Nong Qinwei, the sect master of the Hidden Moon Sect, and she agreed to take her sect members to the Glazed Heaven Domain. After all, they had been inactive since the changes in the Paradise Realm, and she wanted all her sect members to train there.
Zhang Fei contacted Tian Huangjin and Tianshi Shengjie, but only the female dragon would join them, and she would also bring some people from the beast races to the Glazed Heaven Domain.
Zhang Fei also offered the others to join them, but not all of them agreed due to their low cultivation levels. They were afraid of bringing trouble to him, so they decided to train in their domain.

They were furious about it and forced me to find the location of their domain, but we didn’t do anything and focused on our sect."
"Did they say anything else?"
"They didn’t say anything, but eventually, they will discover the location of the Celestial Moon Domain, and they will find out that our sect moved to this domain five years ago."

Yue Xuelian informed Zhang Fei about this matter because his alchemy shop was still in the old Celestial Moon Sect, and she was worried that people from the Divine Samsara Sect would find their old domain and create chaos in his shop so he could take precautions for that.
"What about all of you and our disciples?"

"Our progress isn’t bad because we’ve been cultivating at the Moonlit Passion Temple’s Celestial Yin Lake, but our progress can’t compare to yours, Sect Master." Yue Qingyi answered Yue Xuelian with a hint of jealousy in her voice, especially about her speed of improvement.
Yue Wanxian also spoke to her.
"Fortunately, all the men in the sect never peek at us cultivating there, so we can cultivate peacefully without any disturbance, Sect Master."
"Our disciples also enjoy cultivating there, and they spend more time at the lake than in our sect," Yue Yuling said.
"I think our decision to move our sect to this domain was the right one, and everyone can cultivate more peacefully and faster." Yue Xuelian looked outside the training ground.
"Even so, everyone remains on alert because the people from the Divine Samsara Sect will discover our location one day, and they will invade this domain to find us."
"Do you think all the defenses in this domain will be enough to stop them, Sect Master?"
"Although Liao Hanxue and the Liao Clan have created all the defenses in the domain, no defense is unbreakable.

Moreover, the people from the Divine Samsara Sect are the strongest human race in this Paradise Realm, so we cannot underestimate them." Yue Xuelian paused for a moment and looked towards the floating plateau.
"Although I’ve trained there, I still don’t know about Zhang Fei’s true strength, especially after he broke through to the 1-Sun Celestial Emperor Level."
"Has Zhang Fei really broken through to that stage, Big Sis?"
"Zhang Fei broke through to that stage some time ago, and his strength has increased significantly, but it’s not enough to face the people from the Divine Samsara Sect."
"Haha." They turned towards the laughter and saw Zhang Fei with Luo Yunxiao and Nalan Wangzi there.
"You are right, Sect Master Xuelian.
My strength is indeed insufficient to face the people from that sect, but you forget that I am not alone, and I have many powerful people by my side ready to assist me.
If they dare to invade this domain, we will give them a fierce fight, and we will retaliate by attacking their domain and sect.
By the way, I came here to invite some of you to join me to train in the Glazed Heaven Domain, and you must already know about that domain, right?"
Yue Qianrou nodded at him.
"We’ve trained in that domain in the past because it’s like a battlefield, and we’ll encounter many powerful cultivators there, especially those from the Heavenly Trial Domain."
"Do you have any information about the War God Pavilion and their members?"
Yue Xuelian created a qi screen showing the situation in the War God Pavilion and some of its strongest members.
"They are similar to the Asura Demon Race, and they possess superior physical strength and fighting abilities that surpass other humans.
Moreover, they can enhance their strength by using their secret techniques, which will increase their power severalfold.
They will never seek trouble with others first, but they become very fierce if others seek trouble with them, and you should avoid them because they have a strong hatred for demons."
"A strong hatred for demons, huh?" Zhang Fei nodded slightly.
"So, are any of you interested in joining us?
Your sect may have recently moved into this domain, but the situation has stabilized.
There are many defenses within the domain to protect it, so I think you should focus on yourselves again in preparation for facing those from the Divine Samsara Sect in the future."
"What do you think about that, Big Sis?"
"I think that’s fine," Yue Xuelian readily agreed.
"Moreover, your men will protect our disciples, right, Zhang Fei?"
Zhang Fei nodded at her.
"My men will protect not only your sect but also this domain, and they will notify me if there is any danger threatening it.
Moreover, we can return whenever we want, so you don’t need to worry too much about that."
"When will we depart for the Glazed Heaven Domain?"
"I haven’t informed my women and the people of my sect yet, so we’ll be leaving for the domain tomorrow morning, and we’ll probably be training there for quite some time."
Yue Xuelian nodded at him.
"I think leaving tomorrow morning is the best option, so we can prepare ourselves today."

"Alright, you guys can get ready now, and I’ll pick you all up tomorrow morning." After Zhang Fei took the two women away, Yue Xuelian and the others immediately prepared themselves to leave for the Glazed Heaven Domain.

Zhang Fei didn’t immediately bring the two women back to the Moonlit Passion Temple, but he brought them to meet Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing, who both immediately agreed to join them in the Glazed Heaven Domain.
Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing immediately gathered the elders, asking them to prepare to leave for the Glazed Heaven Domain.
As for the protection of their new sect, they entrusted it to their already constructed defenses and all the defenses in the Twin Flames Domain.
After arriving at the Moonlit Passion Temple, Zhang Fei had Luo Yunxiao and Nalan Wangzi inform all their sisters to prepare.
He went to meet Jian Kuang and the others, asking them if they wanted to join him in the Glazed Heaven Domain.
Jian Kuang, the sword maniac, agreed without hesitation.
Even though they had doubts about it, Han Ling, Zhuxian Sheng, and Su Shentian also agreed to go to the Glazed Heaven Domain.
Zhang Fei also offered representatives from all races the opportunity to join them, but not all of them were willing.
Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha asked him to send them back to the Celestial Demon Domain because they hadn’t been back for years, so he immediately sent them back there.
Zhang Fei contacted Nong Qinwei, the sect master of the Hidden Moon Sect, and she agreed to take her sect members to the Glazed Heaven Domain.
After all, they had been inactive since the changes in the Paradise Realm, and she wanted all her sect members to train there.
Zhang Fei contacted Tian Huangjin and Tianshi Shengjie, but only the female dragon would join them, and she would also bring some people from the beast races to the Glazed Heaven Domain.
Zhang Fei also offered the others to join them, but not all of them agreed due to their low cultivation levels.
They were afraid of bringing trouble to him, so they decided to train in their domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1567: Training Preparation II
paragraphs: "Why are you two back here?" Mo Zainan asked her two daughters.
Mo Anqi hugged her mother. "Mother, we haven’t been back here in over five years, especially after the changes to this Paradise Realm, so we decided to come home and accompany you for a while."
"Has our father returned, Mother?" Mo Yousha asked her.

"Your father arrived at the exit portal to this Paradise Realm four and a half years ago, but the exit was sealed, so he and his five subordinates couldn’t get out of there." Mo Anqi was surprised by that but not Mo Yousha. "My subordinates discovered the location of the exit portal four years ago, and they are there now, but none of them have succeeded in destroying the seal."
"How can the exit be sealed? Can’t my father destroy it with his high cultivation?"

"I don’t understand the reason behind the portal being sealed, but it might be related to the significant changes in this Paradise Realm. If your father could break the seal, he would be back with us now." Mo Zainan hugged them. "Let’s stop talking about your father, okay? I want to hear about your activities at the Moonlit Passion Temple for the past six years, and I want to know your progress after training there for so many years. Did you two make many friends there? Did they treat you both well?"

"Hehe," Mo Anqi giggled. "Mother, the rules at the Moonlit Passion Temple are very strict, especially regarding fighting between disciples. At first, the disciples there were a little cold toward us because of our father, but they eventually accepted our presence, and we made many friends from various races there. Unfortunately, Elder Luolan had been in seclusion with her husband for the past few years, so I learned about formation arrays from Elder Hanxue and the others. By the way, Elder Zhang offered us to go with them to the Glazed Heaven Domain, but we missed you, so we chose to return to our domain."

Mo Zainan was a little sad when her daughter mentioned Zhang Fei, mainly because he hadn’t come to see her since the last time. She also didn’t try to contact him because he was focused on his cultivation, so she would rather not disturb him. "Has his cultivation increased?"
"Elder Zhang’s cultivation is already at the 1-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm, Mother."
Mo Zainan was a little surprised by Mo Yousha’s answer, as Zhang Fei’s speed in breaking through was truly fast and absurd, but she didn’t show it on her expression.
"Have the other demon races discovered our domain, Mother?"

Mo Zainan nodded at them. "The Asura Demon Race, the Nine Nether Demon Race, and the Eternal Night Main Domain all came here a year or two ago. I’m not worried about them because Shang Zhanluo is still in seclusion, and the other two demon races are Zhang Fei’s allies. Fortunately, the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race, the Torture Demon Race, and the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon Race have not managed to locate our domain. If they find out our location and your father’s situation, they will immediately attack us, and I won’t be able to fight them because the three demon gods of the three races are much stronger than me."

Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha knew about the ambitions of Demon God Shang Zhanluo, Demon God Sha Mo, Demon God Ku Shenzu, and Demon God Qian Yan to become the ruler of all the demon races. They were relieved that three of the four demon gods hadn’t yet discovered their location; otherwise, they would have attacked their race.
Afterward, Mo Zainan took her two daughters to her room, where they talked extensively, especially about their experiences in the Moonlit Passion Sect over the past few years.
Shang Luohu stood in front of Shang Zhanluo’s seclusion room, but her expression looked worried because her husband had been there for almost six years, and he still showed no signs of coming out.
"Your soul power has become stronger, Empress."

Shang Luohu nodded to Shang Zhui. "Zhang Fei has been taking me to that domain to see my daughter every few months for the past few years, and the giant Yin-Yang Lotus has been continuously helping us improve our soul power."
"I see." Shang Zhui nodded in understanding. "Has Princess Xueli improved significantly?"

"Her cultivation has increased by one stage, but her fighting abilities have increased several times." Shang Luohu looked at him. "I don’t know how my daughter has been training with Zhang Fei all this time, but I can say that none of us can match her speed now, and the only one who can match her speed is your son."
"Isn’t that great, Empress? This way, Princess Xueli will be even more prepared to become the successor of our Asura Demon Race, and she might be able to bring us to a better situation."

Shang Luohu agreed with Shang Zhui, but there were several things that still bothered her, especially about her husband’s condition. "Zhui, I want you to keep an eye on this place and inform me if there are any changes in my husband."
"Yes, Empress." After Shang Luohu left, Shang Zhui looked at the sealed door before him. "What exactly happened to you, Emperor?"
"Why don’t you go with Zhang Fei to that domain?"

"No," Tian Huangjin answered her father with a shake of her head. "Although the situation in our domain is still safe and under control, I’m still worried about your safety. Moreover, I’ve been away for several years in seclusion, so I want to rest in our domain and accompany you for now. By the way, have Tian Qiye and the others shown any signs of movement yet?"

"Since the changes that occurred in this Paradise Realm, all the grand elders entered seclusion and have not come out until today. As for Tian Qiye, I can’t guess what she’s thinking, but she seems to be planning something in her mind."
Tian Huangjin raised an eyebrow slightly. "I’ve heard from Zhang Fei that Tian Qiye intends to attack Ye Mingran and the Eternal Night Demon Race."

"I see." Tian Yizu understood the reason behind Tian Qiye’s desire to attack the Eternal Night Demon Race. "She has an old grudge against that demon race, which dates back to before she became a grand elder. That’s why I’m not surprised that she wants to attack them, but fortunately, her subordinates haven’t managed to find the location of the Eternal Night Domain, so she won’t be able to attack them anytime soon."
"Have they discovered the locations of other domains?"

"Most of them are small human domains." Tian Yizu told her daughter about all the domains that Tian Qiye’s subordinates had managed to discover. "Since you’ve returned here, I want to see your progress after cultivating and training with Zhang Fei, so we’ll go to the training ground now."
"Haha," Tian Huangjin laughed. "Don’t regret losing to me, Father."
"Hahaha!"

In her room, Tian Yaoqin felt relieved that Tian Qiye couldn’t tell the difference between her true self and her artificial doll. Since she had been away for several years to train with Zhang Fei, she decided to stay in her domain for now.
"Grand Elder Yaoqin, our leader orders you to go see her now."
"What does she want from me?" Tian Yaoqin raised an eyebrow for a moment. "I’ll go see her now."
Tian Yaoqin immediately deactivated the artificial doll, stored it in her storage ring, and went to meet Tian Qiye.
Before long, Tian Yaoqin arrived in front of Tian Qiye. "Why did you call me, Leader?"

Tian Qiye didn’t answer Tian Yaoqin’s question directly; instead, she observed her closely because she still harbored many suspicions about her, but she couldn’t find anything unusual. "What about your cultivation? Have you approached the Celestial God Realm?"

’Phew.’ Tian Yaoqin inwardly sighed in relief. "My cultivation has made great progress in the past few years, but I’m still far from the Celestial God Realm, and it will probably take me several decades to reach it."
"Go back now and continue your cultivation."
"Yes."

Tian Qiye watched Tian Yaoqin leave with narrowed eyes. "Was my suspicion about her wrong? However, I can sense that her cultivation is progressing much faster than that of Tian Liefeng and the others, and she will be the first among them to break through to the Celestial God Realm. Unfortunately, my subordinates have not yet managed to find the location of the Eternal Night Demon Domain, so I will still have to be patient in destroying them."

In the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, Tianshi Shengjie and several beasts stood in front of Long Wuzhao and the others, listening to the messages from the dragon emperor regarding their planned departure to the Glazed Heaven Domain. "You guys can go to the Moonlit Passion Temple now, but you must be careful while in the domain, and you must not underestimate the people from the War God Pavilion. They are humans, but they are similar to the Asura Demon Race, and they possess superior physical strength and fighting abilities that surpass other humans. Moreover, they can enhance their strength by using their secret techniques, which will increase their power severalfold."
"Yes, Emperor." Tianshi Shengjie immediately led them to the portal connecting the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain with the Twin Flames Domain to go to the Moonlit Passion Temple.
"Zhang Fei has become stronger, Brother Wuzhao."

Long Wuzhao nodded to Tianshi Bailong. "Zhang Fei previously told me that he encountered something unexpected in the Ancient Desolation Domain, and he also told me that the situation in the Ancient Realm is dire."

chapters.title: Chapter 1568: Glazed Heaven Domain
paragraphs: "Something unexpected?"

"Yes," Long Wuzhao explained to Tianshi Bailong and Long Xukong the information he had previously obtained from Zhang Fei. "He still doesn’t know the origins of those shadowy creatures, but they have infested the entire Ancient Realm. Moreover, they kill weak demons and beasts, but they also take over the bodies of strong ones."
"What about the sleeping male demon?"

"Zhang Fei said that those creatures did not approach the sleeping male demon, but he himself did not know the cause." Tianshi Bailong and Long Xukong felt strange about that because the male demon was obviously powerful, but they didn’t get close to him. "Given that all domains are already far apart, we cannot investigate whether those creatures also appear in this Paradise Realm. At least, we can check our domain, so I will go to see Feng Jinhuang to discuss this matter, and I want you two to go to the other beast races to inform them of this matter."
"Alright."

Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu also received information about those shadowy creatures from Zhang Fei. They rushed to report the matter to the Fairy King, Jia Leixuan, who immediately ordered their race members to search every area of the Floral Mirage Domain.

Thereafter, the Fairy King went to meet with the leaders of the other natural races to discuss the matter. Meanwhile, Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu went to meet the Ancient Treant Spirit, Shu Yuangu. Unfortunately, he knew nothing about those shadowy creatures, so he couldn’t help them.
After they returned from that place, Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu brought several members of the Fairy Race with them, inspecting the entire Floral Mirage Domain.

In the Soul-Devouring Demon Domain, Nalan Shizhe listened to a report from her son, Nalan Huanzi. "For now, we don’t need to think about the other demon races, Huanzi. I’m sure they won’t attack us because we’re not a threat to them, and I’m certain they’ll focus their attention on the Celestial Demon Race. Moreover, we must prepare for unexpected situations because Zhang Fei just told me a serious matter, and I’m afraid they will appear in our domain."

"What kind of serious matter are you talking about, Mother? What will appear in our domain?" Nalan Shizhe immediately told Nalan Huanzi about the information she had obtained from Zhang Fei, especially regarding those shadowy creatures. "Where did they come from?"

"Zhang Fei and Empress Huo don’t have any information about the origins of those creatures yet, and he asked us to be on standby to deal with the worst possible outcome if they suddenly appear in our domain." Nalan Shizhe contacted her subordinates and ordered them to search the entire area of their domain, as she was afraid that those creatures would appear there, which would be troublesome for them. "Let’s go, Huanzi. We can’t rely on them to check all the areas, so the two of us should check too."
"Yes, Mother."

In the Nine Nether Demon Domain, Jiu Mozu and Jiu Moze stood before their subordinates, ordering the demons to inspect the entire area of their domain, especially since Zhang Fei had informed them that the shadowy creatures were extremely dangerous.

After they finished talking, Jiu Mozu and Jiu Moze left the Nine Nether Demon Palace to check out some other areas, as they didn’t want to be caught off guard if those shadowy creatures suddenly appeared out of nowhere.

After receiving Ye Mingran’s order, Ye Futian ordered several demons from the Eternal Night Demon Race to spread out throughout the area and investigate. "Does Zhang Fei know the origins of those shadowy creatures?"

"No," Ye Mingran replied with a shake of her head. "Zhang Fei and Empress Huo have already investigated the Ancient Desolation Domain, but they don’t know the origins of the creatures, and they are controlling the beasts and demons there. For now, those creatures haven’t appeared in the Paradise Realm for some reason, but it’s possible they will appear in this realm in the future, so we must increase our vigilance and check all areas daily."
"Are you going to enter into seclusion with Zhang Fei again?"

"Zhang Fei’s cultivation has already broken through to the 1-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm, so he won’t enter seclusion anytime soon." Ye Mingran got up from her chair. "Moreover, he will bring all his wives to the Glazed Heaven Domain to train, so I will stay in our domain to monitor everything."

"That kid’s cultivation is really fast; it makes me a little jealous of him." Ye Mingran laughed at Ye Futian’s expression. "In the past, it took me four or five decades to break through from the Celestial King Realm to the Celestial Emperor Realm, but he managed to do it in just a few years."

Ye Mingran nodded at him. "Honestly, I also feel jealous of him, and his cultivation speed makes me feel stupid. However, we can’t say anything about that because he’s a dual cultivator, and he has hundreds of wives by his side, including me."
"Haha! You seem to be enjoying yourself as his wife."
"I am." Ye Mingran smiled to herself, remembering all the time she had spent with Zhang Fei. "Let’s go."

Qi Qingxiu also gathered all her subordinates after she received the news from Zhang Fei, and she ordered a search of all areas of their domain—including the most remote places, as she did not want those shadowy creatures to bring trouble to their domain.
"Qingxiu."

Qi Qingxiu was stunned for a moment as she looked at the woman who suddenly appeared in front of her. She immediately got down from her throne and approached the woman. "Why did you suddenly return to this domain, Master?"
The woman is none other than the former demon god of the Seven Emotions Demon Race, Qi Qingyan. "Haha! I’m happy that you’ve finally found a man worthy of you, Qingxiu."
"Eh?" Qi Qingxiu was surprised by that. "How did you know about that, Master?"
"I know more than you think, you know? Since we haven’t seen each other for so long, I want you to accompany me, and you have to tell me everything that happened after I left."
Qi Qingxiu smiled and pulled her master into her private chamber, where they spent much time together.
"Did you find those shadowy creatures in our domain, Arbeola?"
"Are you sure that the information is correct, Demon God? All my roots have spread throughout this domain, but I haven’t found any of the shadowy creatures you mentioned."
"You’ve known Zhang Fei longer than me, right? Do you think that kid will give me wrong information?"
"No."

Wu Mian nodded at Arbeola. "Actually, Zhang Fei told me that those shadowy creatures had just appeared in the Ancient Realm, but I was worried that they would also appear in this Paradise Realm, so I asked you to look for them. "Alright, I’ll keep an eye on the entire area, and I’ll let you know if I find them in this domain."
"Thank you, Arbeola."

Nong Qinwei, Yin Chang, Dongfang Yuechan, and Lan Xuening arrived at the Moonlit Passion Temple, bringing many members of the Hidden Moon Sect.
Shortly after, Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing also arrived, bringing disciples from the Spring Zenith Sect.

"How powerful is Dugu Yuanshen?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1569: Tower of Eternity
paragraphs: In the Glazed Heaven Domain, there was only one long, vast island, but they could see layers of light of different colors on various areas of the island, each inhabited by beasts of various levels and types. The island was surrounded by a vast ocean, which was also inhabited by various levels and types of beasts.
"Tower again, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered with a soft sigh. "Why did ancient people like building towers so much? Are those towers the same as the Moon Tower and Star Tower?"

"Haha," Jian Kuang laughed as he grabbed his shoulder. "Kid, people call that tower by many names, but its real name is the Tower of Eternity, and it’s entirely different from the Star Tower and the others because it doesn’t connect us to the Three Mortal Realms. Don’t ask me where that name comes from because I don’t have clear information about it, and I found a little record about that tower in it in the past. According to that record, the tower already existed when this universe was still combined into one, but the record doesn’t mention its creator or origin."
Su Shentian also spoke to him. "The tower looks huge from the outside, but it actually only has three floors."
"A tower that huge only has three floors?" Zhang Fei was surprised by that.

"Yes," Su Shentian nodded at him. "The first floor is the Body Floor, where we will face many things related to our physical body. The second floor is the Soul Floor, where we will face many things that are useful for improving our souls. The third floor is called the Transcendent Floor, and only cultivators who have successfully passed the two floors below it can ascend to it."

Zhang Fei rubbed his chin. "All the challenges on the first floor are related to our bodies, and all the challenges on the second floor are related to our souls, huh? What’s on the third floor? Have you guys ever reached it?"
"Believe it or not, only ten people have ever reached the third floor, but they refuse to disclose its challenges."
"Only ten people?" Zhang Fei was shocked by that.

"Five of the ten people are my emperor, my father, Uncle Xukong, Empress Huo, and Tian Qiye." Zhang Fei glanced at Tianshi Shengjie. "Feng Jinhuang was at their level, but he never made it to the third floor. As for the remaining five people, three of them were the ancestors of the Divine Samsara Sect, and the other two came from the natural races."
"Who are those two people from the natural races?" Zhang Fei was more interested in them than the three ancestors of the Divine Samsara Sect.

Tianshi Shengjie created a qi screen showing the images of a man and a woman. "The man comes from the Giant Race, and his name is Ju Jushen. The woman comes from the Druid Race, and her name is Lu Wangyi."
"The Giant Race?"

"There are only ten members of the giant race in the entire Paradise Realm, and Ju Jushen is their leader." Tianshi Shengjie looked at him. "All of them live in the Floral Mirage Domain, but you have never visited them before, and you have just visited the Fairy Race."
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed wryly before turning to Yue Xuelian and the others. "Haven’t you guys passed the second floor of the tower yet?"

Yue Xuelian shook her head. "The challenges on the first and second floors aren’t as easy as you think, Zhang Fei. I was the only one who reached the second floor, but I ultimately failed because I couldn’t pass the test."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei looked at Yue Qianrou and the others, but they turned their heads away. "What about the island?"
"Can you see those layers of light?"
"Yes."

Jian Kuang explained it to him directly. "Each area is inhabited by beasts of various levels and types, and those layers of light separate all the areas, preventing powerful beasts from attacking weaker cultivators. They are different from the beasts in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain because they cannot transform into humans, and they completely rely on their beast instincts. The weakest beasts there have cultivation at the Celestial Lord Realm, and the strongest ones have cultivation at the Celestial Venerable Realm. This way, we can choose an area that suits our cultivation and strength, so we won’t die in vain because of our recklessness in challenging beasts that are much stronger than us."

"Beasts that can’t transform into humans, huh?" Zhang Fei smirked. "I think that island will be a suitable training ground for us, and I’ll also try challenging the Tower of Eternity later since the item I need is inside."
"What kind of item?"
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed at their curious expressions. "You guys will see it later after I get the item, and it will be very helpful for me in the future. So, where should we go now?"
"There." Zhuxian Sheng pointed to one area. "The entrance is in that area, and the strength of all the beasts there is below the Five Celestial Realms."
Zhang Fei looked in that direction and opened the map, but he frowned when he found countless red dots there. "All the cultivators in this domain seem hostile toward each other, huh?"

"Kid, this domain is a training ground and battleground, and our safety is paramount, so you don’t need to be surprised if they are hostile toward each other." Zhang Fei agreed with Jian Kuang. "Most of them will only attack us if we attack them first, but some of them are assholes, and they’ll pick fights with others for no apparent reason. Remember, you must protect all the demon women by your side well; otherwise, the people from the War God Pavilion will hunt them down and kill them."

"I’ve done some preparation for that, so those people won’t be able to recognize the identities of my wives’ demons." A glint of cruelty flashed through Zhang Fei’s eyes. "I don’t care who they are; I will kill them and their families if they dare to touch my wives, including those from the War God Pavilion."

Jian Kuang and the others were no longer surprised by Zhang Fei’s words, having seen his actions many times before. However, the women of the New Celestial Moon Sect, including Yue Xuelian, were shocked.
"Are you really going to kill them?" Yue Qianrou asked him.

"They can attack me as they please, but I will never allow them to attack all my wives. If they dare to do that, then death awaits them." Zhang Fei immediately led them to the location Zhuxian Sheng had previously designated. "Let’s go there now."

Soon, they arrived at the entrance, and countless cultivators were queuing to enter the first area. Zhang Fei immediately looked for an empty area free from surveillance to bring out his clones and wives.

After exiting the training space, Zhang Fei led his entourage in a line to enter the area, as it was impossible for them to train together in a large group. Jian Kuang and the others were surprised to find that all the demon women by his side no longer possessed demonic auras, making them no different from ordinary humans.
Nong Qinwei led the people from the Hidden Moon Sect.
Yue Xuelian led the people from the new Celestial Moon Sect.
Lu Shaqing and Gong Wei led the people from the Spring Zenith Sect.
Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng led the people from the Moonlit Passion Temple.

Zhang Fei divided all his wives into several groups, with Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Fei Lian, and Yao Qilin leading some of them. His five clones led their respective wives, especially since their numbers were not as large as those of his main harem.
As they queued to enter, Zhang Fei monitored everyone present to check their identities and strengths.
’Hey,’ Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow at Feng Yao’s voice. ’Did you see the man in plain white under the tree at three o’clock?’
Zhang Fei immediately looked at the person, but he was taken aback for a moment after he found out that person’s true identity. ’Wang Jingzhi? Why is she disguised as a man?’

’I don’t know why Wang Jingzhi disguised herself as a man, but I do know that she is the owner of one of the Seven Profound Treasures, specifically the Mirror of Eternity.’ Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow. ’The Mirror of Eternity has many functions, but I can’t explain them. I think you should approach her and persuade her to join you, and she will be a valuable ally for you in the future.’

’Let’s see later.’ Zhang Fei continued to check the strength of all the cultivators present because he wanted to ensure the safety of all his wives. ’Their strength and cultivation ranged from the Celestial Lord Realm to the Celestial Venerable Realm, and Wang Jingzhi was one of the strongest among them with his cultivation at the 1-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm.’
’Don’t you want to go to the Tower of Eternity?’

’Naturally, I’ll go there, but I want to check the situation on this island first to make sure it’s safe for them to train here. If it’s safe, I’ll go to the tower directly.’ Zhang Fei pondered for a moment. ’What did you find on the third floor?’
’I found a lot of things, including a stone gate.’
’A stone gate?’
’The gate connects this domain to one of the domains of the Ancient Realm, but no one can open it because it is sealed by a powerful seal.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1570: A Mysterious Voice
paragraphs: Zhang Fei was shocked to hear this. "Does the gate really connect this domain to one in the ancient realm?"

’The name of that domain is the Zhanlu Domain, which is a training ground similar to this Glazed Heaven Domain.’ Zhang Fei looked at the tower, and he became increasingly eager to go there. ’However, the situations of the two domains are stark contrasts, especially since life in that realm is much harsher. In the past, when the Ancient Realm was still prosperous, all the clans in that realm would send their younger generations to the domain to train in life-and-death situations. Time would forget those who failed or died, while those who managed to emerge alive would gain immense prestige and reputation.’
’That harsh, huh?’

’Puyang Shangren’s ancestor, Puyang Shenmi, was one of the cultivators who managed to get out of there alive. Since then, her name has been highly respected by all cultivators in the Ancient Realm, and the Puyang Clan has become one of the best clans there.’

Zhang Fei naturally remembered Puyang Shangren and his beast, the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu, and he knew that both of them were truly powerful. Back in the Forgotten Realm many years ago, the ancient beast had wiped out all the demons and evil beasts without a trace, and he did it in just one strike. ’Does that mean the Tower of Eternity also exists in the ancient realm?’

’If you successfully pass through the stone gate, you will arrive at the Tower of Eternity in the Zhanlu Domain. However, the stone gate is sealed from there, and no one can break the seal, so you won’t be able to enter that domain through it.’

’Who are you lying to? Although I don’t know the exact depth of your power, I know you can break the seal because you are one of the primordials, Shen Yuanzhi.’ Feng Yao laughed in Zhang Fei’s mind. ’Forget it! I did want to meet Old Fox’s greed and envy souls in the Ancient Realm, but I am fully aware of my strength. Moreover, the situation there is chaotic because of the appearance of those shadowy creatures, so I won’t be careless about going there.’

Wang Jingzhi leisurely sat under a tree as her eyes repeatedly observed Zhang Fei and his entourage. She felt disgusted with him when she sensed the abundant Yin Qi within his body, which came from hundreds of women.

Wang Jingzhi recognized Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, Zhuxian Sheng, Tianshi Shengjie, Yue Xuelian, and several others, but she was surprised to see that they had arrived in the domain with the entourage from the Moonlit Passion Temple and appeared to be very familiar with Zhang Fei.

"Before the change in the situation in the Paradise Realm, I heard that the sect had already transformed into a universal sect, and they were also recruiting many people. However, I didn’t expect Qing Qiu’er to successfully persuade Jian Kuang and the others to join them, and the members of the Celestial Moon Sect were also familiar with them." Wang Jingzhi looked at all the women who looked impatient and excited behind them. "That young man is such a bastard womanizer, and most of those women are his women because their Yin Qi is in their bodies, including Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling."

"What are you looking at, Big Sis?" A young man who was sitting next to Wang Jingzhi asked a question before turning his attention to Zhang Fei and the others. "Oh? Are they people from the Moonlit Passion Temple? Why are the women from the Celestial Moon Sect, Jian Kuang, and the others joining them?"

"Yusheng, you probably haven’t heard of the current Moonlit Passion Temple, and that sect is no longer a dual cultivation sect but a universal one." Wang Yusheng was surprised to hear that. "Several years before this realm change, I heard from other cultivators who attended the opening ceremony of their new sect, and I also met with their members in several domains to recruit disciples. If I’m not mistaken, the man sitting next to Jian Kuang should be Zhang Fei, and he’s the one who brought about the great changes in the sect."

Wang Yusheng narrowed his eyes as he looked at Zhang Fei. "How could that kid bring such a huge change to the sect? His cultivation is only at the 1-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm, and it hasn’t completely stabilized yet, which means he hasn’t broken through to that stage for long."

"You’re underestimating him." Wang Jingzhi continued to watch them. "Look at them carefully! Jian Kuang and Su Shentian are known for their carefree lifestyles, and they’ve never been affiliated with any faction before, but they decided to join that sect. Moreover, they’re so respectful of that kid, so he’s definitely not your average cultivator, and there’s something about him that makes them respect him."

"Hey! I’ll challenge him to a fight, Big Sis." Wang Jingzhi turned and frowned at her brother. "Why are you looking at me like that? I just want to spar with him, okay? This domain is a training ground, and we can challenge anyone, so I’ll challenge him to a spar to determine his true strength."
Wang Jingzhi sighed softly. "Up to you then."
"I’m going to see him now."
"Excuse me, are you Zhang Fei?"
Everyone looked at Wang Yusheng, including Zhang Fei. "I am. What do you want from me, Senior?"
"My name is Wang Yusheng, and I would like to challenge you to a spar."
"Hahaha," Jian Kuang laughed at that. "Hey, Yusheng! You have to be careful if you want to spar with this kid, and you will lose if you dare underestimate him."

Wang Yusheng shook his head. "Brother Kuang, you know that I never underestimate anyone, right? I always fight my opponents with full strength, as it’s my way of showing respect to them. If he is willing to spar with me, I will use my best ability to fight him."
"What do you think of that, Kid?"
"I have no problem with that." Zhang Fei looked at the line of people in front of the entrance. "It’s almost our turn to go in, so we’ll spar inside. What do you think about that, Senior Wang?"

Wang Yusheng nodded at him. "It’s much freer inside than here, so we’ll spar inside. Winning or losing is common in a fight, so I hope you will use all your fighting skills, because I don’t like fighting with half-hearted people."
’Hey! I like him.’ Zhang Fei immediately agreed to his request. "Don’t worry, Senior Wang. I never fight half-heartedly, and I will fight you with all my might."
"That’s good! We’ll meet inside." Wang Yusheng immediately returned to his sister’s side and waited for their turn to enter.

Jian Kuang grabbed Zhang Fei’s shoulder. "If you fight Wang Yusheng later, you must not give him a chance to fight back. If you give him a chance to attack you, you might lose to him. That kid is different from the cultivators you’ve faced before, and he will become stronger over time, so you must defeat him as quickly as possible once the fight begins."
"Eh?" Zhang Fei looked at him in surprise. "How can he become so much stronger in battle? Did he use some special technique?"

"He didn’t use any special technique," Zhuxian Sheng answered him. "You’ve never fought him, so you don’t know Wang Yusheng’s special qualities. He doesn’t have a special physique like me, but he was born with a special advantage. I fought him in the past, and I almost lost because I wasted too much time fighting him, which allowed him to become extremely powerful. When he reached his peak, the power of his attacks would be several times greater, and not everyone could withstand them."
Su Shentian also spoke to him. "The only way to defeat Wang Yusheng is with short-term combat and using all your strength; otherwise, you will lose to him."
Since the three men were more experienced than him, Zhang Fei did not ignore their advice, and he immediately made plans for his spar with Wang Yusheng.
Soon, it was their turn to enter, and they immediately spread out according to their original plan.
Nong Qinwei led the people from the Hidden Moon Sect.
Yue Xuelian led the people from the new Celestial Moon Sect.
Lu Shaqing and Gong Wei led the people from the Spring Zenith Sect.
Zhang Fei’s five clones immediately took all their wives to different areas.

Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng wanted to watch Zhang Fei spar with Wang Yusheng, but they abandoned their plan and led the people from the Moonlit Passion Temple to different areas so they wouldn’t encounter each other there.
"Go now! I’ll catch up with you all later."
Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Fei Lian, and Yao Qilin nodded to Zhang Fei and led his main harem members to several different areas.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei sat alone in the first area, waiting for Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi to take their turn to enter. However, he suddenly had an uneasy feeling, and a gentle voice tried to speak to him.

Zhang Fei tried to search the surrounding area for its source, but he found nothing. Soon, the voice became clearer, and a man spoke to him. ’The heir of the ten-tailed fox, I have long awaited your arrival, and you can find me on the third floor of the Tower of Eternity.’
’Who are you?’
’I will wait for you on the third floor of the Tower of Eternity, and you will know my identity when you arrive here, the heir of the ten-tailed fox.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1571: A Little Spar
paragraphs: "Who exactly is that man? Why did he ask to meet me there?" Zhang Fei wondered to himself as he looked towards the third floor of the Tower of Eternity. ’Do you know anything about that man, Feng Yao?’

However, the phoenix princess didn’t answer Zhang Fei, making him sigh softly. He wanted to go to the Tower of Eternity, but he wanted to ensure that all his wives could train safely and peacefully. Qing Qiu’er, Fei Lian, and Yao Qilin were the strongest among them, but he wasn’t confident they could protect their sisters from cultivators as powerful as them.

In the Blazing Nirvana Domain, Feng Yao stood on the balcony alone, as her eyes stared into the distance. She knew that the mysterious man was speaking to Zhang Fei, but she could not recognize his voice.
"What are you thinking, Yao’er?" Feng Jiu asked, walking behind her daughter together with her husband, Feng Tian.
"Is something bothering you, Yao’er? I know you’re stronger than us, but we are your parents, and you can share your burden with us."
Feng Yao turned to her parents. "Something happened beyond my calculations, and I feel that it will disrupt all the plans I’ve been planning for so long."
"What happened?"

Feng Yao created a qi screen and displayed the situation in the Ancient Desolation Domain, which shocked Feng Jiu and Feng Tian, especially after they saw those shadowy creatures. She pointed out to them the situation in that domain, but she had no explanation for those creatures. "They appeared out of nowhere a year ago, and they have spread throughout the entire area of the Ancient Realm."
"What are those creatures looking for in the Ancient Realm?"

"Hu Tianlang’s greed and envy souls." Feng Jiu and Feng Tian were shocked by that because they had long known that Zhang Fei needed both souls to evolve into the next ten-tailed fox. "However, I think they are not only after those two souls, but they are as well after some other things that I don’t know about yet."
"Did those creatures also appear in this Paradise Realm?"

"For now, the situation in the Paradise Realm is still safe, and all the domains are far apart from each other." Feng Yao looked at the qi screen. "While I’m not sure, it doesn’t rule out the possibility that those creatures will appear in this realm one day, and all cultivators here will face great trouble because of them."
"What can we do to stop them?"

"There’s nothing we can do for now," Feng Yao sighed. "I’ve never seen them before, and I haven’t found the source or origin of those creatures, so I don’t have a proper solution to deal with them. By the way, do you two want to go to the Glazed Heaven Domain? Your son-in-law brought everyone there to train, and you’ve been in seclusion for a long time, so—"
"Let’s go!" Feng Jiu and Feng Tian were excited.
Feng Yao smiled in amusement at their expressions, and she immediately led the two of them away from her palace towards the Glazed Heaven Domain.
After waiting for some time, Wang Jingzhi and Wang Yusheng arrived in the area, and the latter immediately approached Zhang Fei. "Eh? Why are you here alone? Where are Jian Kuang and the others?"

"We don’t have much time to waste, so I asked Senior Jian and the others to lead them to train in some other areas." Zhang Fei stole a glance at Wang Jingzhi, but she paid him no attention and walked away from them. "Can we start now?"
Wang Yusheng nodded at him. "You seem confident in your fighting abilities."

"If I didn’t have confidence in my fighting abilities, I wouldn’t have brought all my wives to train in this domain." Zhang Fei walked to a wider area, with Wang Yusheng following behind him. "Even though I’m young and my cultivation is far below yours, I’ve been training since I was very young, and I’ll give you a fierce fight."
"Haha," Wang Yusheng laughed at that. "I was hoping for just that, so you don’t need to hold back and fight me with all your might."
"Are you ready, Senior?"
"Let’s stop talking and spar."

Wang Yusheng was shocked because Zhang Fei had already moved in front of him, caught him off guard, and punched him. He tried to block his attack with one hand, causing their fists to collide and knock him back several steps. After stabilizing himself, he waved his right hand, feeling his fist go numb. ’What the hell? The power of his attack just now was clearly not that of a cultivator at the Celestial Emperor Realm.’

Wang Jingzhi, who witnessed the incident from a distance, was also shocked. She was surprised that Zhang Fei knocked her brother back several steps, even though he didn’t use any techniques and simply relied on his raw strength. ’I didn’t feel the power of his attack, but I’m sure his raw strength is already on par with or even surpasses cultivators in the Celestial Venerable Realm like us. Judging from his movements just now, his speed is also very fast, and I’m not sure I could catch up to him if he used his maximum speed.’

Unfortunately, Wang Jingzhi and Wang Yusheng were unaware that Zhang Fei was a body cultivator who had already reached the Divine Body Stage. He also mastered nine body techniques, six of which have reached the maximum level, and the remaining three have reached the middle level.

Besides, Zhang Fei was a lust demon, a heavenly fox, and a calamity dragon, which made his body and raw strength extremely powerful. He was even able to defeat two of the four Asura Guardians and draw with one of them.
"What do you think of the power of my punch just now, Senior?" Zhang Fei asked calmly.

Wang Yusheng felt his right hand was still numb. "Your attack power is truly abnormal, Zhang Fei. I’ve fought many people, including Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng in the past, but none of them could make my hand go numb like you. Are you a body cultivator?"

"Senior, body cultivation and dual cultivation are inseparable, you know?" Although he wasn’t a dual cultivator like Zhang Fei, Wang Yusheng knew that dual cultivation required a strong body. "I have hundreds of wives by my side, and I can’t possibly satisfy them if my body is weak."
"Haha," Wang Yusheng laughed at that. "I’ve never met someone who has so many wives like you! Let’s continue!"
Boom

A massive explosion erupted as Zhang Fei and Wang Yusheng’s fists collided, drawing the attention of the cultivators in the area. They immediately rushed over to watch the battle, only to see the latter being sent flying backward, leaving them in disbelief.

After stabilizing himself, Wang Yusheng dashed toward Zang Fei again. He still didn’t use his full strength because his opponent’s cultivation was several stages lower than his, so he felt it wouldn’t be appropriate to use his full strength.

This time, Zhang Fei did not physically clash with Wang Yusheng, as Jian Kuang and the others had previously reminded him that his opponent would become stronger if he continued to attack him. Instead, he used his speed and disappeared from his sight, looking for his weak point to defeat him with one decisive attack.

Wang Jingzhi, Wang Yusheng, and the cultivators gathered there tried to locate Zhang Fei. However, they couldn’t see his movements, and they also couldn’t sense his aura because he had suppressed it completely.

Wang Jingzhi took out a small mirror, which was none other than the Mirror of Eternity. She activated it to search for Zhang Fei’s location, but no image appeared, making her realize that her speed was far beyond her previous estimation. ’Unbelievable! I’m sure no cultivator can surpass his speed in this Paradise Realm.’

Wang Yusheng closed his eyes and tried to sense Zhang Fei’s movements, but he couldn’t feel anything, as if he were moving as one with the air. ’I think I’ve found the right opponent for me to further develop myself.’
Wang Yusheng was stunned for a moment when Zhang Fei suddenly appeared in front of him, and he hurriedly jumped away to dodge his attack.

Zhang Fei did not let Wang Yusheng escape, and he grabbed his leg before throwing him towards a large tree. He immediately moved on top of him and punched his chest, causing him to hit the ground with a loud bang.
"Cough... Cough..." Wang Yusheng coughed hard as he clutched his chest, and Zhang Fei’s punch just now caused him quite a bit of difficulty breathing. "Damn it! Your blow was so heavy and painful."
Zhang Fei stood in front of him with a smile. "Honestly, I used all my strength in that punch just now, but you still managed to withstand it."

Zhang Fei naturally wouldn’t tell Wang Yusheng the truth that he had only used a few percent of his strength, especially with so many cultivators watching. If he had used his full strength like when he fought the four Asura Guardians a few years ago, he would have been able to knock his opponent out or even kill him, as he wasn’t as powerful as the four demons.

"Phew." Wang Yusheng sighed and stood up, but he still clutched his chest due to the intense pain. "I didn’t expect to meet a young cultivator as skilled as you today. Even though I didn’t use my cultivation or anything else, I still have to admit that you’re superior to me in many aspects, especially your speed."
