Wang Yusheng felt his right hand was still numb.
"Your attack power is truly abnormal, Zhang Fei.
I’ve fought many people, including Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng in the past, but none of them could make my hand go numb like you.
Are you a body cultivator?"
"Senior, body cultivation and dual cultivation are inseparable, you know?" Although he wasn’t a dual cultivator like Zhang Fei, Wang Yusheng knew that dual cultivation required a strong body.
"I have hundreds of wives by my side, and I can’t possibly satisfy them if my body is weak."
"Haha," Wang Yusheng laughed at that.
"I’ve never met someone who has so many wives like you!
Let’s continue!"
Boom
A massive explosion erupted as Zhang Fei and Wang Yusheng’s fists collided, drawing the attention of the cultivators in the area.
They immediately rushed over to watch the battle, only to see the latter being sent flying backward, leaving them in disbelief.
After stabilizing himself, Wang Yusheng dashed toward Zang Fei again.
He still didn’t use his full strength because his opponent’s cultivation was several stages lower than his, so he felt it wouldn’t be appropriate to use his full strength.
This time, Zhang Fei did not physically clash with Wang Yusheng, as Jian Kuang and the others had previously reminded him that his opponent would become stronger if he continued to attack him.
Instead, he used his speed and disappeared from his sight, looking for his weak point to defeat him with one decisive attack.
Wang Jingzhi, Wang Yusheng, and the cultivators gathered there tried to locate Zhang Fei.
However, they couldn’t see his movements, and they also couldn’t sense his aura because he had suppressed it completely.
Wang Jingzhi took out a small mirror, which was none other than the Mirror of Eternity.
She activated it to search for Zhang Fei’s location, but no image appeared, making her realize that her speed was far beyond her previous estimation. ’Unbelievable!
I’m sure no cultivator can surpass his speed in this Paradise Realm.’

Wang Yusheng closed his eyes and tried to sense Zhang Fei’s movements, but he couldn’t feel anything, as if he were moving as one with the air. ’I think I’ve found the right opponent for me to further develop myself.’
Wang Yusheng was stunned for a moment when Zhang Fei suddenly appeared in front of him, and he hurriedly jumped away to dodge his attack.
Zhang Fei did not let Wang Yusheng escape, and he grabbed his leg before throwing him towards a large tree.
He immediately moved on top of him and punched his chest, causing him to hit the ground with a loud bang.
"Cough...
Cough..." Wang Yusheng coughed hard as he clutched his chest, and Zhang Fei’s punch just now caused him quite a bit of difficulty breathing.
"Damn it!
Your blow was so heavy and painful."
Zhang Fei stood in front of him with a smile.
"Honestly, I used all my strength in that punch just now, but you still managed to withstand it."
Zhang Fei naturally wouldn’t tell Wang Yusheng the truth that he had only used a few percent of his strength, especially with so many cultivators watching.

If he had used his full strength like when he fought the four Asura Guardians a few years ago, he would have been able to knock his opponent out or even kill him, as he wasn’t as powerful as the four demons.
"Phew." Wang Yusheng sighed and stood up, but he still clutched his chest due to the intense pain.
"I didn’t expect to meet a young cultivator as skilled as you today.
Even though I didn’t use my cultivation or anything else, I still have to admit that you’re superior to me in many aspects, especially your speed."

chapters.title: Chapter 1572: The Challenges
paragraphs: "Strength is important, but speed is also important." Zhang Fei clenched his fists. "If our speed is slow, we will struggle to defeat enemies with high speed, regardless of our strength. Even if we have high speed, we will not be able to defeat the enemy if our strength is too low. Therefore, we must always balance the two, and we must use our brains to find the enemy’s weaknesses before attacking."
"Did Jian Kuang and the others tell you about me?"
Zhang Fei nodded smilingly. "They told me about your advantages, so I didn’t want to waste time fighting you; otherwise, I would have lost to you."

"Sigh." Wang Yusheng sighed heavily. "My advantage is indeed frightening, but I can’t always rely on it, so I continue to improve myself by fighting many enemies. If I rely solely on that, I will die if I encounter an aggressive enemy with superior strength."

"That’s why I learned a lot of things to survive, so my enemies won’t be able to predict my every move." Zhang Fei looked towards the Tower of Eternity. "By the way, did you two come here to challenge the Tower, Senior?"

Wang Yusheng also looked towards the tower. "If you want to improve your fighting skills, you can fight all the beasts in this forest. If you want to strengthen your body and soul, you should go to the tower and undergo all the challenges there, which are beneficial for both. I have challenged the tower thousands of times, but I haven’t been able to climb to the third floor because I couldn’t pass the final challenge on the second floor."
"Can you tell me about all the challenges on the first and second floors?"
"Yusheng!"
Wang Yusheng looked at Wang Jingzhi, who had already walked away. "Come join us; I will tell you about all the challenges."
"Alright."
The two immediately followed behind Wang Jingzhi. "On the first floor, we will face many challenges, such as gravity, extreme pressure, extreme weather, and many more."
"How heavy is gravity there?"

"Hmm? If I remember correctly, the gravity there is only about twenty times heavier at maximum. The challenges there are random, so we can’t predict when they will appear." Zhang Fei was disappointed to hear that because it was too light for him. "For some people, twenty times gravity is too heavy, and it becomes even more difficult when combined with extreme pressure, and it took me dozens of times challenging the tower to pass it."
"So, several challenges can come out at once, huh?"

"Yes," Wang Yusheng nodded at him. "Normally, only one or two challenges will appear at a time, but we can’t predict the situation inside the tower. Last time I challenged the tower, four challenges appeared at once, and I almost died from that."
"Oh? What are the four challenges?"
"Ten times gravity, extreme pressure, extreme weather, and extreme places."
"Extreme places?"
"At that time, I was faced with an extremely hot desert, which made my body lose a lot of fluids."
"That hot?" Zhang Fei was shocked.
"Extremely hot! Even our drinking water will evaporate faster, so we have to move really fast if we want to drink and store it again."
"Besides that?"

Wang Yusheng looked at Wang Jingzhi in front of them. "In the past, my sister encountered a labyrinth teeming with numerous creatures, yet it was also brimming with valuable items. She found her mirror there, but she didn’t get through it easily, and she suffered serious injuries to complete it, forcing her to rest for several years."
"Eh? Are those creatures powerful?"

"They are extremely powerful," Wang Yusheng replied with a nod. "In fact, hundreds or even thousands of people have died when facing those challenges, so you must be careful when you enter that tower. I advise you not to bring your women with minimal fighting experience there, or they will throw away their lives for nothing. If you want them to train there, you must bring those with real experience in fighting and survival."
"Do other cultivators often cause trouble there?"

"Most only care about those challenges, but some ignore them and attack other cultivators." Wang Yusheng looked around before continuing. "Fortunately, this Paradise Realm has changed, and there are no demons present. Usually, they are the ones who cause trouble by attacking other cultivators, especially the demons of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race and the Torture Demon Race. The demons of both races are extremely cruel, especially the latter, and many members of other races died at their hands in the past."
"The Heavenly Fiend Demon Race and the Torture Demon Race, huh?" Zhang Fei himself was curious about the demons of both races. "What about the challenges on the second floor, Senior?"

"Haish." Wang Yusheng let out a heavy sigh as he patted his shoulder. "All the challenges on the second floor are extremely dangerous, especially for those with weak soul power. Believe it or not, many cultivators have fallen victim to all the challenges on the second floor. Many of them died there, and several others became like soulless puppets."
"Challenges that can destroy the soul, huh?"

"Are all your wives soul cultivators with high soul cultivation levels? If their soul power is weak, they should not force themselves to go to the second floor; otherwise, they will die or become soulless puppets."
"Although most of their cultivation is still at the Celestial King Realm, their soul power is much higher than their cultivation."

"If their soul cultivation reaches the saint soul level, they can go to the second floor to try those challenges. However, they must first pass all the challenges on the first floor, and you cannot assist them in doing so."

"I see." Zhang Fei wasn’t worried about the challenges on the second floor because all his wives had very high soul cultivations, but he was worried that they wouldn’t be able to pass the challenges on the first floor. "Are you two going straight to the tower?"
"We came here specifically to challenge the tower, and we hope to reach the third floor this time."

Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "In that case, we’ll meet there later, Senior. For now, I need to go meet with them to ensure that the other cultivators won’t disturb or attack them, and I’ll go to the tower afterward."
"Alright," Wang Yusheng sighed after Zhang Fei disappeared and immediately followed his sister, who was far ahead. "What do you think of him, Big Sis?"

"A playboy and a pervert." Wang Jingzhi’s answer made Wang Yusheng smile bitterly. "I have to admit that he’s an extraordinary cultivator, especially his speed. I feel that he wasn’t using his full speed when he sparred with you earlier, as my mirror couldn’t track his movements, and his speed was likely several times higher."
"Do you know how heavy his punch is, Big Sis?"
"Hmm?"

"His punching power is much heavier than our uncle’s." Wang Jingzhi looked at him straight away. "I didn’t lie to you, Big Sis. His punch seemed light, but my hand is still numb now, and he could crush my hand bones if he used all his strength. He said that he had already used all his strength, but I’m sure he saved some of his strength because many other cultivators were here."
Wang Jingzhi nodded in understanding. "If that’s true, the Moonlit Passion Temple is truly fortunate to have him, and the sect will become even greater than the Divine Samsara Sect in the future."
"Speaking of the Divine Samsara Sect, several of their top disciples are on their way to this domain, and they should arrive soon."
"Where did you get this news?"
"Our cousin, Wang Tieshan." Wang Jingzhi’s expression turned ugly upon hearing that name. "Do you still hate him, Big Sis?"

"Don’t you hate him?" Wang Yusheng shuddered as the hair on the back of his neck stood up at his big sister’s cold tone. "Wang Tieshan was the cause of our parents’ deaths, but he forgot their sacrifice, and he looked down on our Wang Clan after he joined the Divine Samsara Sect."

Wang Yusheng inwardly sighed. "Our cousin used to be so kind, and our parents sacrificed their lives for him. Unfortunately, he changed after he joined the Divine Samsara Sect, and he became even more arrogant after he became Liang Huizhong’s direct disciple."
"I wanted to kill him, but the people from that sect would attack our clan, so I always held back."
"I know." After that, the two of them accelerated their steps towards the Tower of Eternity.
"What do you think about Wang Yusheng?" Jian Kuang asked as Zhang Fei appeared by his side.
"He’s not bad, and I like his character. Luckily, you all told me about his advantages, so I ended our spar early."

"Hahaha," Jian Kuang laughed. "Wang Yusheng is a good person, and he is willing to help others in need. However, Wang Jingzhi is different from him, and she is very cold. She doesn’t like interfering in other people’s affairs, and she won’t move even if she sees people in danger."
"Isn’t that much better? If we’re too nice, others will stab us in the back, and we’ll be the ones who suffer, right?"
"Yeah," Jian Kuang nodded. "Wang Jingzhi has a grudge against the Divine Samsara Sect, especially her cousin, Wang Tieshan."

"What happened between them?" Jian Kuang immediately told Zhang Fei about their problems based on his knowledge. "Only a fool would abandon his family for a sect, especially since his family has helped and sacrificed so much for him."
"Are you going into the Tower of Eternity now? We can protect all your wives, so you don’t have to worry about their safety."
"I’ll check on them first, and then I’ll bring some of them to the tower."

chapters.title: Chapter 1573: Divine Samsara Sect’s Members
paragraphs: Zhang Fei inspected all the members of his main harem who had begun fighting beasts at the Celestial Lord Realm in several groups. They were escorted and protected by Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Fei Lian, and Yao Qilin.

Zhang Fei decided to summon all the beasts in his beast space so they could train and improve themselves. He asked Sha Huoyan, the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant, and Shou Yunzhi, the Sunfire Emperor Behemoth, to escort them because the two female beasts were the strongest among them.

[Are you going to the Tower of Eternity now, Master? They’re not facing any problems right now, and the beasts in this area are weaker than them. Moreover, your five clones are also in this area, and there are no cultivators with cultivation higher than the Celestial Lord Realm in this area, so I think they’ll be fine.]

Zhang Fei thought for a moment before he brought his third, fourth, and fifth clones to the side of some of his wives, especially those who came from Earth, the Sky Jade Realm, and the Nine Stars Realm.

"What are your plans now? Do you want to go to the Tower of Eternity?" Tianshi Shengjie asked as she landed beside Zhang Fei. "If you’re worried about all your wives’ safety, I can order my group to protect them. The majority of them have reached the 3-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm, so they can protect the others well. Moreover, there are still Tian Houtian and Tian Zhiling; I’m sure those two will also protect them."

"I do want to go to the tower, and I’ll be bringing some of them with me. Although my five clones are in this area and can protect them, I want your group members to keep an eye on them, but they should only move if they’re in danger."
"Who among them will you take to the tower?"

"I wanted to bring them all to the tower, but I don’t think they’re ready for that yet. Thus, I’ll take Luo Yunxiao, Helian Xun’er, and Nalan Wangzi. As for the others, they can train in this area for now. They can go to the area with beasts at the Celestial King Realm after they’ve adapted to their new strength." Zhang Fei looked at her. "Do you want to join us?"
"The last time I challenged the tower, I failed on the second floor, and I want to reach the third floor this time."
Thud
They looked at Feng Yao and her parents, who had just arrived. "Did you bring them here to train?"

"Yeah," Feng Yao raised her right hand, and countless small crimson flames shot out from her fingers, entering the bodies of all of Zhang Fei’s wives. "This way, you don’t have to worry about them, right? If anyone attacks them, my crimson flames will protect them, so no one can harm them."
Feng Jiu moved beside Zhang Fei. "Son, your father-in-law and I can also protect them, so you don’t need to worry about them and go to the tower."

"We’ve been cultivating for so long since Yao’er brought us here, so we’ll stretch our muscles by fighting the beasts in this area." Feng Tian looked at the beasts in the area below them. "Moreover, we are the phoenixes, and they are ordinary beasts, so I’m sure we can help you to protect them."

Zhang Fei wasn’t worried about those beasts because some of his wives were mythical beasts, so he was confident they could handle them. He was only worried that other cultivators would attack them, but he believed that Feng Yao could protect them, even though she was in a faraway location.

"I’ll call some of them now, and we’ll go straight to the tower." Soon, Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Luo Yunxiao, Helian Xun’er, and Nalan Wangzi had already arrived beside Zhang Fei. At first, he didn’t think about bringing the two women first, but he changed his mind after Feng Yao’s arrival. "We will go to the tower now."
"I know Feng Yao can protect them, but I think Feiling and I should stay here." You Feiling agreed with Qing Qiu’er.
"Have you two ever challenged the tower before?"
You Feiling pointed at Qing Qiu’er. "Big Sis once reached the second floor, but she ultimately failed. As for me, I got stuck on the first floor, and I never challenged the tower again since."

"In that case, you two should come with us, and Feng Yao will protect them. After they adapt to their new strengths, I will take them to the tower." Zhang Fei tilted his head to face Feng Yao. "Do you think I can open my training space there?"

"There are no space restrictions inside the tower, so you can do that." Feng Yao pointed to the barrier leading to the next area. "To reach the tower, we have to pass through all the areas ahead. Those areas are inhabited by beasts with cultivation levels higher than the Celestial Lord Realm, and there are also countless powerful cultivators there, so you can take them to the tower using that method."
"Let’s move now."

They suddenly heard a commotion from the entrance of the area where people from the Divine Samsara Sect had just arrived. They arrived in large numbers, led by their vice sect master and several elders.
Zhang Fei recognized one of the sect elders, who was none other than Yu Shan, the old man who had guided him when he first arrived at the sect.

"Did you see that man?" Feng Yao pointed to the man behind the vice sect master, Li Guangyu. "He is Wang Jingzhi and Wang Yusheng’s cousin, Wang Tieshan, and he is also a direct disciple of Liang Huizhong."

Zhang Fei watched Wang Tieshan from afar. "His cultivation is already at the 2-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, huh? As long as he doesn’t look for trouble with us, we don’t need to care about him. On the contrary, if he looks for trouble with us, I will fight him and kill him."
"Haha," Feng Yao softly laughed.

Zhang Fei remembered Yue Xuelian and the others who had gone deeper into the area. He contacted her and informed her of the presence of the people from the Divine Samsara Sect so they could be on guard against them, as the people from the sect continued to search for them. "Let’s go now."
After Zhang Fei and the others left for the next area, Feng Tian and Feng Jiu immediately went to another area to begin their training.

In the outer area, Li Guangyu was giving instructions to the disciples of the Divine Samsara Sect, and he also divided them into several groups, each led by an elder. "Are you confident you can reach the third floor this time, Wang Tieshan?"
"My master has provided me with some supplies, but I’m still not confident, Vice Sect Master."

Li Guangyu could understand Wang Tieshan’s concerns, as none of their sect members, including him, had yet to reach the third floor. So far, only three of their sect’s several ancestors have reached it, but they kept all information about it under wraps, requiring them to see for themselves once they reached it.
"Even though I’m uncertain of my chances of reaching the third floor, I will try my best to reach it, Vice Sect Master."
Li Guangyu nodded to him. "At first, your master also wanted to challenge the tower, but our ancestors assigned him to take care of other things."
"I know."

"The changes in the Paradise Realm are truly difficult for us." A female elder said, "Several years have passed since the change, but we still haven’t found the location of the sects directly affiliated with our sect, one of which is the Celestial Moon Sect."
"What did our ancestors say to you before, Yue Minglan?" A male elder asked her.

"Qiu Han, our ancestors thought that Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou might have already discovered this realm, so they asked me to come here to look for them." Yue Minglan looked towards the tower. "If they were indeed in this domain, I’m sure they wouldn’t waste time training in the forests, and they would definitely head straight there."

Qiu Han agreed with her. "Yue Xuelian is one of the strongest human cultivators, so there’s no point in her spending time in these forests. Moreover, she once reached the second floor of the tower, right? So, I’m sure she’ll take them there, and we’ll meet them if they’re in this domain."
"Yeah."

"We should go in now, but we don’t need to waste time with those beasts, and we should go straight to the location of the tower." They agreed with Li Guangyu, and the elders immediately led their group members by spreading out.
Li Guangyu led Wang Tieshan and several others, and he released his aura to keep the beasts away from them.
"It seems many people have discovered the location of this domain, Vice Sect Master. Otherwise, this first area wouldn’t be this crowded, right?"

"Yes." Li Guangyu observed all the cultivators they passed. "Most of their cultivations are still at the Celestial Lord Realm, and many of them have just broken through to the Celestial King Realm. They probably want to use these beasts as opponents to stabilize their cultivation."

"Look over there, Vice Sect Master." A female disciple pointed in one direction, where several women were fighting with beasts. "Those women are still young, but their cultivation has broken through to the Celestial King Realm. Their fighting ability and speed are also on par with cultivators several realms above them."
Li Guangyu looked at the women. "You’re right, Hua Liuying. Let’s try talking to them, and I’ll persuade them to join our sect."

They were escorted and protected by Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Fei Lian, and Yao Qilin.
Zhang Fei decided to summon all the beasts in his beast space so they could train and improve themselves.
He asked Sha Huoyan, the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant, and Shou Yunzhi, the Sunfire Emperor Behemoth, to escort them because the two female beasts were the strongest among them.
[Are you going to the Tower of Eternity now, Master?
They’re not facing any problems right now, and the beasts in this area are weaker than them.
Moreover, your five clones are also in this area, and there are no cultivators with cultivation higher than the Celestial Lord Realm in this area, so I think they’ll be fine.]

Zhang Fei thought for a moment before he brought his third, fourth, and fifth clones to the side of some of his wives, especially those who came from Earth, the Sky Jade Realm, and the Nine Stars Realm.
"What are your plans now?
Do you want to go to the Tower of Eternity?" Tianshi Shengjie asked as she landed beside Zhang Fei.
"If you’re worried about all your wives’ safety, I can order my group to protect them.
The majority of them have reached the 3-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm, so they can protect the others well.
Moreover, there are still Tian Houtian and Tian Zhiling; I’m sure those two will also protect them."
"I do want to go to the tower, and I’ll be bringing some of them with me.
Although my five clones are in this area and can protect them, I want your group members to keep an eye on them, but they should only move if they’re in danger."
"Who among them will you take to the tower?"
"I wanted to bring them all to the tower, but I don’t think they’re ready for that yet.
Thus, I’ll take Luo Yunxiao, Helian Xun’er, and Nalan Wangzi.
As for the others, they can train in this area for now.
They can go to the area with beasts at the Celestial King Realm after they’ve adapted to their new strength." Zhang Fei looked at her.
"Do you want to join us?"
"The last time I challenged the tower, I failed on the second floor, and I want to reach the third floor this time."
Thud
They looked at Feng Yao and her parents, who had just arrived.
"Did you bring them here to train?"
"Yeah," Feng Yao raised her right hand, and countless small crimson flames shot out from her fingers, entering the bodies of all of Zhang Fei’s wives.
"This way, you don’t have to worry about them, right?
If anyone attacks them, my crimson flames will protect them, so no one can harm them."
Feng Jiu moved beside Zhang Fei.
"Son, your father-in-law and I can also protect them, so you don’t need to worry about them and go to the tower."
"We’ve been cultivating for so long since Yao’er brought us here, so we’ll stretch our muscles by fighting the beasts in this area." Feng Tian looked at the beasts in the area below them.
"Moreover, we are the phoenixes, and they are ordinary beasts, so I’m sure we can help you to protect them."
Zhang Fei wasn’t worried about those beasts because some of his wives were mythical beasts, so he was confident they could handle them.
He was only worried that other cultivators would attack them, but he believed that Feng Yao could protect them, even though she was in a faraway location.
"I’ll call some of them now, and we’ll go straight to the tower." Soon, Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Luo Yunxiao, Helian Xun’er, and Nalan Wangzi had already arrived beside Zhang Fei.
At first, he didn’t think about bringing the two women first, but he changed his mind after Feng Yao’s arrival.
"We will go to the tower now."
"I know Feng Yao can protect them, but I think Feiling and I should stay here." You Feiling agreed with Qing Qiu’er.
"Have you two ever challenged the tower before?"
You Feiling pointed at Qing Qiu’er.
"Big Sis once reached the second floor, but she ultimately failed.
As for me, I got stuck on the first floor, and I never challenged the tower again since."
"In that case, you two should come with us, and Feng Yao will protect them.
After they adapt to their new strengths, I will take them to the tower." Zhang Fei tilted his head to face Feng Yao.
"Do you think I can open my training space there?"
"There are no space restrictions inside the tower, so you can do that." Feng Yao pointed to the barrier leading to the next area.
"To reach the tower, we have to pass through all the areas ahead.

Those areas are inhabited by beasts with cultivation levels higher than the Celestial Lord Realm, and there are also countless powerful cultivators there, so you can take them to the tower using that method."
"Let’s move now."
They suddenly heard a commotion from the entrance of the area where people from the Divine Samsara Sect had just arrived.
They arrived in large numbers, led by their vice sect master and several elders.
Zhang Fei recognized one of the sect elders, who was none other than Yu Shan, the old man who had guided him when he first arrived at the sect.
"Did you see that man?" Feng Yao pointed to the man behind the vice sect master, Li Guangyu.
"He is Wang Jingzhi and Wang Yusheng’s cousin, Wang Tieshan, and he is also a direct disciple of Liang Huizhong."
Zhang Fei watched Wang Tieshan from afar.
"His cultivation is already at the 2-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, huh?
As long as he doesn’t look for trouble with us, we don’t need to care about him.
On the contrary, if he looks for trouble with us, I will fight him and kill him."
"Haha," Feng Yao softly laughed.
Zhang Fei remembered Yue Xuelian and the others who had gone deeper into the area.
He contacted her and informed her of the presence of the people from the Divine Samsara Sect so they could be on guard against them, as the people from the sect continued to search for them.
"Let’s go now."
After Zhang Fei and the others left for the next area, Feng Tian and Feng Jiu immediately went to another area to begin their training.
In the outer area, Li Guangyu was giving instructions to the disciples of the Divine Samsara Sect, and he also divided them into several groups, each led by an elder.
"Are you confident you can reach the third floor this time, Wang Tieshan?"
"My master has provided me with some supplies, but I’m still not confident, Vice Sect Master."
Li Guangyu could understand Wang Tieshan’s concerns, as none of their sect members, including him, had yet to reach the third floor.
So far, only three of their sect’s several ancestors have reached it, but they kept all information about it under wraps, requiring them to see for themselves once they reached it.
"Even though I’m uncertain of my chances of reaching the third floor, I will try my best to reach it, Vice Sect Master."
Li Guangyu nodded to him.
"At first, your master also wanted to challenge the tower, but our ancestors assigned him to take care of other things."
"I know."

"The changes in the Paradise Realm are truly difficult for us." A female elder said, "Several years have passed since the change, but we still haven’t found the location of the sects directly affiliated with our sect, one of which is the Celestial Moon Sect."
"What did our ancestors say to you before, Yue Minglan?" A male elder asked her.
"Qiu Han, our ancestors thought that Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou might have already discovered this realm, so they asked me to come here to look for them." Yue Minglan looked towards the tower.
"If they were indeed in this domain, I’m sure they wouldn’t waste time training in the forests, and they would definitely head straight there."
Qiu Han agreed with her.
"Yue Xuelian is one of the strongest human cultivators, so there’s no point in her spending time in these forests.
Moreover, she once reached the second floor of the tower, right?
So, I’m sure she’ll take them there, and we’ll meet them if they’re in this domain."
"Yeah."

"We should go in now, but we don’t need to waste time with those beasts, and we should go straight to the location of the tower." They agreed with Li Guangyu, and the elders immediately led their group members by spreading out.
Li Guangyu led Wang Tieshan and several others, and he released his aura to keep the beasts away from them.
"It seems many people have discovered the location of this domain, Vice Sect Master.
Otherwise, this first area wouldn’t be this crowded, right?"
"Yes." Li Guangyu observed all the cultivators they passed.
"Most of their cultivations are still at the Celestial Lord Realm, and many of them have just broken through to the Celestial King Realm.
They probably want to use these beasts as opponents to stabilize their cultivation."
"Look over there, Vice Sect Master." A female disciple pointed in one direction, where several women were fighting with beasts.
"Those women are still young, but their cultivation has broken through to the Celestial King Realm.
Their fighting ability and speed are also on par with cultivators several realms above them."
Li Guangyu looked at the women.
"You’re right, Hua Liuying.
Let’s try talking to them, and I’ll persuade them to join our sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 1574: Rejection
paragraphs: Li Guangyu and the disciples had already arrived at the women’s location, forcing them to stop fighting as the beasts fled due to his aura. "Excuse me, can I talk to you guys?"

The women’s beauty captivated Wang Tieshan and several male disciples, but they were disappointed after realizing they were no longer virgins. Some men, like Zhang Fei, never care about virginity. However, many of them considered it important, and women who were no longer virgins were secondhand goods in their eyes.
The female disciples, like Hua Liuying, don’t care about that, but they are jealous of the beauty of the women in front of them.
"What do you want from us, Senior?" Zhang Chen asked him.

Li Guangyu introduced himself to them first, but Zhang Chen and the others weren’t surprised by his identity because Zhang Fei had already told them about him. "Have you guys joined a sect? You’re still young, but your cultivation has already reached the Celestial King Realm. I can see that your fighting ability and speed are also on par with cultivators several realms above you, so I’d like to offer you to join our sect."
"We already joined the Moonlit Passion Temple seven years ago, and we will never join another sect." Zhang Lin casually answered him.

Li Guangyu was taken aback because of Zhang Lin’s answer, and he realized that they had the same Yang Qi in their bodies, but he couldn’t recognize that the Yang Qi in their bodies belonged to Zhang Fei. "Our sect—"

"Please forgive us, Senior." Li Guangyu looked at Qing Yi, who interrupted him. "We know that the Divine Samsara Sect is the largest human sect in the Paradise Realm, but we will never leave our sect to join yours. We are dual cultivators, and our partner is a member of our sect. Although your sect could give us more opportunities, we will remain in our sect with our partner."

Zhang Yue didn’t say anything, and she turned her face to the side as the male disciples watched her. ’Humph! Your cultivation is high, but you’re no match for Fei’er! All of you better not think anything of us, or you’ll die by his hands.’

"Don’t you want to think about it first?" Li Guangyu didn’t want to give up so easily, as it was difficult to find young disciples with such high cultivation levels, especially after the major changes that had occurred in the Paradise Realm. "I know the Moonlit Passion Sect has changed over the past few years, but they’re still not on the same level as my Divine Samsara Sect, and we can provide you with far better cultivation resources."
Zhang Chen, Qing Yi, and Zhang Lin shook their heads at him. "We will forever be disciples of the Moonlit Passion Temple, Senior."
"I see." Li Guangyu sighed in disappointment. "If that’s the case, I won’t bother you guys anymore, and we will continue our journey."
Zhang Chen, Qing Yi, Zhang Lin, and Zhang Yue watched them leave. They saw the male disciples glancing at them repeatedly, mainly because of their beauty.
"Do you think he’ll do something to force us to join his sect, Mother?"

"Let’s ignore them, Grandma." Zhang Yu walked away. "If they dare to do anything negative towards us and the other sisters, Fei’er will move to stop them. For now, we just need to focus on our training, and I want to catch up with him at the tower soon."

"Hehe," Zhang Lin laughed and followed her big sister. "Hey, Big Sis! You’ve changed now, you know? When you first became a cultivator, you were reluctant to kill those beasts, but now you kill them mercilessly."
"Fei’er has always protected and helped us, but I don’t want to continue being a burden to him, so I have to improve myself again to fight by his side."
"Me too."
Zhang Chen and Qing Yi smiled listening to the two, and they immediately followed them to fight with the beasts again.
Along the way, they met almost all of Zhang Fei’s women, and they immediately rejected Li Guangyu’s offer to join the Divine Samsara Sect.
Li Guangyu was disappointed by their rejection, but he was shocked because all the women possessed the same Yang Qi within their bodies, meaning they belonged to the same man.
"Who exactly is the man who is their partner? How can that man have so many beautiful women like them?" None of them knew the answer because they had never met Zhang Fei before.

They saw another group of women, but Li Guangyu preferred to avoid them because they were led by Fei Lian and Yao Qilin, who were just as powerful as him. He noticed that they belonged to the same man as the previous women, but he didn’t expect that the man had two powerful women by his side.

’Since when did those two women join the Moonlit Passion Temple? I’ve heard that Jian Kuang and a few others joined the sect, but I’ve never received any information about those two women.’ Li Guangyu considered the sect’s total strength, given the presence of those powerful cultivators. ’I must convey this matter to my sect master so he can order the others to search for that sect as soon as possible. If we let that sect continue to develop, they might reach our level one day, which would bring trouble for us.’

"Hey, Guangyu!" Li Guangyu and all the disciples immediately stopped and turned toward the voice, where they saw Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng sitting leisurely on a large tree branch. "You should stop trying to persuade the people from the Moonlit Passion Temple to join your sect."
"The three of us are elders of the Moonlit Passion Temple now, so we won’t allow you to disturb our sect," Su Shentian spoke.
Zhuxian Sheng looked at the disciples behind Li Guangyu. "You guys should forget about all the female disciples from our sect, especially those you met when you first entered."
"Hmm?" Wang Tieshan and the male disciples frowned, but none of them dared to argue because Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng were much stronger than them.

"Haha," Li Guangyu laughed at that. "They are talented and highly gifted young cultivators, so it’s natural that I would want to recruit them, right? Moreover, they’ve already rejected me, so I won’t bother them any further. However, I’m curious about the man who is their partner, and I hope the three of you can enlighten me on that."

Jian Kuang jumped down in front of him. "If you were to speak to anyone else, they might believe you. However, I’m different from them, and I know the character of the higher-ups of the Divine Samsara Sect, so I will never believe you. As for the identity of the man who is their partner, I won’t tell you about it, but I can tell you that he is powerful."
"Hmm?"
"You may not believe Old Jian, but he’s telling you the truth. The three of us have sparred with him too many times, but we’ve never managed to defeat him."
Li Guangyu looked at Su Shentian in disbelief because he, Jian Kuang, and Zhuxian Sheng possessed high abilities. "Is that man in this domain?"
"There." Zhuxian Sheng pointed towards the tower. "He’s on his way to the tower, and you might meet him later."
Li Guangyu nodded in understanding. "In that case, we won’t waste our time here, and we’ll continue our journey to the tower. Aren’t you three going to challenge the tower this time?"
"Our duty is to protect all members of our sect, so we will not go there until they are ready."
"We will leave now." Li Guangyu immediately led the disciples to continue their journey, and he also contacted all the elders to warn them not to approach the people from the Moonlit Passion Temple.
"Do you think they will look for trouble with Zhang Fei?"

Jian Kuang shrugged his shoulders. "Before his cultivation broke through to the Celestial Emperor Realm, Zhang Fei’s strength was already extremely high, and we never managed to defeat him in a spar. He’s broken through to that stage now, and I’m sure his strength has increased significantly."
"Moreover, that kid was quite cruel, and he would never allow them to disturb his wives. If they did, he would probably kill them, and the Divine Samsara Sect would lose many cultivators."
"Yeah," Jian Kuang nodded. "For now, we just need to focus on protecting them, and we’ll leave those people’s affairs to that kid."
Deep in the forest, Yue Xuelian led her sect members at high speed. "Li Guangyu and the others are in this area, so we have to avoid them."
"Even if we can avoid them now, we’ll still encounter them inside the tower, Big Sis."

Yue Xuelian nodded slightly. "We will definitely encounter them in the tower, but those challenges will keep them busy. I hope you all can pass the challenges on the first floor this time, and I will try to pass the challenges on the second floor to get to the third floor."
Yue Qianrou and the elders sighed upon hearing that, and they had no confidence that they would make it through all the challenges on the first floor.

"Why are you all sighing?" Yue Xuelian and the others turned to Zhang Fei and the women. "You should have more confidence in your abilities, and you must do your best to pass those challenges. By the way, the people from the Divine Samsara Sect are already on their way to the tower, so I will take us all there."

chapters.title: Chapter 1575: The Tower
paragraphs: Yue Xuelian and the others were stunned when they arrived under the Tower of Eternity. There were countless powerful beasts on the way to the area, but none of them attacked their group, allowing them to move much more freely than other cultivators. They knew that Zhang Fei was a heavenly fox, but they didn’t know the power of his beast bloodline, nor did they know that he was the Calamity Demon Dragon.
"How do we get into the tower?"
"There." Feng Yao pointed above. "We just need to fly there, and we’ll arrive at the entrance. We will face strong pressure once we fly there, but that’s not a problem for us."

"Let’s go then." Zhang Fei immediately flew towards the tower, followed by Feng Yao, Luo Yunxiao, Tianshi Shengjie, Helian Xun’er, Nalan Wangzi, Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, and the women of the Celestial Moon Sect.

The cultivators in the area looked at Zhang Fei with jealous gazes because he was surrounded by many beautiful women; however, their expressions changed to fear when they saw Feng Yao among them, and they frantically moved away after recognizing her identity from her dress.
"Why don’t these people go straight into the tower?"

"You’ve never challenged the tower, right?" Luo Yunxiao shook his head at Tianshi Shengjie. "They came to this domain to challenge the tower, but they doubted their ability to overcome all the challenges within it, as they were troublesome. Many people dared to enter it directly to face all the challenges, but quite a few of them took time to think before entering, and these people were among the latter."

"Oh." Zhang Fei immediately told Luo Yunxiao about some of the challenges inside the tower based on the information from Wang Yusheng earlier. "The challenges are that bad, huh? The gravity challenges don’t make me feel worried at all, but those extreme pressures, extreme weather, and many more might be troublesome."
"You’ve been training under extreme pressure for a long time, so you don’t need to worry about that, right?"
Luo Yunxiao nodded to Nalan Wangzi. "I can’t wait to take on those challenges, and I will definitely reach the third floor in one go."

Yue Qianrou and the elders looked confused by Luo Yunxiao’s confidence. After all, they had already challenged the tower and experienced great difficulties at that time, which prevented them from reaching the second floor.

Unlike them. Yue Xuelian had been training in Zhang Fei’s training space for many years, and she was already familiar with Luo Yunxiao and the others, so she didn’t doubt her ability to go to the third floor. "I’ll also be going up to the third floor this time, so I can see the challenges on that floor with my own eyes."
"Are you sure you can do that, Big Sis?"
"Let’s see later."
"Let’s enter now."
[Ding]
[The host entered a special dungeon: the Tower of Eternity.]
[Quest I: Clear the first floor.]
[Quest rank: Hard.]
[Reward: Eternity gift pack x 1]
[Quest II: Clear the second floor.]
[Quest rank: Easy.]
[Reward: Eternity gift pack x 1]
[Quest III: Clear the third floor.]
[Quest rank: Medium.]
[Reward: Eternity gift pack x 1]
[Quest IV: Obtain the metal element.]
[Quest rank: Hard.]
[Reward: Special gift pack x 1]
[Quest V: Unlock the stone gate.]
[Quest rank: Special.]
[Reward: Eternity gift pack x 1]
[Quest VI: Go to the Zhanlu Domain in the Ancient Realm.]
[Quest rank: Hard.]
[Reward: Ancient gift pack x 1]

Zhang Fei almost stumbled to the ground after a series of notifications appeared in his mind, particularly the last two quests. ’Does the system want me to go to the Ancient Realm with my current cultivation level?’
[I guess so, Master. I don’t know why the system gave you those two quests, but you have no choice but to go there to complete the last quest.]

’Yeah,’ Zhang Fei was increasingly curious about the identity of the young woman who accidentally killed him and gave him the system. She knew so much about his universe and gave him so many quests through the system. ’Sigh! Who exactly is that young woman? Why does she give me so many things?’
"What are you thinking, husband?"
Zhang Fei shook his head at Luo Yunxiao. "Why didn’t those challenges come out immediately?"

"Do you see that line?" Zhang Fei looked at the line Feng Yao was pointing at. "Once you step across it, you’ll face the first challenge, and you’ll continue to receive new challenges until you reach the line in front of the stone staircase to the second floor."
"So, this area is a safety zone, huh?" Zhang Fei looked towards the stone staircase leading to the second floor, measuring the distance between the two. "Can we fly straight to the gate?"

"This tower has anti-cheat, huh?" Zhang Fei rubbed his chin as he thought of the quickest way to reach the stone staircase. He tried to use his teleportation ability to get to the stone staircase, but an invisible attack knocked him back. "Damn it!"

"Haha," Feng Yao laughed heartily at that. "I already said you can’t fly there, which means you can’t use your teleportation either. This tower is an ancient one, and all the challenges here are used to prepare all cultivators who want to go to the Ancient Realm."
"Does this tower really connect the Paradise Realm and the Ancient Realm, Empress Yao?"
Feng Yao nodded to Yue Qianrou. "There’s a stone gate on the third floor, and it used to connect the two realms. However, some changes occurred in the past, and the gate has been sealed ever since."
"Did that change occur along with the barrier that separated the Paradise Realm and the Three Mortal Realms?"

"Yes," Feng Yao explained to them some things about the changes that occurred in their universe in the past. "Since then, all realms were separated by the barrier, and the stone gate was sealed from the Ancient Realm."

"Can you open the stone gate, Sister Yao?" Feng Yao just smiled at Nalan Wangzi, proving that her guess was correct. "Since we’re already here, we should move forward now, and we must reach the second floor as soon as possible."

"I’ll try first." Zhang Fei stepped forward first, but a heavy pressure immediately pulled him down from below. "The gravity challenge, huh? If I’m not mistaken, it’s only about ten times heavier, so the load is too light for me."
Luo Yunxiao, Nalan Wangzi, Helian Xun’er, and Tianshi Shengjie also stepped forward before a strong pull pulled them up from below, but it was useless against them.
"Hehe! I’m the same as you, husband. This gravity is ten times heavier than outside." Luo Yunxiao looked at the other three women. "What about you guys?"

"I thought it was only five times heavier than outside." Helian Xun’er jumped up and down on the spot. "I’ve never challenged this tower before, but my training over the past few years has helped me a lot."
Nalan Wangzi nodded slightly. "I think the gravity I’m experiencing is also five times heavier, so this is too light for me."
"I’m the same as you and Zhang Fei, Yunxiao." Tianshi Shengjie could still move freely because she had been training in Zhang Fei’s training space for so long.
Following that, Feng Yao and Yue Xuelian also stepped forward, and both of them had no difficulty resisting the gravity pulling them down.
"Twenty times heavier."
"I’m only five times heavier."
Yue Qianrou and the elders of the Celestial Moon Sect immediately followed them, but all of them fell to the ground as the heavy gravity pulled them down. "Shit! This gravity is too heavy, Big Sis."
"Ugh! I can’t move!"
Yue Qingyi and the others couldn’t move their bodies, even though they tried to fight the gravity using their cultivation.
"How can you guys withstand this much gravity?"
"Training, of course."
"How long will this first challenge last?" Zhang Fei asked Feng Yao.

Feng Yao shook her head at him. "The duration of each challenge is uncertain, sometimes fast, sometimes slow, so we can only wait for it to disappear on its own. By the way, some challenges will send you to a special place, and you must survive there until the duration ends. If you successfully pass the challenge, you will be sent back to this floor, but you will be sent out if you fail or die."
"So, we can only move forward if we’ve completed the challenge, right?"
"Not really." Feng Yao set an example by stepping forward, but she immediately disappeared from their sight as she was sent to the next challenge.
After that, Nalan Wangzi, Luo Yunxiao, Helian Xun’er, and Tianshi Shengjie also stepped forward, but the first two women were sent to different locations to face the next challenges.
"Phew." Helian Xun’er wiped her forehead. "The challenge I’m facing this time is still the same, but the gravity beneath me is stronger than before."
On the other hand, Tianshi Shengjie not only felt the gravity was heavier than before, but she also felt a heavy pressure pressing down on her from above. "Gravity and suppression!"
"Aren’t you going to step forward, Sect Master Xuelian?"
Yue Xuelian glanced at Yue Qianrou and the others before stepping forward, but she instantly disappeared from their sight for the next challenge.
"My turn." Zhang Fei disappeared as soon as he stepped forward.
"I think we should wait for them to return before moving forward, Xun’er."
Helian Xun’er agreed with Tianshi Shengjie. "Let’s wait for them to return."

chapters.title: Chapter 1576: A Mysterious Man
paragraphs: Feng Yao was in a dark room, causing her to raise an eyebrow. "Come out."

"Haha." A black shadow of a man suddenly appeared in front of Feng Yao, but she couldn’t see his face. "It’s useless for you to try to guess my identity, Shen Yuanzhi, or do you prefer if I call you the core of this universe?"
Feng Yao was not surprised to hear that from the man. "You are the source of the birth of this universe, right?"
"That little girl who came from another universe talks too much to you. Unfortunately, I couldn’t stop her because her father was born special, and she inherited something from him."

Feng Yao raised an eyebrow when the man mentioned Xuanyuan Yue and her father, but she didn’t bother about them. "So, my guess about you was correct, eh? How could this universe be born? How did you come to be in this universe? What is your purpose in doing all that?"
"I won’t explain to you my identity or the origins of this universe," Feng Yao frowned. "This universe has lost its order; you are responsible for that, and I appeared to restore it to normal."
"Are you thinking of destroying this universe like you wanted to destroy Xuanyuan Yue’s universe in the past?"

"You’re wrong about that," The man refuted her. "The one who wants to destroy her universe is not me, but something hidden within its core, which is your equal. My job is only to maintain the balance of this universe, or it will be destroyed if that balance is lost."
"If that’s the case, why did you create those shadowy creatures?"
"You’re wrong again." The man pointed his finger at her. "You are the mastermind behind the emergence of those shadowy creatures, and I was forced to appear because of your negligence."
"What do you mean by that?"
"You may not realize it, but your decision to manifest yourself in the past is the cause of the appearance of those shadowy creatures."
Feng Yao was confused by that because she had already considered everything well in the past, and she never knew that those shadowy creatures existed in her universe in the past.

The man spoke to her again. "As you already know, this universe was born from Yin and Yang—good and evil, and those shadowy creatures are the incarnation of the evil side hidden in this universe. They have existed since the birth of this universe, but they were locked away deep in the core, and they were finally freed after you manifested yourself. They had never moved before, and they took advantage of the damage and chaos in this universe to strengthen themselves. They were strong now, so they decided to appear on the surface, and they intended to destroy this universe."
"Can you stop them?"

"No." The man shook his head. "I am merely the will born from my true self, and I possess no power whatsoever, so I can’t stop them. Fortunately, the arrival of that young girl brought changes to this universe, and the savior has already been born."
"Zhang Fei."

"Yes." The man nodded at her. "Zhang Fei is the key to defeating those shadowy creatures, but he’s still too weak right now, and they’ll devour him alive if they meet now. They are only pawns, and the core creature has not yet surfaced. To stop the chaos in this universe, you must kill it, and those shadowy creatures will disappear forever."
"Where is the location of the core creature?"

"Unfortunately, the core creature escaped due to your mistake, and I haven’t managed to find it yet, so I can’t tell you its location." Feng Yao frowned deeply as she thought. "I think our conversation is enough, and I will wait for Zhang Fei on the third floor of this tower."
"Wait—" Feng Yao had not finished speaking, but she had already been sent out of the place and returned to the first floor.

[Master, what happened to you? Why did I feel like my connection with you was cut off just now?] Feng Yao sighed softly and told Huo Ling about her conversation with the mysterious man just now. [Huh? Are you serious about that? Are you really the cause of the appearance of those shadowy creatures?]
’At least, that’s what that man told me.’
[So, what are you going to do now?]

’Nothing.’ Feng Yao looked around, but she couldn’t find Zhang Fei there. ’For now, we have to wait for that kid to become strong because he’s the only one who can stop those creatures’ main core, but I don’t know how much time we have after their appearance.’
"What happened to you, Empress Huo? Why is your expression so serious?" Tianshi Shengjie asked.
"Nothing happened." Feng Yao looked ahead. "We don’t need to wait for Zhang Fei and the others, and we should go first."
"What about them?" Helian Xun’er pointed to Yue Qianrou and the elders of the Celestial Moon Sect, who were still struggling to cope with the gravity.

Feng Yao looked at them. "They’ve already challenged this tower before, so they should be ready to face any challenges here. Moreover, their cultivation bases are already high, so they’ll have to work on their own to reach the second floor. Let’s move."
Tianshi Shengjie and Helian Xun’er glanced at Yue Qianrou and the elders of the Celestial Moon Sect, but they didn’t say anything and immediately followed behind Feng Yao.

A few moments later, Wang Jingzhi and Wang Yusheng arrived at the tower, and they were slightly surprised to see the women from the Celestial Moon Sect. They were even more surprised because Tianshi Shengjie and Helian Xun’er were already ahead of them, even though they had headed to the tower before the two women.
"Hey, Big Sis! Isn’t that crimson-haired woman Empress Huo? What is she doing in this tower?"

"Empress Huo has reached the third floor in the past, but I don’t know if she found anything there. Perhaps she wants to go to the third floor again to check something, so we shouldn’t disturb her and focus on the challenges that await us." Wang Jingzhi looked at Tianshi Shengjie and Helian Xun’er. "Could it be that Zhang Fei has also arrived at this tower?"
"I think so." Wang Yusheng sighed softly as he looked at the women from the Celestial Moon Sect. "They will likely take a long time to break free from that heavy gravity."
"Let’s go." Wang Jingzhi and Wang Yusheng were immediately transported to two different locations as soon as they stepped forward.

Luo Yunxiao suddenly returned to the place, but she couldn’t find Zhang Fei and Nalan Wangzi. She didn’t worry about them and stepped forward to the third challenge, but a powerful pressure pressed down on her from above. She activated her Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique to dispel the pressure, and she immediately stepped onto the next challenge.
Yue Qianrou and the elders of the Celestial Moon Sect looked enviously at Luo Yunxiao and the others, especially since the challenges on the first floor seemed insignificant to them.
A few moments later, Nalan Wangzi had also returned to the first floor. She didn’t care too much about Yue Qianrou and the others, and she immediately continued to the next challenge.
Yue Xuelian finally returned, and she looked at her sect members. "Are you guys still unable to handle the gravity?"
"Big Sis, you don’t have to wait for us and move forward directly."
"Alright." Yue Xuelian immediately stepped forward, but she was sent elsewhere once again.

After some time, Zhang Fei appeared at the place, but he did not move forward immediately; instead, he turned to face the group from the Divine Samsara Sect that had just arrived. "Oh? Elder Yu Shan? Are you leading disciples from your sect? I didn’t expect to see you here."

"Haha," Yu Shan laughed. "I didn’t expect to see you here today either, Kid. My vice sect master and all the elders are here to lead our disciples, but I only lead our inner disciples. As for the core disciples, they are under the leadership of Vice Sect Master Li Guangyu, and they should have already made their way here. Did you come here alone?"
"I came with them." Zhang Fei pointed to Luo Yunxiao and the others at the front.
Yu Shan glanced at them for a moment, but he trembled when he saw Feng Yao. "I didn’t expect Empress Huo to be in this tower too."
"I will continue the challenge, Elder Yu Shan."
"Alright."
Zhang Fei once again disappeared from the place.
"Do you know that man well, Elder Yu?" a female disciple asked.
Yu Shan nodded at her. "He’s the son-in-law of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary and also one of the leaders of the Moonlit Passion Temple."
"The Moonlit Passion Temple? Isn’t that sect a dual cultivation sect? How could he be the son-in-law of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary?"

"The Moonlit Passion Temple was a dual cultivation sect in the past, but Zhang Fei had completely overhauled the sect, and it became a universal sect now." Yu Shan looked at the male disciples. "Alright, you guys don’t need to worry about that kid; instead, focus on completing all the challenges on this first floor, and remember our Sect Master’s explanation regarding them."
"Yes, Elder Yu." Those disciples immediately moved forward, but most of them right away fell on the floor, and some were sent to other places.

Yu Shan could only shake his head as he saw several disciples fall to the floor because of the gravity challenge, and he himself stepped forward to start his challenge before disappearing from that place.

"I didn’t expect to see you here today either, Kid.
My vice sect master and all the elders are here to lead our disciples, but I only lead our inner disciples.
As for the core disciples, they are under the leadership of Vice Sect Master Li Guangyu, and they should have already made their way here.
Did you come here alone?"
"I came with them." Zhang Fei pointed to Luo Yunxiao and the others at the front.
Yu Shan glanced at them for a moment, but he trembled when he saw Feng Yao.
"I didn’t expect Empress Huo to be in this tower too."
"I will continue the challenge, Elder Yu Shan."
"Alright."
Zhang Fei once again disappeared from the place.
"Do you know that man well, Elder Yu?" a female disciple asked.
Yu Shan nodded at her.
"He’s the son-in-law of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary and also one of the leaders of the Moonlit Passion Temple."
"The Moonlit Passion Temple?
Isn’t that sect a dual cultivation sect?
How could he be the son-in-law of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary?"
"The Moonlit Passion Temple was a dual cultivation sect in the past, but Zhang Fei had completely overhauled the sect, and it became a universal sect now." Yu Shan looked at the male disciples.
"Alright, you guys don’t need to worry about that kid; instead, focus on completing all the challenges on this first floor, and remember our Sect Master’s explanation regarding them."
"Yes, Elder Yu." Those disciples immediately moved forward, but most of them right away fell on the floor, and some were sent to other places.

Yu Shan could only shake his head as he saw several disciples fall to the floor because of the gravity challenge, and he himself stepped forward to start his challenge before disappearing from that place.

chapters.title: Chapter 1577: Enemies?
paragraphs: Zhang Fei was in a scorching desert, coupled with extreme pressure pressing down on him from above and heavy gravity pulling him down. However, none of those conditions mattered to him because he had adapted to the 256 times heavier gravity, and he also possessed the ice and water elements.

"Sigh," Zhang Fei sighed as he sat leisurely in the desert, enveloped by his water and element domains, which made the heat completely imperceptible to him. "How long will this challenge last? All the physical challenges in this tower are useless and a waste of time for me."
[Master, I detected something unusual from this area.]
"What’s that?"
[I detected a strong presence of someone or something, but I couldn’t track its location.]

Zhang Fei furrowed his brows and opened the system map, but he didn’t find a single dot in all areas of the place, which proved that he was alone there. "Is your detection not wrong, Mei? There’s nothing here, except for this scorching desert."
[It can’t be wrong, Master. I can detect that presence, but I can’t track its location, as it’s hidden somewhere.]

Zhang Fei himself knew that Mei was never wrong, and she always managed to detect everything beforehand, which always smoothed his journey. Yet, he couldn’t find anything there, even after he spread his senses throughout the area.

The mysterious man who had previously met Feng Yao was standing high up in the sky, observing him seriously, without either him or Mei noticing. "This kid is the only person who can stop those shadowy creatures, but he must find the location of the creature’s main body first. Unfortunately, I can’t find its location, so he must try to find and kill it himself."
Before long, the mysterious man saw Zhang Fei disappear from that place, so he also immediately left that place.

Zhang Fei had returned to the first floor of the Tower of Eternity, and he saw many people from the Divine Samsara Sect already there. He only recognized a few of them, especially those who had attended the briefing when he was about to enter the Forgotten Land years ago.

Zhang Fei saw Yue Qianrou and the others already standing in their spots, but sweat drenched their bodies from the previous effort to fight against the gravity. After they stabilized their breath, they immediately stepped forward before being sent to several different places for the next challenge.

Since he didn’t see Yue Xuelian there, Zhang Fei was sure she was facing challenges elsewhere. He wasn’t worried about her because she had been training in his training space for so long, and he was confident she could overcome any challenges that came her way.

Zhang Fei saw Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi, and the two of them had no difficulty moving forward because they had already reached the second floor before. He looked at Luo Yunxiao, Feng Yao, Nalan Wangzi, and Helian Xun’er, who were a little far in front of him.

Zhang Fei knew from the start that Luo Yunxiao would have no difficulty with all the challenges because she had been training in the training space since he first came to the Paradise Realm, and she also had the overpowered Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique. He wasn’t surprised that Feng Yao could move forward so easily, especially because of her other identity as a primordial, Shen Yuanzhi. Although he was a little surprised by Nalan Wangzhi and Helian Xun’er, he was pleased that the two women had no significant difficulty facing the challenges that awaited them.

Zhang Fei wanted to step forward, but he suddenly sensed a powerful, familiar aura arriving. He saw that Li Guangyu and the core disciples of the Divine Samsara Sect had already arrived, but he ignored them and continued his challenge.

"Hmm?" Li Guangyu looked at Zhang Fei and immediately recognized him, but his expression changed after he realized something. ’I didn’t expect him to be the partner of all those women before! I know he’s an elder of the Moonlit Passion Sect, and he’s also brought great changes to the sect, but I never knew he had so many talented women by his side.’
"Why are you looking at that man, Vice Sect Master?" Hua Liuying asked, glancing at Zhang Fei.
"That young man is the partner of all the previous women, Liuying." Hua Liuying and all the core disciples looked at Wang Tieshan. "Try to feel his qi."

Once again, Hua Liuying and all the core disciples observed Zhang Fei, and they immediately realized the truth of Wang Tieshan’s words. She and all the female disciples were a little surprised by that, but they didn’t care much about him because he was a dual cultivator with dozens of partners.
On the contrary, Wang Tieshan and the male disciples stared at Zhang Fei’s back with envy and hatred, mainly because all those women had the beauty to topple any kingdom.
"Look over there, Brother Tieshan." Wang Tieshan followed the direction pointed by a male disciple, where he saw Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi. "Aren’t those two your cousins?"
Wang Tieshan nodded slightly. "We don’t need to pay attention to weaklings like them, and we should focus on our own matters."
"Move now and reach the second floor as soon as possible! Whoever manages to reach that floor first, our Sect Master will reward that person."

Wang Tieshan, Hua Liuying, and all the core disciples became even more eager to face all the challenges on the first floor. They immediately spread out and began their challenges, but most were automatically sent elsewhere.
Just as he was about to step forward, Li Guangyu saw Yue Xuelian just returning from the previous challenge. "Sect Master Yue?"

Yue Xuelian froze for a moment as she recognized Li Guangyu’s voice, but she was already prepared to face him and all the elders of the Divine Samsara Sect. She turned around and looked at him. "I didn’t expect to meet you here, Vice Sect Master Li."

"Me too," Li Guangyu then asked her. "Ancestor Yue Ningxue repeatedly contacted you but never got through, and she asked Yue Qianrou and the others to find the location of our domain, but they refused her and enraged her."
"I’ve heard about the matter, but they wouldn’t have made a move without my orders because I’m the sect master of the Celestial Moon Sect, and I was still in seclusion at the time."
"Were you really in seclusion at that time?"
"I entered seclusion long before the changes that occurred in the Paradise Realm, and I only came out a few days ago."
"Then, how did you end up here now?"
"Someone brought me and my sect members here to train."
"Who is that person?"
"Her." Yue Xuelian pointed to Feng Yao in the distance after receiving Zhang Fei’s voice transmission.
Li Guangyu looked at Feng Yao, who was watching him from afar. "Did Empress Huo really bring you here? Since when did you become so close to her?"

"If you don’t believe me, you can ask her directly, Vice Sect Master Li." Li Guangyu’s lips twitched at Yue Xuelian’s statement, knowing that he would never dare to ask Feng Yao. "Since we’re in this tower now, we should focus on all the challenges ahead of us, and we’ll discuss other matters after we leave this place."
"Yes,"
"I will continue my challenge now, Vice Sect Master Li."

Li Guangyu simply nodded at her, but he was surprised when Yue Xuelian moved forward swiftly as if there was no obstacle in her way. He quickly contacted Liang Huizhong, and he informed him of the presence of people from the Celestial Moon Sect in the Tower of Eternity so his sect master could inform Yue Ningxue.

After that, Li Guangyu began his challenge, but pressure pressed him from above and strong gravity pulled him down. Fortunately, he had challenged the tower several times in the past, and his cultivation was already very high, at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, making both of them ineffective.
Meanwhile, Liang Huizhong walked into a cave filled with ice, where a woman sat cross-legged on an ice bed.

"Ancestor Ningxue, I have received news of the whereabouts of the members of the Celestial Moon Sect." Yue Ningxue immediately opened her eyes and looked at Liang Huizhong with her icy blue eyes. "Lu Guangyu is at the Tower of Eternity now, and he met Yue Xuelian there. She told him that she was in seclusion before the great changes that occurred in this realm, and she only came out a few days ago."
"Are the others also in that tower?"
"He only met Yue Xuelian, but she told him that Empress Huo brought her and the others to that tower."
"Empress Huo?" Yue Ningxue frowned. "Since when did she have connections with the Celestial Moon Sect?"
"I don’t have any clear information about their relationship, Ancestor."
"How long is the journey to the Glazed Heaven Domain?"
"About a month, Ancestor."
"About a month," Yue Ningxue muttered to herself, pondering a few things.

"The major changes that occurred in this Paradise Realm a few years ago made travel difficult, Ancestor. My people have been searching for the location of the Celestial Moon Domain for the past few years, but they still haven’t managed to find it. So far, we’ve only managed to find around twenty other domains, but most of them are just small domains."

Yue Ningxue nodded in understanding and got off her ice bed. "Since a month won’t be enough to complete all the challenges in the Tower of Eternity, I’ll go to the Glazed Heaven Domain to meet Yue Xuelian and the others myself."
"Yes, Ancestor."

chapters.title: Chapter 1578: Two Demon Races
paragraphs: While the people inside the tower were busy facing all the challenges, a black flying artifact with torture ornaments on each side flew into the Glazed Heaven Domain.

All the cultivators, who saw the flying artifact heading towards their location, immediately took out their flying artifacts and fled the domain as quickly as possible. They recognized the symbols on the flying artifact, which were none other than the group from the Torture Demon Race.

They were not afraid of other demon races because they would fight to the death if they encountered them, but the Torture Demon Race was entirely different from the others. Instead of directly killing their victims, the demons of the Torture Demon Race would capture them and torture them for their own satisfaction.

"Hahaha," A young male demon standing at the front end of the flying artifact laughed in satisfaction as he watched the crowd of flying artifacts fleeing the domain. "We haven’t done anything yet, but those pathetic humans are already so frightened by our arrival that they immediately fled like cowardly dogs."

"Young Lord Ku Yu, we don’t need to think about those weak humans, and our targets are the cultivators in the Tower of Eternity, especially those who come from the Divine Samsara Sect." An old female demon said.

Ku Yu looked towards the Tower of Eternity. "Grand Elder Ku Yin, why did my father suddenly send us to this domain? Haven’t we already discovered several other human domains? Instead of attacking the cultivators in the tower, we should attack them first, right?"

"Young Lord, my demon god has already sent your two brothers to those few domains, but those are too small for him to care about, and your brothers are more than enough to handle them." An old male demon looked towards the tower. "On the contrary, all the cultivators who challenged the tower were much more powerful than them, so he sent you here to deal with them, and the two of us will help you to succeed in your task."
"So, our main target is the people from the Divine Samsara Sect, right, Elder Ku Shan?"

Ku Shan nodded at him. "Our greatest enemy among the human race is the Divine Samsara Sect, so we will focus on them. However, we will also capture other powerful human cultivators, and my demon god will use them as sacrifices to attack the Celestial Demon Race."
"Can those weak humans from other domains fight us?"
"Young Lord, the human race is indeed physically weaker than us demons, but some of them are extremely powerful, so you must not underestimate them."
"For example?"
"Su Shentian, Jian Kuang, Zhuxian Sheng, Hun Lingwu, Liao Hanxue, and many more."

"The strongest among the human race are Empress Huo Yanling and her subordinates from the Blazing Nirvana Domain." Ku Yu turned to face Ku Shan directly. "Empress Huo’s strength is terrifying; even my demon god would have to think twice if he wanted to fight her. The previous demon god once fought with her, but he lost decisively to her, and his injuries took tens of thousands of years to recover. Additionally, several of her subordinates, such as Huo Lanyin, Huo Mingyi, Huo Mengyi, and several others, were also powerful."

Ku Yin reminded him directly. "Young Lord, we forbid you from fighting with people from the Blazing Nirvana Domain, and you must flee immediately if you encounter them, especially Empress Huo. If you offend her, we won’t be able to save you from her, and she will mercilessly slaughter us."

"I know." Although he had never met Feng Yao in person, Ku Yu had often heard about them from his demon race or others, so he did not underestimate the warnings of the two grand elders. "Will the other demon races also come to this domain?"

"I heard that Shang Zhanluo entered seclusion a few years ago, but I don’t know if he’s come out yet, so I don’t have any information about the Asura Demon Race. The Celestial Demon Domain was sealing their domain years ago, and Mo Shentian hasn’t answered our demon god’s call, so we can’t be sure whether he will send anyone here or not." Ku Yu himself was still surprised by the Celestial Demon God’s decision to seal his domain, and several years had passed since then. "The Nine Nether Demon Race, the Soul-Devouring Demon, the Eternal Night Demon Race, and the Seven Emotions Demon Race have already said they will not send their members here."
"What about the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race, the Faceless Demon Race, and the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon Race?"

Ku Shan answered him. "The prince and the princess of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race, Sha Huo and Sha Qingge, are already on their way to this domain, and they will arrive tomorrow. As for the Faceless Demon Race, Wu Mian has always avoided fighting with all races, so he did not send his race members here."

"Tch! I often feel that the Faceless Demon is a coward, and he doesn’t deserve to be on the same level as my father." Ku Shan and Ku Yin agreed with Ku Yu, and they also thought that Wu Mian was too cowardly as a demon god. "Then, what about Demon God Qian Yan?"

"There." Ku Yu looked in the direction Ku Shan was pointing. "The Ten Thousand Eyes Demon Domain is located not far from this domain, about a two-week journey, and our demon god obtained information about this domain’s location from Demon God Qian Yan."
"Hmm?" Ku Yu squinted his eyes.
"Hey! You don’t have to look like that." Two shadows appeared in front of Ku Yun and the others, which immediately turned into a young man and a young woman.
"Greetings Prince Qian Yu and Princess Qian Qin." Ku Shan and Ku Yin respectfully greeted them.
Qian Yu nodded at them before patting Ku Yu’s shoulder. "What if we compete?"
"Compete?" Ku Yu raised an eyebrow.
"Which of us captures more humans is the winner."
"Alright! We will compete to capture those humans!" Ku Yu glanced at Qian Qin. "If I win, I will date your sister."
Qian Qin looked at him with a dark face. "Who would want to date an ugly demon like you! You are competing with my brother, so don’t involve me in your competition!"
"Hahaha," Ku Yu laughed at that. "Hey, Qin! I’m not ugly, okay? I—"
"I don’t care! I’ll never date you even if there are no other male demons in this Paradise Realm!" Qian Qin immediately left the flying artifact.
Ku Yu watched Qian Qin’s departure as he spoke to Qian Yu. "Your sister never changes, and her character is still as fierce as ever."

"Isn’t that your own fault? Have you forgotten you called her fat in the past?" Ku Yu smiled bitterly upon hearing that from Qian Yu. "We have to work hard to capture those humans so our fathers can use them as sacrifices to attack the Celestial Demon Race."

"Do you think our two races combined can defeat the Celestial Demon Race?" Ku Yu asked with doubt in his tone. "Mo Shentian is far stronger than our fathers, so I doubt we will be able to defeat them."

Qian Yu shook his head. "My father once fought Mo Shentian, but he was never able to touch or attack him, which ended in his crushing defeat. The terrifying power of the Celestial Demon God to bend reality was too overwhelming, and my father’s middle eye couldn’t see through his domain. That’s why we won’t attack them directly, and we will use people from various races as sacrifices to distract him."
"Did you bring your subordinates?"
"As long as we don’t meet cultivators like Empress Huo, my sister and I are enough to face them, so you should be prepared to lose our competition."
"Tch! Arrogant! Let’s go there!"

In the forest, Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng noticed the arrival of the two demon races. They immediately asked everyone from the Moonlit Passion Temple not to spread out too far, making it easier for the three of them to protect them.

Zhang Fei’s five clones also noticed the arrival of the two demon races, and they were quite worried about the safety of all their wives after learning of their strength, especially Ku Yin and Ku Shan.
They asked Yao Qilin and Fei Lian to protect the others and prepare for dangerous situations, such as potential attacks from the two demon races, ensuring that everyone remained safe.

Inside the Tower of Eternity, Yue Xuelian finally managed to reach Zhang Fei and the others’ position. "Members of the Torture Demon Race and the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon Race are in this domain. I don’t know what they’re planning, but we must be wary of their presence."
"Who from the two demon races came here?" Feng Yao asked.
"Ku Yu, Ku Shan, Ku Yin, Qian Yu, and Qian Qin."

Feng Yao raised an eyebrow for a moment before telling them the identities of the five demons. "I don’t know the strength of those three young demons, but Ku Shan and Ku Yin are quite powerful, and their cultivation should be at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm. Jian Kuang and the others should be aware of their presence, and they can protect your sect’s people, so your five clones must protect all your wives out there."
"I will use one of my clones to investigate the intentions of the two demon races." Zhang Fei looked at Yue Xuelian. "Why do you look so anxious?"
Yue Xuelian sighed softly. "Li Guangyu must have contacted one of the ancestors of my sect, and I’m sure she’s on her way here."
"Who was the strongest of all your ancestors?"
"Yue Ningxue was the strongest among them, and she was one of the people behind the founding of the Divine Samsara Sect."
