"The strongest among the human race are Empress Huo Yanling and her subordinates from the Blazing Nirvana Domain." Ku Yu turned to face Ku Shan directly.
"Empress Huo’s strength is terrifying; even my demon god would have to think twice if he wanted to fight her.
The previous demon god once fought with her, but he lost decisively to her, and his injuries took tens of thousands of years to recover.
Additionally, several of her subordinates, such as Huo Lanyin, Huo Mingyi, Huo Mengyi, and several others, were also powerful."
Ku Yin reminded him directly.
"Young Lord, we forbid you from fighting with people from the Blazing Nirvana Domain, and you must flee immediately if you encounter them, especially Empress Huo.
If you offend her, we won’t be able to save you from her, and she will mercilessly slaughter us."
"I know." Although he had never met Feng Yao in person, Ku Yu had often heard about them from his demon race or others, so he did not underestimate the warnings of the two grand elders.
"Will the other demon races also come to this domain?"
"I heard that Shang Zhanluo entered seclusion a few years ago, but I don’t know if he’s come out yet, so I don’t have any information about the Asura Demon Race.

The Celestial Demon Domain was sealing their domain years ago, and Mo Shentian hasn’t answered our demon god’s call, so we can’t be sure whether he will send anyone here or not." Ku Yu himself was still surprised by the Celestial Demon God’s decision to seal his domain, and several years had passed since then.
"The Nine Nether Demon Race, the Soul-Devouring Demon, the Eternal Night Demon Race, and the Seven Emotions Demon Race have already said they will not send their members here."
"What about the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race, the Faceless Demon Race, and the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon Race?"
Ku Shan answered him.
"The prince and the princess of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race, Sha Huo and Sha Qingge, are already on their way to this domain, and they will arrive tomorrow.
As for the Faceless Demon Race, Wu Mian has always avoided fighting with all races, so he did not send his race members here."
"Tch!

I often feel that the Faceless Demon is a coward, and he doesn’t deserve to be on the same level as my father." Ku Shan and Ku Yin agreed with Ku Yu, and they also thought that Wu Mian was too cowardly as a demon god.
"Then, what about Demon God Qian Yan?"
"There." Ku Yu looked in the direction Ku Shan was pointing.
"The Ten Thousand Eyes Demon Domain is located not far from this domain, about a two-week journey, and our demon god obtained information about this domain’s location from Demon God Qian Yan."
"Hmm?" Ku Yu squinted his eyes.
"Hey!
You don’t have to look like that." Two shadows appeared in front of Ku Yun and the others, which immediately turned into a young man and a young woman.
"Greetings Prince Qian Yu and Princess Qian Qin." Ku Shan and Ku Yin respectfully greeted them.
Qian Yu nodded at them before patting Ku Yu’s shoulder.
"What if we compete?"
"Compete?" Ku Yu raised an eyebrow.
"Which of us captures more humans is the winner."
"Alright!
We will compete to capture those humans!" Ku Yu glanced at Qian Qin.
"If I win, I will date your sister."
Qian Qin looked at him with a dark face.
"Who would want to date an ugly demon like you!
You are competing with my brother, so don’t involve me in your competition!"
"Hahaha," Ku Yu laughed at that.
"Hey, Qin!
I’m not ugly, okay?
"I don’t care!
I’ll never date you even if there are no other male demons in this Paradise Realm!" Qian Qin immediately left the flying artifact.
Ku Yu watched Qian Qin’s departure as he spoke to Qian Yu.
"Your sister never changes, and her character is still as fierce as ever."
"Isn’t that your own fault?
Have you forgotten you called her fat in the past?" Ku Yu smiled bitterly upon hearing that from Qian Yu.
"We have to work hard to capture those humans so our fathers can use them as sacrifices to attack the Celestial Demon Race."
"Do you think our two races combined can defeat the Celestial Demon Race?" Ku Yu asked with doubt in his tone.
"Mo Shentian is far stronger than our fathers, so I doubt we will be able to defeat them."
Qian Yu shook his head.
"My father once fought Mo Shentian, but he was never able to touch or attack him, which ended in his crushing defeat.
The terrifying power of the Celestial Demon God to bend reality was too overwhelming, and my father’s middle eye couldn’t see through his domain.
That’s why we won’t attack them directly, and we will use people from various races as sacrifices to distract him."
"Did you bring your subordinates?"
"As long as we don’t meet cultivators like Empress Huo, my sister and I are enough to face them, so you should be prepared to lose our competition."
"Tch!
Arrogant!
Let’s go there!"
In the forest, Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng noticed the arrival of the two demon races.
They immediately asked everyone from the Moonlit Passion Temple not to spread out too far, making it easier for the three of them to protect them.

Zhang Fei’s five clones also noticed the arrival of the two demon races, and they were quite worried about the safety of all their wives after learning of their strength, especially Ku Yin and Ku Shan.
They asked Yao Qilin and Fei Lian to protect the others and prepare for dangerous situations, such as potential attacks from the two demon races, ensuring that everyone remained safe.
Inside the Tower of Eternity, Yue Xuelian finally managed to reach Zhang Fei and the others’ position.
"Members of the Torture Demon Race and the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon Race are in this domain.
I don’t know what they’re planning, but we must be wary of their presence."
"Who from the two demon races came here?" Feng Yao asked.
"Ku Yu, Ku Shan, Ku Yin, Qian Yu, and Qian Qin."
Feng Yao raised an eyebrow for a moment before telling them the identities of the five demons.
"I don’t know the strength of those three young demons, but Ku Shan and Ku Yin are quite powerful, and their cultivation should be at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm.
Jian Kuang and the others should be aware of their presence, and they can protect your sect’s people, so your five clones must protect all your wives out there."
"I will use one of my clones to investigate the intentions of the two demon races." Zhang Fei looked at Yue Xuelian.
"Why do you look so anxious?"
Yue Xuelian sighed softly.
"Li Guangyu must have contacted one of the ancestors of my sect, and I’m sure she’s on her way here."
"Who was the strongest of all your ancestors?"
"Yue Ningxue was the strongest among them, and she was one of the people behind the founding of the Divine Samsara Sect."

paragraphs: "Yue Ningxue, huh?"

Feng Yao smiled as she realized Zhang Fei’s thoughts, teasing him. "Are you considering taking that woman as your woman? Yue Ningxue is quite beautiful, and her cultivation has already reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm—probably stronger than cultivators of the same level."

"Not really." Zhang Fei stood facing Feng Yao. "Compared to that woman, I am more interested in having you as my wife. I often imagine you under me with my dick inside your body, and you enjoy the incomparable sexual satisfaction that I give you."

Yue Xuelian was stunned to hear Zhang Fei speak so vulgarly to Feng Yao, and she was sure that no man apart from him would dare speak to her like that. ’This kid! How dare he speak to Empress Huo like that?’
"Hahaha." Nalan Wangzi, Luo Yunxiao, Helian Xun’er, and Tianshi Shengjie burst into laughter at Zhang Fei’s words.
"He’s a pervert."
"His brain is only filled with sex."
"I’m not surprised by that."
"After all, he is the most lustful man, and Sister Yao is powerful, so he always yearns for her."
Feng Yao’s next action shocked Yue Xuelian as she moved closer to Zhang Fei. She wrapped one hand around his neck, kissed him, and rubbed his dick from outside his trousers.
This time, Feng Yao did not refuse when Zhang Fei hugged her waist, and he gave her a deeper and more passionate kiss, with their tongues clashing against each other.
Yue Xuelian was utterly shocked as she saw them kissing, and she did not expect that Zhang Fei and Feng Yao had such a profound relationship because she had never seen them interact in person.
Nalan Wangzi, Luo Yunxiao, Helian Xun’er, and Tianshi Shengjie had been with Zhang Fei for too long, so they knew for sure about his roller coaster relationship with Feng Yao.

All the cultivators on the first floor, especially Li Guangyu and the core disciples of the Divine Samsara Sect, looked at them with expressions of incredible shock. They didn’t know the reason behind Feng Yao deliberately kissing Zhang Fei and letting him kiss her back, and she did that with the aim of giving them a deterrent.

’What the hell is going on here? How could Zhang Fei have that kind of relationship with Empress Huo?’ Li Guangyu was utterly shocked, and he immediately informed Liang Huizhong of their relationship. However, he was more curious about his relationship with Yue Xuelian, as she looked warm when talking to him. ’Is that woman also one of his wives? It’s impossible because I can detect that she is still a virgin, and there is no his yang qi in her body.’
The Wang siblings, who had just completed a challenge elsewhere, stared at them speechlessly.
Wang Yusheng thought that Zhang Fei was a lucky bastard for having Feng Yao as his woman, and he was a little jealous of him, but he didn’t know about their true relationship.
Wang Jingzhi was also surprised to see Zhang Fei and Feng Yao embracing while kissing hotly, but her opinion of him became even worse. ’Tch! He is indeed a bastard, playboy, and pervert!’

After kissing for a while, Feng Yao pushed Zhang Fei back as his hands started groping her rear. "If you can’t wait to enjoy my body, you should work harder to surpass me, and I’ll let you do whatever you want to me then."

"Sigh." Zhang Fei was always depressed because Feng Yao always used those conditions, and he realized that he would never be able to surpass her, mainly because she was the reincarnation of a primordial being named Shen Yuanzhi. "Just wait for that day to come! I will surpass you in the future, and I will enjoy your body then."
"I will always wait for that day to come."
Zhang Fei looked at Yue Xuelian. "You don’t need to worry about Yue Ningxue, and I will handle her if she comes here and attacks you all."
"But—"

"Trust him, Sect Master Xuelian." Yue Xuelian looked at Luo Yunxiao. "You’ve lived with us for so long, so you should already know his abilities, right? Yue Ningxue may be strong, but she won’t be able to face him as long as she comes to this tower alone, and she will regret it if she messes with him."
Nalan Wangzi also spoke to her. "You already know our husband’s other identity, so you should already know that no woman can resist him, right?"
"Sect Master Yue, leave everything to Zhang Fei, and I believe everything will be fine," Helian Xun’er said.
Tianshi Shengjie gave a light nod. "They still haven’t discovered the location of our domain, so you and your sect should be fine."
"Phew," Yue Xuelian exhaled softly. "Please help us, Zhang Fei."
"I will." Zhang Fei looked towards the second floor. "We have to reach the next floor quickly, so let’s continue our challenge."
In one of the deepest forest areas.

A young man and a young woman, who were cultivating there, suddenly opened their eyes. Like the other cultivators, they noticed the arrival of the demons of the Torture Demon Race and the Thousand Eyes Demon Race in that domain.
"Brother Dugu Qingshu."
"I know, Yao Jinyu." Dugu Qingshu nodded to her. "I didn’t expect them to have discovered this domain, and they seem to have come here on purpose to cause trouble."
"Do you recognize them, Brother?"
"Hmm?" Dugu Qingshu looked up at the sky. "If I’m not mistaken, they are members of the Torture Demon Race and the Thousand Eyes Demon Race, but I don’t recognize their identities."
"The Torture Demon Race? Isn’t the demon race terrible and vile?"

"Phew," Dugu Qingshu exhaled. "The Torture Demon Race is the most vicious and vile of all the demon races; they torture all the cultivators they capture. The second most vicious is the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race, but they don’t like torturing their victims, and they mercilessly kill people. As for the Thousand Eyes Demon Race, they are demon beasts with powerful physiques and impressive strength, and they will devour anyone who stands in their way."
"Should we alert all the cultivators in this forest?"

"They should have noticed the demons by now, so we don’t need to warn them. Moreover, we are cultivators, so they should be responsible for their own safety and lives." Yao Jinyu nodded in understanding at Dugu Qingshu. "I will contact our master and the others who are on the second floor of the tower so they can prepare to face those demons."

After contacting his master and the others, Dugu Qingshu took Yao Jinyu away from their location and hid in another area to avoid the demons, as they could not possibly face them with just the two of them.
The second floor of the Tower of Eternity.
"Master."

"I know, Dugu Xuanye." A middle-aged man, none other than Dugu Yuanshen, nodded to his disciple. "I didn’t expect the demon races to have discovered the location of this domain, and three of the ten races are here now. The situation in the domain will soon become chaotic with their arrival, so I want you all to prepare for the worst. They won’t be able to arrive on this floor so quickly, and they must first overcome all the challenges on the first floor."
"Are you going to contact the others to stop those demons, Master?" A woman asked him.

"We can’t stop those demons with our numbers, Ru Feiyan. Moreover, Dugu Qingshu hasn’t gotten any information about the people from the three demon races, so I can’t be sure of their strength yet." Dugu Yuanshen immediately contacted the people from the War God Pavilion, asking them to go to the Glazed Heaven Domain as quickly as possible. "Fortunately, we’ve long since installed a teleportation portal connecting this domain with ours, so the people from our sect can come here directly."
"Shall we go out to help them?"

"No need." Dugu Yuanshen refused. "As long as the three demon gods don’t come to this domain, the people of our sect will be able to deal with them, so we don’t need to go back out to help them. If we leave now, we’ll have to redo the first-floor challenges, making it harder to reach the third floor."
"Yes, Master."
Dugu Yuanshen looked up at the ceiling. "Get ready! The next challenge is about to appear!"
Members of the Torture Demon Race and the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon Race had already landed outside the forest, but they didn’t see a single cultivator there.
"Tch! Those people are truly cowards!" Ku Yu shouted angrily.

Ku Shan immediately spoke to him. "Young Lord, the cultivators who haven’t entered the forest have already fled, but I’m sure many of them are still training inside, as they won’t be able to leave unless they come out here."

"Young Lord, all the cultivators inside this forest and the tower are much stronger than those cowards, so you can have fun capturing them. The two of us won’t interfere with your competition with Prince Qian Yu, but we will act if you encounter two cultivators of Jian Kuang and the others’ caliber inside," Ku Yin said.
"Yeah." Ku Yu looked at Qian Yu, who was standing beside Qian Qin. "Are you ready to lose?"
Qian Yu shrugged. "I will never lose to you, and I will beat you by a huge margin."
"A braggart!"
"Hey! Be careful of the cultivators from the War God Pavilion!"
"We know."
After Ku Yin and Ku Shan ordered the members of the Torture Demon Race to spread out, they immediately entered the forest to capture the cultivators there.

chapters.title: Chapter 1580: The Heavenly Rift Pouch
paragraphs: As they entered the first area of the forest, Ku Yu and the others saw almost no one there, making them feel strange about the situation.
As senior demons, Ku Shan and Ku Yin sensed many presences in the area, but they couldn’t sense too many people.
"What happened in this area, Elders? Do you two think those people fled deeper into the forest?" Ku Yu asked, looking around them.
"Young Lord, we sense the presence of many cultivators in this area, but we can’t see them or sense their positions," Ku Yin answered him.
"They seem to be using advanced hiding techniques, Young Lord." Ku Shan looked at Qian Yu and Qian Qin. "Were you two able to find their location, Prince Qian and Princess Qian?"
"No." Qian Yu shook his head. "Even though my beast form has countless eyes, I don’t have my father’s middle eye, so I can’t find their location."

"Brother, I think the majority of people in this area are women." They turned to Qian Qin. "I can’t see them or find their location, but I have something that makes me sensitive to qi, so I’m sure my guess is correct. I think your previous guess was wrong, Grand Elder Ku Shan."
"Where is my guess wrong, Princess Qian?"
"Everyone can learn the same techniques, but not everyone can reach the same level because everyone’s talents are different."
"You’re right about that, Princess Qian." Ku Shan nodded at her. "So, what do you think about the people hiding?"

"One or more people have mastered excellent hiding techniques, and they are helping those women hide from us, which means they come as a group." Qian Qin looked in several different directions. "However, I have never met other living creatures with such techniques, whether humans, demons, beasts, or winged races."

Ku Yin nodded at her. "Ku Shan and I have never met anyone else who possesses such techniques in our entire lives. Unfortunately, Demon God Qian Yan is not in this domain now, and he should be able to discover them with the ability of his middle eye."

"Haha," Qian Yu laughed. "My father’s middle eye ability is extremely terrifying, and he can see even hidden spaces. Unfortunately, we can only obtain it after we reach the Demon God Rank, so no one in our race possesses it, except for our father."
"So, what should we do now?"

Ku Yin pointed to the path ahead. "We should go to the next area, Young Lord. I don’t believe that all the cultivators in this forest have such excellent hiding techniques, so I’m sure we’ll meet more cultivators if we go deeper."

"Young Lord, all the cultivators in this area won’t be able to hide forever, so I’ll order some of our demon race members to wait here. I’m sure those people’s cultivation is no higher than the Celestial Lord Realm, and our subordinates will capture them as soon as they emerge from hiding." Ku Shan immediately carried out his idea, and five demons from the Torture Demon Race right away appeared in the area. "Let’s go to the next area."
"Let’s go."
After Ku Yu and the others left, the five demons from the Torture Demon Race moved around the first forest area, trying to find the cultivators hiding there.
As soon as they moved, Zhang Fei’s five clones, Fei Lian, and Yao Qilin blocked them. They immediately attacked the demons, but they didn’t kill them and knocked them out.
"What will you do with them, Master?"

"We can’t kill them, so we have to send them to other domains." Zhang Fei [1] immediately opened five different gates, but he swiftly closed them again after the two female evil beasts kicked the five unconscious demons into them. "This way, Ku Shan and Ku Yin won’t notice that they disappeared."
"Master, Ku Shan and Ku Yin are just as strong as us, and we can definitely defeat them for you." Yao Qilin spoke.

"I knew that." Zhang Fei [1] looked towards the next area. "You two can defeat them after training for so long in my training space, but I’m worried that Ku Shenzu will come here if we do anything to them. Furthermore, we don’t know if Qian Yan is monitoring this domain with his middle eye ability, so I don’t want to risk facing two of the ten demon gods. We might be able to fight the former if we join forces, but I think it’s too risky to provoke the latter."
Zhang Chen and all of Zhang Fei’s wives immediately came out of their hiding places. "Fei’er, won’t people from our sect have trouble inside?"

"Senior Su, Senior Jian, and Senior Zhuxian are protecting them, so I believe they will be fine." Zhang Fei [1] turned to Yao Qilin and Fei Lian. "I want you two to go to the deeper area to help them if those demons attack the people of my sect, but you don’t need to care about the other cultivators, as they have nothing to do with us."
"Yes, Master." Yao Qilin and Fei Lian immediately moved into a deeper area.

Zhang Fei [1] turned to all his wives. "You guys don’t need to worry about those demons anymore, and I want you to focus on your training in this forest. Once you’ve all gotten used to your new strengths, I’ll take you all to the tower to try out all the challenges there."
After being in seclusion for so long, Zhang Chen and the other women were eager to fight the beasts again, so they spread out to the first area. As before, Feng Tian and Feng Jiu joined them.

Ku Shan nodded slightly. "You’re not even a hundred years old, but your cultivation has already reached the Celestial Emperor Realm, and your body cultivation level is already so high."

As for your race, you can become stronger faster through sex, especially if you have sex with demons with cultivation as high as Xie Yan."

"Haha," Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed softly. "Unfortunately, not all demons care about becoming strong, and many of them indulge in sex, Senior. If only they strove hard to become strong, our lust demon race would become powerful, and my two leaders would not have a headache."

"I have no doubt about that," Ku Yin replied with a nod. "The lust demon race has the potential to be strong, but their obsession with sex has made them weak. If not for the natural illusion formation in the Endless Domain, the other cultivators would have slaughtered them long ago."

"Although Xie Yao and Xie Yan have long been demon gods, their strength is far inferior to that of other demon gods. My demon god could kill them easily if he wanted to, but he would rather not waste his energy killing fellow demons." Ku Shan said.

"Yes," Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "That’s why I don’t want to be like them, and I constantly strive to improve in every aspect of myself. Apart from increasing my physical strength, I also increase my speed to save myself if I encounter dangerous situations."
"How fast is your speed?"
"Above average."
"Show us."
"Alright." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately disappeared from his spot, but he didn’t use his maximum speed. He limited his speed, allowing Ku Shan and Ku Yin to see his movements.
The situation was different for Qian Qin, who was stunned because she couldn’t see his movements. "So fast!"
Ku Shan and Ku Yin agreed with her. "For a lust demon, his speed is incredibly fast, Princess Qian."
"If I pay attention to his movements, his speed is almost on par with Xie Yao and Xie Yan."
"Are the two lust demon gods really that fast, Seniors?"
"Yes," Ku Shan and Ku Yin nodded at her. "Our demon god once tried their speed, but he couldn’t catch them."
"The Lust Demon Race doesn’t have good fighting abilities, so they focus on their speed to save themselves if they encounter enemies stronger than them."
Qian Qin nodded in understanding. "All demon races have their advantages and disadvantages, and the Lust Demon Race is one of the weakest in combat among all the demon races."

"You’re not wrong in saying that, Princess Qian." Ku Shan stopped as Zhang Xiaolong [3] appeared before them. "However, this kid and his two demon gods are not weak, and their strength surpasses many demon races, except for our two demon races."

"Haha," Ku Yin caressed his dick from outside his trousers. "Isn’t a lust demon like sex? Do you think I’m too old for you?"
’Tch! This old bitch!’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] cursed inwardly. "Senior, you’re not old, but I don’t dare to do it with you."
"Why?"
"You’re a senior, and I’m a junior, so I feel it would be inappropriate to do it with you."
"If I did this to Xie Yao, he would pounce on me without a second thought." Ku Yin pulled her hand back. "Do you want to do it with Princess Qian?"
Qian Qin was stunned for a moment. "Senior Yin, please don’t say things like that, okay?"
"Haha," Ku Yin laughed. "I was just teasing this young lust demon, Princess Qian."
Qian Qin didn’t answer Ku Yin, but she repeatedly stole glances at Zhang Xiaolong [3], thinking about something.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] noticed her glance, but he pretended not to notice. He looked at Ku Shan, who threw the Heavenly Rift Pouch into the air, sucking the cultivators in. ’If I think about it, his artifact is indeed useful. But how can I steal it from him?’
Before long, all the cultivators in the second area had been sucked into the Heavenly Rift Pouch, and Ku Shan immediately put away his artifact. "Let’s go to the third area."
Ku Yin, Ku Yu, Qian Yu, and Qian Qin immediately followed behind Ku Shan.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] followed them as he checked his map; he was relieved to find that Jian Kuang and the others had already brought the people from his sect to the fourth area, and he didn’t see too many cultivators there. ’It seems they have warned the people and taken them to the next area.’
Unlike Zhang Xiaolong [3], Jian Kuang and the others couldn’t let those people fall into the hands of the demons, so they warned them and took them deeper into the forest.
"Hey, Kid! What’s your name?" Ku Yu shouted at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Xie Xiaolong, Senior."
Ku Yu nodded slightly. "I’d like to spar with you later, but you don’t have to worry because I won’t be using all my strength."
’Sigh.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "Are we going to spar inside the tower, Senior?"
"We will spar in the area under the tower."
"Alright."
Qian Yu noticed his sister’s glance at Zhang Xiaolong [3], and he immediately walked beside her. "What do you think of him? Did you find something wrong with him?"
’I can’t find anything wrong with him, Brother.’ Qian Qin paused. ’However, I feel something familiar about him, but I can’t remember it.’
’Something familiar? Have you met him before?’

Qian Qi shook her head slightly. ’I’ve met many lust demons in the past, but I’ve never met him once. Brother, try contacting our father and tell him to ask Xie Yao and Xie Yan about this young demon.’

’Did you forget that our father is in hibernation? He’ll be mad at me if I contact him about such a trivial matter.’ Qian Yu glanced at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. ’Try to remember what’s familiar about him.’
’Alright.’
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smirked faintly as he noticed their glances at him. ’Heh! You two won’t be able to find out anything about me, even if you contact Xie Yao and Xie Yan.’
The five demons frowned when they arrived at the third area because they didn’t find a single cultivator there. "Why isn’t there anyone in this area? Did they all go deeper?"

"They must have already received information about our actions, Young Lord." Ku Shan looked at the tower. "They may have fled to the tower to avoid us, but they won’t be able to escape us forever, and we will capture them there."
Ku Yu nodded. "Let’s move faster."

You two won’t be able to find out anything about me, even if you contact Xie Yao and Xie Yan.’
The five demons frowned when they arrived at the third area because they didn’t find a single cultivator there.
"Why isn’t there anyone in this area?
Did they all go deeper?"
"They must have already received information about our actions, Young Lord." Ku Shan looked at the tower.
"They may have fled to the tower to avoid us, but they won’t be able to escape us forever, and we will capture them there."
Ku Yu nodded.
"Let’s move faster."

chapters.title: Chapter 1582: Intercept The Demons
paragraphs: The further they walked in, the fewer cultivators they encountered, leaving Ku Yu and the others confused.
They knew that those cultivators knew they were coming, but they also knew that many of them were arrogant and liked to push themselves too hard.
All the beasts in the forest kept their distance from them due to the auras emitted by Ku Yin and Ku Shan, as well as the beast auras from Qian Yu and Qian Qin.

Ku Yu and Qian Yu walked ahead of them with annoyed expressions, as did Ku Shan and Ku Yin. Qian Qin looked more relaxed and unperturbed, but she repeatedly stole glances at Zhang Xiaolong [3], thinking about the familiar feeling she felt from him. ’What exactly is this familiar feeling? Where have I felt it before?’

Zhang Xiaolong [3] followed behind them as he watched the system map, but he also paid attention to Qian Qin’s movements in front of him. ’How strong would those two be if they fought at full strength? Ku Yu is indeed strong, and their cultivation is at the same level, but my gut feeling says that those two demon beasts are much stronger than him.’

[In terms of strength, Qian Yu and Qian Qin are stronger than Ku Yu, Master. Besides, they have much better eye abilities than him, especially the male demon beast. As for the female beast, I feel like she’s been trying to find something from you, which might be related to your Yang Qi.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] agreed with Mei, as he listened to Qian Qin’s words earlier when they first entered the first area. He couldn’t find anything special in her status, but she could feel the Qi from all his wives, even though they were invisible. ’Could that be her advantage as a demon beast? Then, what are the advantages of her brother’s?’
"Young Lord, I sense the aura of people from the War God Pavilion, so we should be close to their location."
"The people from the War God Pavilion possess abilities similar to those of the Asura Demon Race, and they can increase their strength by using them, so we should avoid them, Young Lord."
Ku Yu nodded to the two grand elders. "Do you think Dugu Yuanshen and the others are in this domain?"
"There." Ku Yu looked towards the tower. "The people from the War God Pavilion in this forest should be their monitoring team, and Dugu Yuanshen should be in the tower with their core team."

Ku Shan warned him. "Even my demon god would think twice about fighting Dugu Yuanshen and the others, Young Master. Their cultivation is on par with his, but they become much stronger once they activate their special techniques, so all the demon races always avoid them. There’s no benefit in fighting them, and we would lose a lot of our members."

"My father said the same thing." Qian Yu looked at Ku Yu. "In fact, my father once fought with Dugu Yuanshen and several elders from the War God Pavilion in the past, and they forced him to retreat. Thereafter, he ordered all members of our demon race to avoid the people from that sect, but some were still arrogant and attacked them, and they ended up dying at their hands."

"I’ve never fought cultivators from the War God Pavilion before, but I’ve often heard of their strength from the other demons. Since they were able to force Demon God Qian Yan to retreat, I wouldn’t be so crazy as to fight with them." Ku Yu momentarily glanced at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. ’What do you think about that young lust demon? I’ve often fought with demons or other races, but I’ve never fought someone like him, and I feel that he’s still hiding his true strength.’

Qian Yu nodded slightly. ’My sister felt something familiar from that young lust demon, but she couldn’t remember it. I’ve asked her to try to remember, but it seems she can’t remember it yet, so we have to be careful with him.’
’Hmm? I’ll try asking Xie Yan about him.’
’Go on.’
A while later, Ku Yu informed Qian Yu, ’Xie Yan told me that that young lust demon is indeed a member of her race, and she also confirmed all of his previous stories.’
’Is that true?’
’Hey! Xie Yan wouldn’t dare lie to me, so I believe it’s all true.’

’I don’t know Xie Yan and Xie Yao as well as you do, so I don’t know whether it’s true or not.’ Qian Yu stole a glance at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. ’Even if you are confident in her words, we must still be wary of him, or we will be the ones to bear the consequences if we underestimate him.’
’Yeah.’ Ku Yu sent a voice transmission to Ku Shan and Ku Yin, asking them to keep a close eye on Zhang Xiaolong [3], to which they immediately agreed.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed in his heart after Xie Yao contacted him and told him that Ku Yu contacted Xie Yan to ask about him, but he had already taken precautions by contacting them first.

’Fortunately, the two lust demon gods are still on my side, even though I rejected their request a few years ago. Even though they had told him about me, he still seemed suspicious of me, and the source was Qian Qin. I have to do something about her immediately, but I’m afraid that the two grand elders will notice my actions.’ After he thought about it, Zhang Xiaolong [3] dispelled the qi covering his body, causing his passive lust aura to spread out around him. He directed it only at Qian Qin, who immediately looked at him. He pretended not to see it and looked around them, making sure that there were no cultivators in the area. ’Let’s see how long you can hold it.’

Qian Qin’s heart skipped a beat when she looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] due to the effect of his passive lust aura, and she felt that he was truly handsome due to the effect of his passive absolute beauty. She couldn’t see that he did anything or used any of his abilities, as both of them moved passively.

Qian Qin looked at Ku Yin, but the female grand elder of the Torture Demon Race looked normal, and there was no change in her expression. ’What exactly is going on here? Why do I suddenly feel attracted to that young lust demon? Why is my lust starting to get out of control?’

After they had walked for quite a while and passed through several areas, Ku Shan and Ku Yin asked Ku Yu and Qian Yu to stop, and the two of them moved in front of the two men. "I know you guys are here."

"Haha," Jian Kuang appeared in front of them as he laughed, followed by Su Shentian and Zhuxian Sheng. Yao Qilin and Fei Lian were also in the area, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked them not to come out. "You guys seem to have captured the cultivators in the previous areas, huh?"
"I haven’t fought a powerful demon like you in a long time, so I’ll stretch my muscles by fighting you two today," Su Shentian said casually.

Ku Shan and Ku Yin hurriedly raised their guard when Zhuxian Sheng took out the black spear that Feng Yao gave him when they were in the Endless Night Dungeon, mainly because the spear was brimming with powerful killing intent.
Zhuxian Sheng rubbed the black spear. "My spear can’t wait to taste your blood."
’Shit!’ Ku Yin and Ku Shan cursed in their hearts, and they ordered Ku Yun and the others to leave immediately, as they were not confident in facing the three people in front of them. "Leave!"

Qian Yu did not delay any longer and pulled his sister, Qian Qin, away from the area, with Ku Yu following them. Zhan Xiaolong [3] also immediately followed them as he glanced at Jian Kuang and the others. ’Stall them for me and kill their subordinates.’
They didn’t say anything in response to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. Jian Kuang and Zhuxian Sheng immediately moved to attack Ku Shan and Ku Yin, while Su Shentian moved to attack their subordinates.
"Sheng! The male demon is mine, so you have to fight the female one!" Jian Kuang shouted as he dashed toward Ku Shan, who immediately moved away from his spot.
Zhuxian Sheng sighed inwardly, but he immediately moved towards Ku Yin and thrust his spear towards her.

"Shit!" Ku Yin hurriedly moved away from Zhuxian Sheng as soon as she sensed something unusual about his black spear. "What kind of spear is that? How can an inanimate object emit such powerful killing intent?"
"You won’t be able to escape from me, demon." Zhuxian Sheng whispered something to his black spear before throwing it into the air, where it immediately split into several spears. "Go!"
Ku Yin looked at the black spear and accelerated her movement speed, but Zhuxian Sheng immediately blocked her path and kicked her chest.
"Gah!" Ku Yin staggered backward before hastily dodging all the spears that plunged down towards her, but one of them managed to hit her in the back, causing her to bleed profusely. "Argh!"
Zhuxian Sheng dashed toward Ku Yin, grabbed his spear, and thrust it at her.

Ku Yin wouldn’t allow Zhuxian Sheng to injure her any further, and she reverted to her demon form. She parried his spear and launched a powerful blow at him, but he quickly dodged her attack and moved away from her. ’What? His speed has become so fast now, and it is almost on par with Su Shentian’s.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1583: Thousand Eyes Demon Race
paragraphs: *Clang*
"Haha," Ku Yin laughed after she parried Zhuxian Sheng’s attack. "Even though you’ve improved a lot, you’re still no match for me when I’m in my demon form."

"Is that so?" Ku Yin frowned at the smirk on Zhuxian Sheng’s face, but she was shocked when her hand suddenly started bleeding, forcing her to move away from him. "My spear is no ordinary spear, and your tough skin won’t be able to withstand it."

Zhuxian Sheng detected an increase in Ku Yin’s strength, and he moved towards her to prevent her from using her special technique. However, he was a little late, and she knocked him back when his spear was only an inch away from her chest.
"Hahaha," Ku Yin laughed as many torture tools appeared around her. "You are too late! I will kill you this time!"

Zhuxian Sheng hurriedly moved away from Ku Yin as soon as the torture tools moved towards him, but one of them released several chains that shot towards him quickly. "I have to avoid them, or I’ll be damned if I get caught by them."
"Hahaha," Ku Yin laughed as she watched Zhuxian Sheng, but she remained in her spot and continued to observe his movements. ’His speed is indeed almost on par with Su Shentian’s.’
*Boom*
In another area, Jian Kuang was knocked back by the sudden attack of Ku Shan, who was already in his complete demon form, surrounded by various kinds of torture tools. "What a troublesome demon."

"You are indeed strong, but you are still no match for me with that weak body of yours." Ku Shan stretched his hand forward, and hundreds of chains immediately shot toward Jian Kuang, forcing him to run and avoid them. "Haha! You won’t be able to run because they will keep chasing you until they get you!"
Jian Kuang fled as he parried those chains with his sword, and he glanced at Ku Shan, looking for an opening to attack him.

Ku Shan noticed Jian Kuang’s action, and several chains immediately wrapped around his body to protect him. He glanced away and spotted Su Shentian chasing after his subordinates, but he had difficulty following his movements. "He truly deserves his nickname, the Speed Demon."
Ku Shan decided to contact Ku Shenzu, as he was not confident in defeating Jian Kuang, and all of his subordinates would be killed by Su Shentian if he didn’t do something to stop him.
*Clang... Clang...*

"This demon is truly troublesome! I’ve fought him before, but he wasn’t this strong back then. It seems there have been many changes in those demon races, and their strength has increased significantly as a result." Jian Kuang was busy fending off the chains that were chasing him, and he decided to contact Zhang Fei. "That kid should be able to help me get rid of this demon."
Jian Kuang was slightly taken aback by Zhang Fei’s reply, and black flames appeared out of nowhere, shooting towards Ku Shan.

"What?" Ku Shan quickly shielded himself with those chains, but the black lightning immediately hit him and pushed him back several steps. He activated his torture tools and sucked those chains into them, but the black lightning destroyed them. "Shit! Come out!"
"Hehehe," Yao Qilin laughed as she appeared by Jian Kuang’s side. "Your strength has increased significantly, but your mere tools can’t withstand my black lightning."
Ku Shan frowned. "Aren’t you Yao Qilin, one of the ten evil beast generals? Why are you helping humans?"
"No reasons." Yao Qilin’s black lightning immediately struck toward Ku Shan, forcing him to flee. "The two of us will not be able to defeat this male demon."

Jian Kuang nodded at her. "This male demon’s strength has increased considerably compared to the past, and he can also summon Ku Shenzu’s Avatar. If his avatar appears here, we will be in big trouble."

"Yes," Yao Qilin launched her black lightning at Ku Shan again. "My master should be able to defeat him, but he must protect all his wives because the demons of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race will soon arrive in this domain."

"Hmm?" Jian Kuang raised an eyebrow. "The situation will be chaotic if the demons of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race are in this domain, and the tower will become a battleground because the other cultivators are on their way there."
"We don’t need to care about the other cultivators, and we only need to protect the people of our sect and domain."

Jian Kuan sighed softly at Yao Qilin’s words, and he looked to another area, finding Zhuxian Sheng and Fei Lian fighting with Ku Yin. "That female demon’s strength has also increased significantly, and they’re quite overwhelmed by her torture tools."
"Don’t mind them." Yao Qilin flew away. "Let’s fight that male demon first, but we have to leave immediately if he summons Ku Shenzu’s Avatar."
"Alright."
Yao Qilin and Jian Kuang immediately chased after Ku Shan, who swiftly summoned several torture tools to stop them.
"Haha," Ku Yin laughed as she continued attacking Zhuxian Sheng. "I didn’t expect an evil beast like you to help humans fight me, but you two won’t be enough to stop me."

Unlike Zhuxian Sheng, Fei Lian could easily dodge all of Ku Yin’s attacks, but she struggled to find a gap in the female demon’s defenses. All her attacks also served as defenses, and they continued to repel her attacks. "This female demon is troublesome! We have to find a way to penetrate her defenses, or we won’t be able to defeat her."

"Let me try something." Zhuxian Sheng threw his spear into the air, and it dispersed into hundreds before shooting towards Ku Yin, but the chains around the female demons repelled them all. "Her defenses are really strong."
Fei Lian agreed with that before making a few gestures, and black winds quickly covered all the surrounding areas of their battle. "Let’s attack her together."
"Alright."

In another area, Su Shentian didn’t have much difficulty fighting the demons of the Torture Demon Race because they weren’t high-level. He managed to kill a few of them, but most of them immediately fled from him.

Su Shentian looked towards the other two battle areas. "Old Jian and Old Zhuxian seem to be having a tough time fighting those two grand elders, huh? Do I need to help them? Forget it, Yao Qilin and Fei Lian have already helped them, so I don’t need to help them anymore."
Su Shentian immediately chased the demons who fled to another area to avoid him.
"Hey! Did you really not bring any subordinates to this domain?"

"Naturally, my sister and I did not come to this domain ourselves, and I have ordered my subordinates to make their move." Qian Yu glanced at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was walking leisurely a little distance behind them. "For some reason, I feel that the male demon is connected to Jian Kuang and the others, but I can’t prove it."
"Hmm?" Ku Yu also looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Do you think he really has a relationship with them? I don’t know them, but I’ve heard that they dislike demons, especially Zhuxian Sheng."

"For now, it’s just my guess, but you can try to confirm it when you spar with him later." Ku Yu raised an eyebrow for a moment and nodded in agreement with Qian Yu. "Moreover, he’s just a lust demon, so it doesn’t matter if we kill him. Xie Yao and Xie Yan won’t dare complain to our fathers, and they’ll accept his death with resignation."
"Alright! I will try to lure him first, and I will kill him if he really has anything to do with those three people."

Meanwhile, Qian Qin felt increasingly restless as Zhang Xiaolong’s passive lust aura progressively affected her, and his passive absolute beauty tempted her, causing her to want to jump into his arms. Despite this, she still held back the urge within her, but she couldn’t stop stealing glances at him. ’Tch! I’m sure he’s using his lust demon abilities on me, but strangely, I can’t feel him doing anything.’

Zhang Xiaolong [3] didn’t pay attention to Qian Qin, and he thought more about what Qian Yu said earlier. He didn’t know the exact strength of the demon beasts of the Thousand Eyes Demon Race, and he was worried that their appearance would change the situation.

[Master, your other four clones can deal with those demon beasts easily, but I’m afraid you’ll alert Qian Yan if you kill them. He is still in hibernation; he will wake up immediately if he senses the death of his subordinates, and he will use his middle eye ability to check this domain.]

Of all the demon gods who had not yet sided with him, Zhang Xiaolong [3] feared Qian Yan the most. He was a demon beast with terrifying eye abilities, and he could track him anywhere, even from a great distance, including his training space.
’Let’s look at the situation first.’

In the outermost area, dozens of demon beasts appeared, and they immediately transformed into humans, led by two old men. "Our young lord informed me that they are being blocked by Jian Kuang and two other humans, so we must move quickly to reach his location and protect him from those people."
"Let’s move now! Kill all the humans we meet on our way!" The other old man spoke.
"Yes!"
The two old men immediately led all the demon beasts of the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon Race into the forest, but they didn’t see a single human in the area, so they hurried to the next area.
Shortly after they left, Zhang Fei’s four clones and all the people with them reappeared. "Don’t mind them and focus on your training."

"My master should be able to defeat him, but he must protect all his wives because the demons of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race will soon arrive in this domain."
"Hmm?" Jian Kuang raised an eyebrow.
"The situation will be chaotic if the demons of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race are in this domain, and the tower will become a battleground because the other cultivators are on their way there."
"We don’t need to care about the other cultivators, and we only need to protect the people of our sect and domain."
Jian Kuan sighed softly at Yao Qilin’s words, and he looked to another area, finding Zhuxian Sheng and Fei Lian fighting with Ku Yin.
"That female demon’s strength has also increased significantly, and they’re quite overwhelmed by her torture tools."
"Don’t mind them." Yao Qilin flew away.
"Let’s fight that male demon first, but we have to leave immediately if he summons Ku Shenzu’s Avatar."
"Alright."
Yao Qilin and Jian Kuang immediately chased after Ku Shan, who swiftly summoned several torture tools to stop them.
"Haha," Ku Yin laughed as she continued attacking Zhuxian Sheng.
"I didn’t expect an evil beast like you to help humans fight me, but you two won’t be enough to stop me."
Unlike Zhuxian Sheng, Fei Lian could easily dodge all of Ku Yin’s attacks, but she struggled to find a gap in the female demon’s defenses.
All her attacks also served as defenses, and they continued to repel her attacks.
"This female demon is troublesome!
We have to find a way to penetrate her defenses, or we won’t be able to defeat her."
"Let me try something." Zhuxian Sheng threw his spear into the air, and it dispersed into hundreds before shooting towards Ku Yin, but the chains around the female demons repelled them all.
"Her defenses are really strong."
Fei Lian agreed with that before making a few gestures, and black winds quickly covered all the surrounding areas of their battle.
"Let’s attack her together."
"Alright."
In another area, Su Shentian didn’t have much difficulty fighting the demons of the Torture Demon Race because they weren’t high-level.
He managed to kill a few of them, but most of them immediately fled from him.
Su Shentian looked towards the other two battle areas.
"Old Jian and Old Zhuxian seem to be having a tough time fighting those two grand elders, huh?
Do I need to help them?
Forget it, Yao Qilin and Fei Lian have already helped them, so I don’t need to help them anymore."
Su Shentian immediately chased the demons who fled to another area to avoid him.
"Hey!
Did you really not bring any subordinates to this domain?"

"Naturally, my sister and I did not come to this domain ourselves, and I have ordered my subordinates to make their move." Qian Yu glanced at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was walking leisurely a little distance behind them.
"For some reason, I feel that the male demon is connected to Jian Kuang and the others, but I can’t prove it."
"Hmm?" Ku Yu also looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Do you think he really has a relationship with them?
I don’t know them, but I’ve heard that they dislike demons, especially Zhuxian Sheng."
"For now, it’s just my guess, but you can try to confirm it when you spar with him later." Ku Yu raised an eyebrow for a moment and nodded in agreement with Qian Yu.
"Moreover, he’s just a lust demon, so it doesn’t matter if we kill him.
Xie Yao and Xie Yan won’t dare complain to our fathers, and they’ll accept his death with resignation."
"Alright!
I will try to lure him first, and I will kill him if he really has anything to do with those three people."

Meanwhile, Qian Qin felt increasingly restless as Zhang Xiaolong’s passive lust aura progressively affected her, and his passive absolute beauty tempted her, causing her to want to jump into his arms.
Despite this, she still held back the urge within her, but she couldn’t stop stealing glances at him. ’Tch!
I’m sure he’s using his lust demon abilities on me, but strangely, I can’t feel him doing anything.’
Zhang Xiaolong [3] didn’t pay attention to Qian Qin, and he thought more about what Qian Yu said earlier.
He didn’t know the exact strength of the demon beasts of the Thousand Eyes Demon Race, and he was worried that their appearance would change the situation.
[Master, your other four clones can deal with those demon beasts easily, but I’m afraid you’ll alert Qian Yan if you kill them.
He is still in hibernation; he will wake up immediately if he senses the death of his subordinates, and he will use his middle eye ability to check this domain.]
Of all the demon gods who had not yet sided with him, Zhang Xiaolong [3] feared Qian Yan the most.
He was a demon beast with terrifying eye abilities, and he could track him anywhere, even from a great distance, including his training space.
’Let’s look at the situation first.’
In the outermost area, dozens of demon beasts appeared, and they immediately transformed into humans, led by two old men.
"Our young lord informed me that they are being blocked by Jian Kuang and two other humans, so we must move quickly to reach his location and protect him from those people."
"Let’s move now!
Kill all the humans we meet on our way!" The other old man spoke.
"Yes!"
The two old men immediately led all the demon beasts of the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon Race into the forest, but they didn’t see a single human in the area, so they hurried to the next area.
Shortly after they left, Zhang Fei’s four clones and all the people with them reappeared.
"Don’t mind them and focus on your training."

chapters.title: Chapter 1584: Cross Path
paragraphs: Jian Kuang, Zhuxian Sheng, Yao Qilin, and Fei Lian, who were fighting with Ku Shan and Ku Yin, immediately stopped when they received a voice transmission from one of Zhang Fei’s clones. He informed them about the arrival of the demon beasts of the Thousand Eyes Demon Race.
The four exchanged glances for a moment before leaving the area, as did Su Shentian, who had previously been hunting the demons of the Torture Demon Race.
Ku Yin landed beside Ku Shan and asked, "What happened? Why did they suddenly withdraw?"

"Prince Qian Yu asked the demon beasts of the Thousand Eyes Demon Race to come in, and they are on their way here now." Ku Shan looked ahead. "I still didn’t expect that Yao Qilin and Fei Lian would join them, and they deliberately held back their true strength when facing us earlier."
"I agree with you." Ku Yin frowned, realizing something. "Does that mean the four perils decided to join the human race?"

Ku Shan shook his head slightly. "We don’t have clear information about the situation in the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain, so I can’t speculate on that. Moreover, the four perils hate the human race very much, and they would have long since destroyed those weaklings if Long Wuzhao and the others hadn’t stopped them."
"Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, and Tianshi Bailong were too powerful; even our demon god chose to retreat if he met them."

"I will contact our demon god now." After he contacted Ku Shenzu, Ku Shan and Ku Yin immediately moved to catch up with Ku Yu and the others, afraid that Jian Kuang and the others would attack them. I hope our young lord will not meet them, or they will kill him."
"Sigh! I’m not satisfied fighting with Ku Shan yet."
"Haha," Su Shentian laughed at Jian Kuang’s words. "I didn’t expect them to be stronger than in the past, and they could even drive you guys into a corner."

Zhuxian Sheng agreed with him. "I don’t know what Ku Shenzu gave them, but their strength has nearly doubled compared to the past. If Fei Lian hadn’t helped me, I might have been injured by Ku Yin’s torture tools."

"Ku Shan’s strength has also increased greatly, and his improvement is faster than ours. If we continue to slack off, we might not be able to face those demons anymore." Jian Kuang looked towards the tower. "Since the people from our sect have arrived at the tower, we will go there now, and we will focus on increasing our strength there."
"Where are the two female beasts? Why aren’t they joining us?"
"Zhang Fei assigned them to protect all his wives, so they probably went back there while monitoring the movements of those demon beasts."
"What about the three young demons?"
"Leave them to Zhang Fei; he must have plans for them."
"Let’s speed up! We have to reach the tower as soon as possible."
Meanwhile, Yao Qilin and Fei Lian had returned to the previous area, awaiting the arrival of the demon beasts of the Thousand Eyes Demon Race.
"Do you think Ku Shenzu used something to enhance the strength of his two grand elders?"

Yao Qilin nodded. "I’m sure Ku Shenzu used something to strengthen them; otherwise, Ku Yu and Ku Shan’s strength wouldn’t have increased significantly compared to the last time we fought them, but I can’t guess what kind of method he used on them."

"They must have contacted Ku Shenzu, and that vile demon god must have tried to contact the four perils. Fortunately, they were still trapped in the tunnel, and Dong Xuanyin helped us to monitor the movements of their avatars."
"Here they come." Yao Qilin and Fei Lian looked at the group of demon beasts of the Thousand Eyes Demon Race, who were moving hastily. "Qian Hufeng and Qian Kuang."
"They are Qian Yan’s right and left hands, right?"

"Yes," Yao Qilin observed them. "Just like Ku Shan and Ku Yin, the strength of those two demon beasts has also increased significantly, and their strength is as high as ours. Even so, they won’t be able to fight me because my beast bloodline is higher than theirs, and I can suppress them easily."
Fei Lian naturally knew that. "Unfortunately, we can’t make a move on them because Qian Yan will find out our actions, and he will lock onto our location using his middle eye ability."

Qian Hufeng and Qian Kuang noticed the presence of Yao Qilin and Fei Lian in that area, but they just nodded to the two women and led the group of demon beasts of the Thousand Eyes Demon Race to the next area directly. Despite this, both of them wondered about the presence of the two female evil beasts in that place, as their demon god didn’t tell them that that race had also come to that domain.
After they left, Yao Qilin and Fei Lian immediately left that area to return to the first one.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the three demons had already arrived at the next area, but they encountered people from the War God Pavilion, led by Dugu Qingshu and two old men.
Unlike the calm Zhang Xiaolong [3], Ku Yu, Qian Yu, and Qian Qin were quite tense facing the people from the War God Pavilion, especially the two old men beside Dugu Qingshu.
"Should we fight them?" Ku Yu asked Qian Yu.
Qian Yu did not answer directly and observed those people. "The strength of those two old men is on par with your two grand elders, and we will definitely die if we fight with them."
"Brother." Qian Yu nodded to Qian Qin, who seemed frightened of the two old men. "They are too strong for us."
"I know."

On the other hand, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was busy reading the statuses of the people from the War God Pavilion, especially the statuses of the two old men. ’Dugu Nanshan and Dugu Qingwen should be elders of the sect since their cultivation has already reached the 2-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm.’
’They are indeed elders of the War God Pavilion, but they are no less powerful than Dugu Yuanshen. If they use their secret techniques, they should be able to defeat Ku Shan and Ku Yin easily.’
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded slightly in response to Feng Yao. ’Do you think they will attack Qian Qin and the others?’

’The people from the War God Pavilion hate demons very much, but I doubt they will attack the three demons, especially Qian Yu and Qian Qin. They know their father’s power well, and they will think twice about provoking Qian Yan’s anger.’
’Let’s see their decision.’
"Elders."
Dugu Nanshan and Dugu Qingwen nodded to Dugu Qingshu. "The demon in front is the prince of the Torture Demon Race. The other two are the prince and princess of the Thousand Eyes Demon Race."
"We’re not afraid of Ku Shenzu, but Qian Yan’s abilities and strength are terrifying. Even if we use our secret techniques, we might not be able to survive his attack."
"So, shall we let them go, Elders?"
Dugu Qingwen nodded at him. "We don’t need to attack them as long as they don’t bother us, or we’ll face serious trouble if Qian Yan discovers our domain and attacks us."
"Let’s go." Dugu Nanshan led their people away from that place.
"Phew." Qian Qin patted her chest after they left. "I originally thought they were going to attack us."

"They probably didn’t dare attack us because they were afraid of facing our father’s wrath." Qian Yu glanced at Zhang Xiaolong [3] but was a little surprised to see him so calm. "Aren’t you worried that they will attack you?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head. "If I were alone, I would have been scared and run away. However, the three of you are with me now, and I don’t think they will dare attack us because of your presence."

"Haha," Ku Yu laughed at that. "Those people are indeed afraid of my father and Demon God Qian Yan, so they won’t dare attack us. We should wait for the others to arrive here, or we will face serious problems if we have to face those cultivators."
"Alright."
"How about we spar now while we wait for them?"
’Tch! This guy!’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] said to Ku Yu, and the two immediately exchanged blows.
*Boom*
Qian Yu and Qian Qin were stunned when they saw Ku Shu being pushed back by Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s punch.
"Damn it!" Ku Yu cursed after he stabilized himself, waving his right hand. "Your punch was really hard! You weren’t even pushed back by the impact of my punch!"

Even though Zhang Xiaolong [3] could restrain his strength, he couldn’t hide his body strength. "I’m a body cultivator, so it’s natural that my body is much stronger. Moreover, we didn’t use our cultivation or techniques, or I would have lost to you instantly if we had used both."

"Let’s do it again." Ku Yu dashed towards Zhang Xiaolong [3], and they quickly exchanged attacks, but the male demon was not pushed back like before. "You are a lust demon, but your strength is far superior to the others."
"I’m practicing hard." Zhang Xiaolong [3] accelerated his attacks immediately, pushing Ku Yu back. "This is my maximum speed, and I can’t move any faster than this."
"Haha!" Ku Yu laughed as he parried and counterattacked Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Qian Yu and Qian Qin, who were watching their spar from the side, wondered in their hearts about Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s true strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 1585: Enemies Arrival
paragraphs: When Ku Shan and Ku Yin arrived at the area, they saw that the conditions there had become a mess, with many holes and fallen trees, which were the result of the fight between Ku Yu and Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"Even though they were fighting solely on physical strength and speed, this young demon is truly impressive, being able to keep up with our young lord," Ku Yin murmured as she followed the two’s movements.

"Yes," Ku Shan agreed with her. "Our young lord clearly has the advantage in speed, but the young demon has a strong physique due to his body cultivation. If his speed were comparable to his physical strength, I think our young lord would lose to him."

Ku Yin nodded slightly. "If I think about it again, this young demon’s fighting ability is much better than Xie Yao’s and Xie Yan’s. Perhaps he will become the leader of the lust demon race in their place in the future, and their race will probably become even stronger under his leadership."
"Xie Yan and Xie Yao are demon gods, but they are both cowards, and they value sex more than improving their abilities."
"Hahaha! They are lust demons, so I think it’s natural that they place more importance on sex."
"How long have they been fighting, Prince Qian?"

"Since we arrived in this area," Qian Yu turned to Ku Shan. "Since the beginning of their spar, Ku Yu has been unable to gain the upper hand, and Xie Xiaolong has never failed to thwart his attacks. His fighting ability made me think he’s been training far longer than his age; otherwise, he wouldn’t be so skilled at such a young age."

"You’re right, Prince Qian." Ku Shan nodded slightly. "I don’t know how that young demon trains, but I feel that he hasn’t displayed his full strength yet, and he may be stronger than Xie Yao and Xie Yan."
"I think the same as you." Qian Yu thought for a moment. "Do you think he deliberately approached us to spy on us?"

"Why do you think like that, Prince Qian?" Qian Yu explained to the two grand elders that his sister had strange feelings about Zhang Xiaolong [3], but the two old demons were doubtful. "That young demon might still be hiding his true strength, but he’s still not our opponent, so I’m not sure about your suspicions about him. Moreover, Jian Kuang and the others have never liked demons, so I find it hard to believe that he has any connections with them."

Then, Ku Yin spoke. "Prince Qian, I know you’re vigilant for good, but I believe that the young demon has nothing to do with them. His fighting prowess is indeed extraordinary for a demon of his level, but the two of us can still kill him easily, so you don’t need to worry about him. Moreover, Qian Hufeng and Qian Kuang are on their way here, and the four of us can protect the three of you from other cultivators."

"I know." Even though Ku Shan and Ku Yin said that, Qian Yu still had suspicions in his heart, as he was sure that his sister’s feelings would not be wrong. He looked at Qian Qin, who continued to stare at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. ’Did something happen to my sister? Did that lust demon use his abilities on her?’
*Thud*
They looked at Qian Hufeng and Qian Kuang, who had just arrived. "Prince, we’re a little late."
"It’s okay." Qian Yu thought for a moment. "Grand Elders, I want you two to focus on protecting my sister and keeping an eye on the young lust demon who is sparring with Ku Yu."

Qian Hufeng and Qian Kuang looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was running to avoid Ku Yu. "His cultivation is only at the Celestial Emperor Realm, but his speed is much faster than cultivators at his level."
"His physical strength is also on par with or surpasses Xie Yao and Xie Yan." Then, Qian Kuang asked. "Where did you meet him, Prince?"
Ku Shan explained to them directly. "He approached us when we had just entered the second area, but we have already confirmed that he is a subordinate of the two lust demon gods."
"I see," Qian Hufeng spoke to Qian Yu. "Prince, you don’t need to mind that young demon, and we will kill him if he tries to do anything to you and the princess."
"Alright, I’ll leave him to you two, and you must kill him immediately if he shows any suspicious behavior." Qian Yu walked to his sister’s side. "What happened to you? Why do you keep watching him?"

Qian Qin told her brother directly about what she experienced, causing Qian Yu to raise an eyebrow. "However, I didn’t see him use his lust demon abilities, so I feel doubtful about my suspicions, Brother."
"Hmm?" Qian Yu looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I myself never detected that he was using his lust demon abilities, so where did the feeling you felt come from?"
"I don’t know." Qian Qin clutched her chest, feeling her heartbeat quicken. "Brother, we have to stop them and get to the tower as soon as possible."

Qian Yu nodded slightly. "Hey, Ku Yu! Stop your sparring right now! We’ve wasted too much time, and those human cultivators have already escaped into the tower; otherwise, it’ll be even more difficult for us to capture them."

Hearing that, Ku Yu and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately stopped fighting and both returned to their sides. "Grand Elder Qian Hufeng and Grand Elder Qian Kuang, you two have finally arrived, so we don’t have to fear Jian Kuang and the other two anymore."

"Hmm?" Ku Shan explained to the two about Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng. "Heh! They’re strong, but they wouldn’t dare fight us. Compared to them, the people from the War God Pavilion are scarier, especially Dugu Yuanshen."
"Prince Ku, you don’t need to think about those three people, and we will kill them if they attack you again."
Ku Yu nodded to them. "Let’s go to the tower now."

They immediately moved to the next area, with the two grand elders of the Torture Demon Race walking in front and the two grand elders of the Thousand Demon Race guarding the rear. Ku Yu, Qian Yu, and Qian Qin walked amidst them, as did Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Qian Hufeng and Qian Kuang continued to pay attention to Zhang Xiaolong [3] according to Qian Yu’s request, and the two of them talked about him via voice transmission.

Sometime later, they arrived beneath the Tower of Eternity, but they saw no one there. They suspected that Jian Kuang and the others had deliberately alerted those people of their arrival, so they hid inside the tower.
"We should go straight to the tower and capture them while we complete the first-floor challenge."
"I’m sorry, but I won’t go to the tower because my two leaders just asked me to return to the Endless Domain." They looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in surprise.
"Hey! Our spar isn’t finished yet, so you have to stay here," Ku Yu shouted.
Unlike him, Qian Yu wanted Zhang Xiaolong [3] to leave because his sister was becoming uncomfortable with his presence. "Since they asked you to return, you can leave now, or they’ll punish you."
"You—" Ku Shan grabbed Ku Yu’s shoulder and stopped him. "Fine! I’ll look for you in the Endless Domain after I get back from this damn tower!"
"I’ll wait for you there." Thereafter, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately ran away from them. ’Heh! The game isn’t over yet.’
Qian Qin felt relieved after Zhang Xiaolong [3] left, but the strange feeling hadn’t disappeared.
"Let’s enter now." They immediately flew toward the tower and landed at the entrance. ’Sigh! I hope this feeling will disappear soon.’
"Let’s enter now."
When they arrived inside, their expressions changed immediately when they saw Li Guangyu and the people from the Divine Samsara Sect. "Looks like today is our lucky day."
Ku Shan nodded. "Li Guangyu is the vice sect master of the Divine Samsara Sect, so we must capture him. Most of the elders from the sect are also here, so we’ll take care of them all at once."
"Hey! Look over there." They looked in the direction Ku Yin was pointing. "Isn’t that woman Empress Huo?"
Their expressions turned to horror when they saw Feng Yao in the distance. "Shit! Why is that vile woman in this tower? She’s even more vile than us demons."
"What should we do now? If we attack these humans, that vile woman will move to stop us."

"I think we should postpone our plans, and we’ll wait for that vile woman to climb to the second floor first." Qian Hufeng looked around. "Once she’s gone, no one will be able to stop us from capturing these humans, and we’ll use them as pawns against the Celestial Demon Race."
They agreed with Qian Hufeng, so they waited at a safe distance. "Let’s wait and observe the situation."
Qian Qin felt confused as the strange feeling grew stronger, even though Zhang Xiaolong [3] was not with them, and she could not recognize Zhang Fei, who was by Feng Yao’s side.

Meanwhile, Ku Yu’s gaze was focused on Luo Yunxiao and Helian Xun’er, who were slightly behind Zhang Fei. He licked his lips. ’I must capture those two women! Their whimpers as I torture them will definitely be melodious.’
"Husband."
Zhang Fei nodded to Luo Yunxiao. "You don’t need to think about them and focus on reaching the second floor as soon as possible."

sentences.text: When Ku Shan and Ku Yin arrived at the area, they saw that the conditions there had become a mess, with many holes and fallen trees, which were the result of the fight between Ku Yu and Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"Even though they were fighting solely on physical strength and speed, this young demon is truly impressive, being able to keep up with our young lord," Ku Yin murmured as she followed the two’s movements.
"Yes," Ku Shan agreed with her.
"Our young lord clearly has the advantage in speed, but the young demon has a strong physique due to his body cultivation.
If his speed were comparable to his physical strength, I think our young lord would lose to him."
Ku Yin nodded slightly.

"Xie Yan and Xie Yao are demon gods, but they are both cowards, and they value sex more than improving their abilities."
"Hahaha!
They are lust demons, so I think it’s natural that they place more importance on sex."
"How long have they been fighting, Prince Qian?"
"Since we arrived in this area," Qian Yu turned to Ku Shan.
"Since the beginning of their spar, Ku Yu has been unable to gain the upper hand, and Xie Xiaolong has never failed to thwart his attacks.
His fighting ability made me think he’s been training far longer than his age; otherwise, he wouldn’t be so skilled at such a young age."
"You’re right, Prince Qian." Ku Shan nodded slightly.
"I don’t know how that young demon trains, but I feel that he hasn’t displayed his full strength yet, and he may be stronger than Xie Yao and Xie Yan."
"I think the same as you." Qian Yu thought for a moment.
"Do you think he deliberately approached us to spy on us?"
"Why do you think like that, Prince Qian?" Qian Yu explained to the two grand elders that his sister had strange feelings about Zhang Xiaolong [3], but the two old demons were doubtful.
"That young demon might still be hiding his true strength, but he’s still not our opponent, so I’m not sure about your suspicions about him.
Moreover, Jian Kuang and the others have never liked demons, so I find it hard to believe that he has any connections with them."
Then, Ku Yin spoke.
"Prince Qian, I know you’re vigilant for good, but I believe that the young demon has nothing to do with them.
His fighting prowess is indeed extraordinary for a demon of his level, but the two of us can still kill him easily, so you don’t need to worry about him.
Moreover, Qian Hufeng and Qian Kuang are on their way here, and the four of us can protect the three of you from other cultivators."

He looked at Qian Qin, who continued to stare at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. ’Did something happen to my sister?
Did that lust demon use his abilities on her?’

They looked at Qian Hufeng and Qian Kuang, who had just arrived.
"Prince, we’re a little late."
"It’s okay." Qian Yu thought for a moment.
"Grand Elders, I want you two to focus on protecting my sister and keeping an eye on the young lust demon who is sparring with Ku Yu."
Qian Hufeng and Qian Kuang looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was running to avoid Ku Yu.
"His cultivation is only at the Celestial Emperor Realm, but his speed is much faster than cultivators at his level."
"His physical strength is also on par with or surpasses Xie Yao and Xie Yan." Then, Qian Kuang asked.
"Where did you meet him, Prince?"
Ku Shan explained to them directly.
"He approached us when we had just entered the second area, but we have already confirmed that he is a subordinate of the two lust demon gods."
"I see," Qian Hufeng spoke to Qian Yu.
"Prince, you don’t need to mind that young demon, and we will kill him if he tries to do anything to you and the princess."
"Alright, I’ll leave him to you two, and you must kill him immediately if he shows any suspicious behavior." Qian Yu walked to his sister’s side.
"What happened to you?
Why do you keep watching him?"
Qian Qin told her brother directly about what she experienced, causing Qian Yu to raise an eyebrow.
"However, I didn’t see him use his lust demon abilities, so I feel doubtful about my suspicions, Brother."
"Hmm?" Qian Yu looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"I myself never detected that he was using his lust demon abilities, so where did the feeling you felt come from?"
"I don’t know." Qian Qin clutched her chest, feeling her heartbeat quicken.
"Brother, we have to stop them and get to the tower as soon as possible."
Qian Yu nodded slightly.

Stop your sparring right now!
We’ve wasted too much time, and those human cultivators have already escaped into the tower; otherwise, it’ll be even more difficult for us to capture them."

Compared to them, the people from the War God Pavilion are scarier, especially Dugu Yuanshen."
