chapters.title: Chapter 1586: Reinforcements
paragraphs: Nalan Wangzhi also didn’t expect that demons from both races would come to the Tower of Eternity, but they couldn’t recognize her because Zhang Fei used some of his abilities to disguise her.
"Demons always bring trouble wherever we go." Helian Xun’er said with a shake of her head.
Qing Qiu’er asked him. "Husband, are you going to do something about them?"
"If you don’t do something, they will definitely capture our people, Husband," You Feiling spoke to him.

"Naturally, I won’t let our people fall into their hands, but I won’t move now. Those demons won’t be able to capture them that easily, and they will also have to face all these challenges. For now, we leave their protection to Jian Kuang and the others, and I will move when the time comes."
"Do I need to ask my emperor for help?" Tianshi Shengji asked.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei thought for a moment before turning to Feng Yao, who agreed with that. "Contact him now, and one of my clones will pick them up."
"Alright." Tianshi Shengjie immediately contacted Long Wuzhao and the others, informing them about the arrival of the two demon races.
Zhang Fei glanced at Qian Qin, who looked irritated in front of the entrance. ’Since I can’t enter your domain, I will use you to supervise your father’s moves and plans.’
"You can pick them up now."
"Alright."
Yue Xuelian and the people from the Celestial Moon Sect increased their vigilance as soon as they saw the two demon races.

’Crap! Why did they have to come here today? Moreover, Zhang Fei said that demons from the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race are also on their way to this domain, and they will definitely wreak havoc in the tower.’ Yue Qianrou looked at Yue Xuelian, who had already reached an area a little far away from her. ’What should we do, Big Sis?’

Yue Xuelian signaled her not to worry. ’For now, pay attention to their movements and move away from them. They don’t dare to enter because of Empress Huo’s presence, but they will enter as soon as she goes up to the second floor.’
’Is Empress Huo going to save us from them?’
’She hasn’t said anything, but I believe she will never let you guys fall into the hands of the demons.’
Despite Yue Xuelian’s words, Yue Qianrou and the female elders couldn’t calm down, and they repeatedly looked at the demons, especially Ku Yu, who looked eager to capture them.
’Don’t worry, I won’t leave you guys here, and I will wait for you to reach my position.’ Yue Qianrou and the female elders nodded to Yue Xuelian.
Lu Shaqing and Gong Wei also ordered the people from the Spring Zenith Sect to be wary of the demons’ movements, especially after the two of them received a voice message from Zhang Fei.
’We have to be careful with those demons, Shaqing.’
Lu Shaqing nodded to Gong Wei. ’Based on the information from Zhang Fei, they intend to capture all the humans in this tower and use them as pawns against the Celestial Demon Race.’
’Sigh.’ Lu Shaqing sighed inwardly. ’Let’s focus on all these challenges as we monitor their movements.’

Although Jian Kuang and the others were protecting them, Qiu Yue and the people from the Moonlit Passion Temple were also wary of the movements of the two demon races, as they knew that any sudden attack could jeopardize their safety.

"Hey! You guys don’t need to think about those demons and focus on these challenges." Jian Kuang spoke to the people from the Moonlit Passion Temple. "We won’t let them get close to you, and that kid will definitely move if they move."
Zhuxian Sheng also spoke to them. "Even though we are protecting all of you, you guys must not lower your guard and prepare for the worst."
"As long as you don’t lower your guard, we’ll be fine." They nodded to the three men before stepping forward for the next challenge.
Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi were also worried about the presence of demons, especially since they had come to the domain just the two of them.

"What do you think if we join forces with Zhang Fei?" Wang Jingzhi looked at her brother. "Those demons clearly do not have good intentions, and four among them are the grand elders of the two demon races. We won’t be able to win against them with just the two of us, and I think our best option is to join him since Empress Huo is in his group."
Wang Jingzhi looked at Zhang Fei and the others before making a decision. "Let’s go there."
"Let’s go." As soon as the two of them stepped forward, Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi were immediately transported to another area.

Li Guangyu immediately ordered all members of the Divine Samsara Sect to be on alert, especially after he recognized the four demon grand elders. He focused completely on protecting their core disciples, and he asked the elders to protect the other disciples.
"What should we do now, Vice Sect Master?"

Li Guangyu looked at Wang Tieshan. "I’ve already contacted our sect master for backup, and Ancestor Ningxue is already on her way to this domain, but they won’t be arriving anytime soon. Moreover, those demons are clearly frightened by Empress Huo’s presence in this tower, and I’m sure they won’t move as long as she remains on the first floor. We have to make the most of the time we have, and we have to reach the second floor before she goes there."
Wang Tieshan and the disciples of the Divine Samsara Sect looked at Feng Yao, then at the group of demons.
"Let’s go now."
"Yes,"

"Sometimes I feel that my void element is inferior to all your cheats, Kid," Long Xukong said as one of Zhang Fei’s clones brought him and the other two into the domain. "You don’t have the void element, but you can move between all domains at will."
"Haha," Zhang Fei [1] laughed at that. "That is the main advantage of the heavenly fox race, Senior."
Tianshi Bailong looked towards the Tower of Eternity. "Have all the demons gathered at the tower, Kid?"

"For now, the demons from the Torture Demon Race and the Thousand Eyes Demon Race are already there, but they don’t dare to enter because of Feng Yao’s presence. However, the demons from the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race will arrive in this domain soon, so the situation in the tower will be chaotic because of their presence."
Long Wuzhao looked at him. "You must have prepared protection for your people, right?"

"Hehe," Zhang Fei [1] chuckled. "You can always guess my plans, Emperor Long. I’ve already sent my other three clones to the tower, and those demons are unaware of their presence. As for all my wives in the first area, my second clone and I will protect them. Besides, Yao Qilin and Fei Lian are also with us, and I’m sure we can stop the demons from the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race."
Long Wuzhao nodded at him. "In that case, I’ll hand them over to you, and the three of us will go straight to the tower."
"Yes."
"Do you want those women, Young Lord?"
"Haha," Ku Yu laughed and pointed to several women there, especially Luo Yunxiao, Helian Xun’er, and Yue Xuelian. "I want those three women, and I want to listen to their whimpers as I torture them."

Ku Shan and Ku Yin looked at the three women. "Oh? If I recall correctly, one of them is the Sect Master of the Celestial Moon Sect, Young Lord. If we can capture her, you can torture all the women in her sect as you please."

"However, you have to be careful because one of the ancestors of that sect was one of the founders of the Divine Samsara Sect, and I heard that that woman was truly powerful." Ku Yu looked at Ku Shan. "Her name is Yue Ningxue, and her ice element is quite terrifying. Her ice will cause your body to freeze from the inside out, and no one can save you, including your father."
"Oh? That woman’s abilities are that terrifying, huh?"
"Young Lord, Yue Ningxue’s ice element is one of the most terrifying I’ve ever encountered, and only two women can surpass her."
"Who are those two women?"
"Feng Shizhu and Feng Bingying of the Ice Phoenix Race are the possessors of the deadliest ice element in this Paradise Realm."
Ku Yu nodded slightly. "I’ve never met those two women, but my father once warned me not to mess with them."
"If you meet those two women, you should immediately run away from them, Young Lord."
"Yeah."
A little away from them, Qian Yu kept watching his sister’s expression, and he followed her gaze. "Why are you looking at that man?"

"That man is the partner of all the women I detected in the first area, Brother." Qian Yu narrowed his eyes towards Zhang Fei. "His Yang Qi is in the bodies of all the women there, so I’m sure he is their partner. All the women with him in this place are also his partners, including the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race."
"Are you sure the Celestial Dragon Race is also his partner?"

Qian Qin nodded at him. "She’s still a virgin, but his Yang Qi is inside her body, so I’m sure she’s one of his partners. Moreover, he also seems to have a special closeness with Empress Huo, so we must be careful of him."
"I know." Qian Yu continued to stare at Zhang Fei. "The Heavenly Fiend Demon Race will arrive soon."

chapters.title: Chapter 1587: Heavenly Fiend Demons’ Arrival
paragraphs: In the Divine Samsara Sect, Liang Huizhong had gathered several people and informed them of the presence of the two demon races in the Tower of Eternity. He immediately took out the fastest flying artifact of their sect and took them away to the Glazed Heaven Domain at full speed.
"Do you think we won’t be late, Sect Master?"
"Even if we use this flying artifact, we won’t arrive at the domain in two to three weeks at the earliest, and the demons might already make their move against our sect members."

Liang Huizhong looked at the two people. "Li Guangyu previously told me that Empress Huo is in the tower, and her cultivation has already reached the Celestial God Realm. Since her cultivation is already on par with Qian Yan and Ku Shenzu, I’m sure the demons of the two demon races won’t dare to act recklessly in front of her, and that will give us plenty of time to arrive at the domain."
"Is Empress Huo escorting people from the Moonlit Passion Temple? When she returned to this realm the first time, she announced that the sect was under her protection."
"Empress Huo is indeed protecting the sect’s people, and there are still some other powerful cultivators among them."
"Who?"

"I heard that not only did the three of them join the sect, but several other powerful clans, such as the Liao and Zhang Clans, also joined them."

"Zhang Fei not only strengthened the sect by recruiting them, but he also strengthened the Twin Flames Domain by setting up numerous formations there, which are difficult for anyone, including our ancestors, to penetrate. "I still find it hard to believe that a young cultivator like him managed to obtain Empress Huo’s heart, but news about them had already spread widely when his new sect opened."

"Before the great changes in this realm, I once heard a rumor that Hun Lingwu tried to do something to some of the women in the sect. He asked for help from people from the Stygian Dusk Domain, but they ended up dying for no apparent reason."

"The Celestial Demon Race?"

"Do you think Empress Huo can defeat Mo Shentian?"

"We don’t need to worry about her, and she will never attack us as long as we don’t cause trouble for her or her subordinates."
"Yes."

"Hmm?" Qian Yu looked in that direction before nodding. "Let’s go! We’ll move away from that area so we don’t have to clash directly with Empress Huo and the people from the Moonlit Passion Sect."

"Qin, you have to be careful if those challenges send us to other places."
"I know, Brother."
After they reached their chosen area, they immediately began their challenges, and some of them were sent to other places, including Qian Qin.

Yue Xuelian felt embarrassed when Feng Yao and the others looked at her, but her heart pounded wildly as she recalled her impulsive act of kissing Zhang Fei years ago and all his activities with his women in the pavilion. "I’ll continue now."

Yue Xuelian was sent to another place as soon as she stepped forward, making them laugh with her antics. Luo Yunxiao, Helian Xun’er, Nalan Wangzhi, and Tianshi Shengjie also continued their challenge, and the four of them were also sent to other areas.

Feng Yao tilted her head to the side. "Has Qian Qin fallen deeply into the influence of your abilities?"

"Not yet." Zhang Fei shook his head at her. "That princess has been affected by them, but her mental strength is much higher than most women, including Yue Xuelian, so it will still take me some time to bring her down."
Feng Yao nodded in understanding. "Since your three clones are already here, you must reach the second floor as soon as possible, and I’m sure those challenges won’t be able to stop you."
"How about you?"
"I will wait here to protect your people and the other two sects, so you don’t need to mind me."
"I’ll leave their protection to you." Zhang Fei immediately stepped forward and the heavy gravity pulled him down, but it was of no use, and he was able to pass through it easily.
Outside the forest, a flying artifact landed there, and ten demons descended from it, led by two young demons.
"Grand Elder Sha Huoran, have the two demon races arrived in this domain?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1588: Fighting Demons
paragraphs: Sha Huoran pointed to the Tower of Eternity. "Prince Sha Mo, Ku Shan contacted me earlier and told me that they were already at the tower, and the people from the Divine Samsara Sect were also there. However, he also told me that they met Empress Huo there, and she seemed to be protecting the people from the Moonlit Passion Temple."
"Oh?" Sha Huo turned to him. "Is Empress Huo really there? I’ve heard that she protects the Moonlit Passion Temple, but I didn’t expect her to be in this domain."
"Based on the information provided by Ku Shan, Empress Huo is indeed in the tower, Prince."
"In that case, we have to go to the tower now to join them, and we will capture all the members of the Divine Samsara Sect." Sha Huo immediately led them into the first area of the forest.

"Why do we have to capture those humans, Brother?" Sha Huo looked at his sister, Sha Qingge, and explained their father’s plan to her. "Sigh! Why can’t our demon race ever be at peace? Why do we have to attack other races?"

Sha Qingge had a delicate oval face and large, almond-shaped eyes, with a slightly alluring gaze emanating from her dark brown pupils. She wore a sleeveless purple dress with gold decorative accents. Her long, dark brown hair cascades down her shoulders and back. She has a curvy yet well-proportioned figure. Her waist was slender. The neckline of her dress accentuated her slightly exposed big breasts. Her hips were soft and rounded, with long, slender legs.

Sha Huo embraced her shoulders. "Qingge, I also want our demon race to be safe and peaceful, just like you. However, we both know that our lives will never be peaceful as long as human cultivators continue to hunt our members, especially those from the Divine Samsara Sect, who have killed so many of our race in the past. Besides, we have to face constant pressure from Mo Shentian, so we will capture them and use them as sacrifices against him and his race members."

"Didn’t the people from the Divine Samsara Sect kill our demon race members because we attacked them first?" Sha Qingge asked. "If our father hadn’t ordered his subordinates to attack their sect members, we would never have had a problem with them."
The eight demons behind them shook their heads at Sha Qingge’s naivety, and Sha Huoran spoke to her directly. "Princess, you are too naive about this matter."
"Hmm?" Sha Qingge frowned at him.

Sha Huoran explained to her. "The conflict between our demon and the human races is not solely due to your father’s ambition; it has persisted for a long time. In fact, our Heavenly Fiend Demon Race never attacked them before, and our race only cared about our personal affairs. They attacked us first and many members of our race died at their hands because they considered us heretic creatures. After they founded the Divine Samsara Sect, relations between the two races became increasingly worse. Since then, our demon gods from the past have vowed to destroy them, which makes the conflict between us continue until this era."

"Princess, you may not believe it, but humans started the animosity between the two races." Sha Qingge looked at an old female demon named Sha Minglan. "Humans are the most selfish and greedy living creatures, and they will do anything to fulfill their ambitions, including suppressing other humans or other races. In fact, demons are not the only ones who hate humans, but all races really hate them, including beasts, demihumans, and natural races. As for the winged race, they are much worse than the human race, and they always attack us for unclear reasons, even though we don’t do anything bad."
"Isn’t the enmity between demons and winged races based on an old story? If I remember correctly, it all started with the first ancestors of both races, right?"

"Yes." Sha Huoran nodded to her. "I myself don’t know the origins of the conflict between the demons and the winged races or its causes, but this enmity has existed since the time of our first ancestors, and it has been passed down to the present generation."
"So, of all the races that exist now, our main enemy is the winged race, right?"
"That’s right." Sha Huoran nodded to her. "However, we cannot forget the Divine Samsara Sect, and they are our main enemy among the human race."
"Then, why do we want to capture other humans who have no connection to the sect if they have no problem with us?"
"Princess."

"Stop." Sha Huoran stopped Sha Minglan when they arrived at the first area, and he looked around them. "Come out! I can’t see you guys, but I know you’re all hiding here using your camouflage technique from your scents."
Sha Minglan and the other six demons lined up and surrounded Sha Mo and Sha Qingge to protect them, as they also sensed the presence of dozens of people in the area.
"Haha."
Sha Huoran and the others were alert after hearing the laughter, and they immediately mobilized their strength to face the unexpected attack.
Sha Huoran frowned when Zhang Fei [1], Fei Lian, and Yao Qilin appeared in front of them. "Fei Lian and Yao Qilin, the Evil beast generals?"
"You seem to still remember me, Sha Huoran." Yao Qilin said with a smile, causing the old male demon to shudder. "Do you still remember our last fight a thousand years ago?"
"Tch." Sha Huoran tightly clenched his jaw. "What do you two want from us?"
"We don’t want anything from you." Fei Lian pointed at Zhang Fei [1]. "Our husband forbids you from going to the tower."
Sha Huoran and the others looked at Zhang Fei [1], but they frowned because his cultivation was clearly far below that of the two evil beasts.

Sha Huo observed Zhang Fei [1] seriously, but he was certain they had never met before. Sha Qingge also looked at him, but she was confused because he was a weak human, yet the two female evil beasts addressed him as their husband.
Zhang Fei [1] activated his soul link and borrowed the strengths of other evil beasts in his beast space, increasing his strength to equal Sha Huoran’s.

Sha Huo and the others were completely shocked by Zhang Fei [1]’s increased strength, and they were even more shocked by the appearance of Feltia [2] not far from them, especially since the two were on par in strength.
"Brother," Sha Qingge said as she hugged Sha Mo’s arm.

Sha Huo didn’t blame his sister for being afraid of them, as he himself was worried about his safety. Although there were eight powerful demons protecting them, Sha Huoran was the only one who could stand up to Zhang Fei [1] and the others. "He must have used a special technique to increase his strength; otherwise, he wouldn’t have become so strong with his cultivation still at the Celestial Lord Realm."

"Protect our prince and princess." Sha Minglan and the others nodded to Sha Huoran, but they were not confident in facing Zhang Fei [1] and the other three. "What do you mean by interfering in our business?"
Zhang Fei [1] disappeared from his spot, and Sha Huoran was sent flying quite far back in the next instant, shocking Sha Huo and the others.
Sha Huoran hurriedly kicked a large tree behind him to stop, but Zhang Fei [1] instantly appeared in front of him and launched an attack with his fist.
*Boom*

Sha Huoran slammed into the tree behind him after he blocked Zhang Fei [1]’s punch, which made both his hands numb. ’What a monster! What kind of technique did he use to increase his strength to surpass mine?’

Sha Huo and the others were shocked to see that, and they were even more shocked when Zhang Fei [1] reappeared and kicked Sha Huoran without him being able to dodge, sending him flying in the other direction.

"Shit!" Sha Huoran himself felt quite pained by Zhang Fei [1]’s two attacks just now, but he immediately transformed into his demon form, which made his strength increase even higher. "I never thought I would have to use this form to face a human like you."
Zhang Fei [1] jumped onto a tree branch behind him. "Although your strength has increased significantly, my strength is still above yours. If you think I’m boasting, we can exchange blows now."
"Heh! I’ll see how long you can use your strengthening technique!"
Sha Huoyan and Zhang Fei [1] moved simultaneously, and the two exchanged blows in midair.
*Boom*
"Gah!" Sha Huoyan rolled back several times after that, but he immediately stabilized himself and launched himself towards Zhang Fei [1] again. "I will kill you, human!"
Quickly, Zhang Fei [1] and Sha Huoran fought in the air, but Sha Mo and the others could see that the former’s speed surpassed their grand elder’s.
"Brother."

Sha Huo nodded to his sister. "I wouldn’t have believed a human could match our grand elder’s strength if I hadn’t seen it for myself. Moreover, the human’s speed was incredible, and our grand elder could not keep up with it."
"Prince, I will help our grand elder fight that human." Sha Minglan moved towards them, but Feltia [2] instantly intercepted her and kicked her. "Gah!"
Sha Minglan slid to the ground, but she quickly stabilized herself before hitting the ground. Feltia [2] instantly appeared in front of her, and he attacked her again.
With Feltia [2]’s speed, Sha Minglan couldn’t withstand his barrage attacks, making her an easy target for all his attacks. "Argh!"
*Bam*
A loud explosion rang out as Sha Minglan was slammed into the ground with great force, causing her to spray a large amount of blood from her mouth. "Cough... Cough..."

Sha Huoran and the others looked at Zhang Fei [1], but they frowned because his cultivation was clearly far below that of the two evil beasts.
Sha Huo observed Zhang Fei [1] seriously, but he was certain they had never met before.
Sha Qingge also looked at him, but she was confused because he was a weak human, yet the two female evil beasts addressed him as their husband.
Zhang Fei [1] activated his soul link and borrowed the strengths of other evil beasts in his beast space, increasing his strength to equal Sha Huoran’s.

Sha Huo and the others were completely shocked by Zhang Fei [1]’s increased strength, and they were even more shocked by the appearance of Feltia [2] not far from them, especially since the two were on par in strength.
"Brother," Sha Qingge said as she hugged Sha Mo’s arm.
Sha Huo didn’t blame his sister for being afraid of them, as he himself was worried about his safety.
Although there were eight powerful demons protecting them, Sha Huoran was the only one who could stand up to Zhang Fei [1] and the others.
"He must have used a special technique to increase his strength; otherwise, he wouldn’t have become so strong with his cultivation still at the Celestial Lord Realm."
"Protect our prince and princess." Sha Minglan and the others nodded to Sha Huoran, but they were not confident in facing Zhang Fei [1] and the other three.
"What do you mean by interfering in our business?"
Zhang Fei [1] disappeared from his spot, and Sha Huoran was sent flying quite far back in the next instant, shocking Sha Huo and the others.
Sha Huoran hurriedly kicked a large tree behind him to stop, but Zhang Fei [1] instantly appeared in front of him and launched an attack with his fist.
*Boom*
Sha Huoran slammed into the tree behind him after he blocked Zhang Fei [1]’s punch, which made both his hands numb. ’What a monster!
What kind of technique did he use to increase his strength to surpass mine?’

Sha Huo and the others were shocked to see that, and they were even more shocked when Zhang Fei [1] reappeared and kicked Sha Huoran without him being able to dodge, sending him flying in the other direction.
"Shit!" Sha Huoran himself felt quite pained by Zhang Fei [1]’s two attacks just now, but he immediately transformed into his demon form, which made his strength increase even higher.
"I never thought I would have to use this form to face a human like you."
Zhang Fei [1] jumped onto a tree branch behind him.
"Although your strength has increased significantly, my strength is still above yours.
If you think I’m boasting, we can exchange blows now."
"Heh!
I’ll see how long you can use your strengthening technique!"
Sha Huoyan and Zhang Fei [1] moved simultaneously, and the two exchanged blows in midair.
*Boom*
"Gah!" Sha Huoyan rolled back several times after that, but he immediately stabilized himself and launched himself towards Zhang Fei [1] again.
"I will kill you, human!"
Quickly, Zhang Fei [1] and Sha Huoran fought in the air, but Sha Mo and the others could see that the former’s speed surpassed their grand elder’s.
"Brother."
Sha Huo nodded to his sister.
"I wouldn’t have believed a human could match our grand elder’s strength if I hadn’t seen it for myself.
Moreover, the human’s speed was incredible, and our grand elder could not keep up with it."
"Prince, I will help our grand elder fight that human." Sha Minglan moved towards them, but Feltia [2] instantly intercepted her and kicked her.
"Gah!"
Sha Minglan slid to the ground, but she quickly stabilized herself before hitting the ground.
Feltia [2] instantly appeared in front of her, and he attacked her again.
With Feltia [2]’s speed, Sha Minglan couldn’t withstand his barrage attacks, making her an easy target for all his attacks.
"Argh!"
*Bam*
A loud explosion rang out as Sha Minglan was slammed into the ground with great force, causing her to spray a large amount of blood from her mouth.
"Cough...
Cough..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1589: Defeat The Old Demon
paragraphs: Sha Huo and the others wanted to help Sha Minglan, but Yao Qilin and Fei Lian immediately acted, creating lightning wind walls around them.
"You guys better not move."
"If you guys move, I’ll attack you all directly."
Sha Huo and the others gulped hard, listening to the threats of the two evil female beasts.
’Brother, you have to contact our father now.’ Sha Qingge whispered.

Sha Huo considered doing so, but he knew it was useless. Their Heavenly Fiend Demon Domain was too far from the Glazed Heaven Domain, and their father wouldn’t be able to reach there in a short time. Moreover, he could see that Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2] had no intention of harming Sha Huoran and Sha Minglan, especially since they did not use their killing moves. ’What do they really want from us? Do they just want to stop us from entering the Tower of Eternity?’

Sha Minglan wiped the blood from her mouth and looked at Feltia [2], who was floating down in front of her. She reverted to her demon form and attacked him directly, but he swiftly kicked her in the head and threw her back.
"Gah!" Sha Minglan hurriedly stabilized herself, but Feltia [2] quickly attacked her, raining down powerful punches and kicks. ’Fuck! His attacks are truly painful, and his speed is truly fast!’
Within a few seconds, Sha Minglan’s body was covered in blood, and extreme pain invaded her entire body because of all Feltia [2]’s attacks.
"Ahh..." Sha Minglan released a loud, ear-splitting moan as soon as Feltia [2] used his demon touch and lust manipulation on her. "Ahh..."
[You gained 7,500,000 female essences from Sha Minglan.]
[You gained 7,500,000 Yin Qi from Sha Minglan.]
Sha Minglan instantly collapsed to the ground as she reached her powerful orgasm. She reverted back to her human form and breathed heavily, looking lustfully at Feltia [2].

Feltia [2] looked at Sha Minglan’s expression with a smile, but she was not interested in having sex with her, even though her Yin Qi and female essence were quite abundant. "Did you enjoy your orgasm?"
"Hah... Hah..." Sha Minglan looked at him. "You... You are a lust demon, right?"
Feltia [2] transformed into his lust demon form, shocking not only Sha Minglan but also the other demons. "You should stay lying here, or else I will take further action against you."
"Why... Why are you meddling in our affairs?"
Feltia [2] shrugged, disappeared from Sha Minglan’s sight, and joined Zhang Fei [1] to fight Sha Huoran.

Sha Huoran himself was already overwhelmed fighting Zhang Fei [1] one-on-one, and Feltia [2]’s arrival overwhelmed him further. Now, two people were ganging up on him, and their speed simply surpassed his, coupled with the weight of their attacks.
Sha Huoran unleashed his full power. "I will kill you both!"

"You’ve said that from the start, but you’ve never been able to touch me, let alone kill me." Zhang Fei [1] summoned the demon extermination sword and swung it towards Sha Huoran. "Last move: Sever the Heavenly Path!"
Feltia [2], who was already holding another sword, also swung it towards Sha Huo. "Last move! Ashen Bloom!"

In that instant, the giant golden sword above Feltia [2] glided toward Sha Huoran. The flurry of petals that emerged from Zhang Fei [1], formed from sword intent, bloomed from nothing before slashing towards those lightning bolts that also shot towards him.

Sha Huoran was shocked by both Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2]’s techniques, realizing that they were not simple swordmasters but god-rank swordmasters. The flurry of petals destroyed everything in its path, including the trees. On the other hand, the giant golden sword hurtled straight toward him.

Sha Huoran, who saw all that, immediately felt that his death was in front of him. He quickly escaped from their attacks, but the golden sword changed trajectory and chased after him. The flurry of petals spread and blocked his escape path, and those petals charged straight towards him.
"Shit!" Sha Huoran used all his strength to create a barrier around his body, but the golden sword struck it and shattered it. "Fuck! I’m dead!"

Sha Huo and the other demons also panicked when they saw the combined attack of Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2], and they thought that Sha Huoran would be seriously injured or even die if they struck him.

Their worries were unfounded, as both techniques disappeared before they could even strike Sha Huoran’s body. The old male demon was quite relieved after the two techniques disappeared, but Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2] appeared on either side of him, pressed their palms against his body, and used two other techniques.
Zhang Fei [1] used his Life-Force Absorption Technique on Sha Huoran, and Feltia [2] used her Demon Absorbing Technique on him.

"Argh!" As Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2] absorbed his life force and cultivated, Sha Huoran screamed in pain. His skin quickly shriveled and made him look older, causing him to weaken rapidly. He tried to attack them, but they casually repelled his attacks. "Argh!"

After two notifications appeared in their minds, Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2] stopped using both of their techniques on Sha Huoran. The old male demon immediately fell to the ground like a broken kite, and all the skin on his body had shriveled.

Sha Huoran was initially confident that Zhang Fei [1]’s strengthening technique would not last long, but his guess was wrong, as his technique was still active and his strength was still on par with his. Not only him, but Feltia [2]’s strength also did not diminish in the slightest.

Sha Huoran realized that one of them was a clone, but he had never seen such a perfect clone with the same strength and abilities. Unfortunately, his guess was slightly wrong, as both were Zhang Fei’s clones. "If you kill us, you will feel my demon god’s wrath."

"Haha," Zhang Fei [1] crouched beside him and touched his chest. "Did I ever say I would kill you guys? I just wanted to stop you from entering the tower, as I have other plans for those two demon races. If you go in there now, you will complicate the situation, so I purposely waited here to stop you."
"Who—"
Sha Huoran’s eyes widened as Zhang Fei [1] pulled his soul out of his body.

Sha Huoran and the others were shocked when Zhang Fei [1] duplicated the soul, merged it with his own, and then returned it to his body. Feltia [2] moved towards Sha Minglan, and he did the same to the female demon, even though she was not as strong as her friend.
"What did you do to me?"

"Even though your soul that merged with mine is a duplicate, I can use it to do many things to you, including killing you. If you don’t want to die, you have to carefully consider your words and actions, or else I will crush your soul." Zhang Fei [1] looked at Sha Huo and the others, and he approached them as he talked to them. "If you don’t want to get hurt, you should surrender and let me do the same to all of you."
Sha Huo pulled his sister behind him, but the demons protecting them immediately collapsed to the ground due to the pressure from Yao Qilin and Fei Lian.

Zhang Fei [1] wasn’t concerned about his subordinates, as they were only weak demons. However, Sha Huo and Sha Qingge were different; they were the prince and princess of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race, and they would be useful for him in suppressing Sha Mo.

Zhang Fei [1] didn’t say anything and pulled the souls of Sha Huo and Sha Qingge out of their bodies, duplicated them, and merged them with his own. After he finished, he returned their souls to their bodies, horrifying the female demon princess.
Feltia [2] gave recovery and healing pills to Sha Minglan and Sha Huoran, allowing them to recover.
"What do you want from us?" Sha Huo asked.

Zhang Fei [1] shrugged his shoulders. "I just want to keep an eye on your parents’ movements, and you two are my best choice because you are the prince and princess of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race, so they won’t be suspicious at all. Once this universe is calm and stable, I will release you two, and you guys can go back to your lives."
"Is that all?"

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [1] nodded at him. "I’m not a maniac killer, okay? I just want peace for everyone close to me, but you demon races always cause trouble wherever you go, so I have to do something to bring about that peace."
"What—" Sha Huo did not continue his words and looked at the dozens of women who suddenly appeared in front of them.

Sha Qingge also looked at them, and she was amazed by their beauty, even though their cultivation was still at the Celestial King Realm. ’Are these women his wives? How can he get dozens of beautiful women?’

"You’re right, Princess Qingge. All of these women are my wives, and I had to take this action against you because I wanted to protect them. Sha Qingge was stunned that Zhang Fei [1] knew her mind. "Our souls are the main part of our bodies, and your duplicate soul has merged with mine, so I can know everything that’s in your mind. By the way, I don’t want anything more from you two, and I just want to use you to keep an eye on your parents. As for your affairs with the people from the Divine Samsara Sect, I won’t interfere with that, and you can do whatever you want with them."

chapters.title: Chapter 1590: Zhang Fei’s Purpose
paragraphs: After the two female beasts freed the other six demons, they immediately went to help Sha Huoran and Sha Minglan.
"Are you really not going to stop us from doing anything to the members of the Divine Samsara Sect?" Sha Huo asked with a hint of surprise.

Zhang Fei [1] thought for a moment. "I only ask you to let go of the old man named Yu Shan, and you can do whatever you want with the rest. That old man is a good man, so I don’t want anything to happen to him. Besides, I forbid you from capturing people from the Moonlit Passion Temple, the Celestial Moon Sect, the Hidden Moon Sect, and the Spring Zenith Sect because they are my people. You should be able to recognize their identities from the symbols on their clothing, so you won’t be mistaken about them."
"What about other cultivators?"
Zhang Fei [1] touched Sha Huo’s forehead. "Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi are my friends."

"I see." Sha Huo nodded in understanding. "You should already know that members of the Torture Demon Race and the Thousand Eyes Demon Race are in the tower, and I can’t stop them from capturing your people."

"I will handle the members of both demon races myself, so you don’t need to worry about them." Zhang Fei [1] glanced at the timid Sha Qingge. "Your sister is a princess, but she is so timid. She keeps hiding behind you even though I don’t do anything else to you."

’Who wouldn’t be timid in front of you? Your cultivation is still at the Celestial Emperor Realm, but you managed to defeat Grand Elder Huoran.’ Sha Qingge grumbled inwardly, but she immediately realized her mistake because Zhang Fei [1] could read her mind.
Zhang Fei [1] teased her directly. "Hey, Princess Qingge, how about you become my woman?"
"W-what?" Sha Qingge stammered. "No! I don’t want to be your woman!"
"Haha," Zhang Fei [1] laughed and left them.

The other demons carried Sha Huoran, who was still weak after Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2] absorbed his life force and cultivation, to the front of their prince and princess, followed by Sha Minglan and the others.
"How is your condition, Grand Elder?"

Sha Huoran glanced at Zhang Fei [1] for a moment. "Prince, I am not injured, but my condition is still weak after they used their abilities on me. We should go to the next area, and I will recover there. Once I recover, we will go to the tower to join the others, but you and my princess must remain careful."
"Alright, let’s move now." Sha Huo immediately led them.
Sha Qingge followed her brother, glancing at Zhang Fei [1] several times and wondering whether he could still read her mind if she returned to the Heavenly Fiend Demon later.
"Are you interested in that princess, Big Brother?"

Zhang Fei [1] shook his head at Zhang Lin. "I’m not interested in her, and I was just teasing her just now. Alright, you guys don’t need to worry about them and focus on your training in this area. We’ll move on to the next area once you’re used to your new powers."
After that, all the women there spread out to various locations in the first forest area, supervised by Zhang Fei’s two clones, Yao Qilin, and Fei Lian.
"Grand Elder, what technique do you think he used to maintain his strength for so long?" Sha Qingge asked once they arrived at the second area.

Sha Huoran exhaled softly. "I don’t know what kind of technique he used earlier, Princess. I’ve fought Xie Yao and Xie Yan in the past, but they didn’t possess such abilities, even though they were lust demon gods. Besides, that young demon’s strengthening technique was truly unusual because he could surpass my maximum strength, and his speed was also abnormal, surpassing the speed demon, Su Shentian."

"Fortunately, he didn’t intend to kill us from the start, or we would have been corpses by now." Sha Minglan spoke, but she was still aggrieved because Zhang Fei [1] duplicated her soul and merged it with his.

"I think I know his identity." They looked at Sha Huo. "He said that the people from the Moonlit Passion Temple are his people, so I’m sure he’s the mysterious person behind the sect’s great changes. However, I don’t know about his relationship with the members of the Celestial Moon Sect, the Hidden Moon Sect, and the Spring Zenith Sect."
"Isn’t the Celestial Moon Sect a women-only sect? Why would they form a relationship with a dual cultivation sect like the Moonlit Passion Temple?"

Sha Huo spoke to his sister directly. "Qingge, that sect is no longer a dual cultivation sect, and it transformed into a universal sect several years ago. That man has managed to recruit many renowned cultivators and clans from this realm, including Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, Zhuxian Sheng, and many more. Long before the changes that occurred in this realm, I thought about investigating that sect and seeing the situation there firsthand, but our mother forbade me from going there because Empress Huo protects the sect."
"You mean that young demon changed the sect, Brother?"

"Yes." Sha Huo nodded slightly. "I’ve heard people from that sect in other domains talk about him, but they haven’t revealed his true identity to the public. Judging by his previous battle with our grand elder, I’m certain that he’s the person they were referring to back then."
"Why did the sect members accept him if he’s a demon like us?"

Sha Huo sighed softly. "Qingge, the sect accepts all races as members, including demons. I heard rumors that Nalan Wangzi also joined the sect, but I don’t know if it’s true because I’ve never been there before."
"A sect that accepts members of all races," Sha Qingge mumbled in disbelief.
"That’s why I wanted to check the sect myself, but our mother wouldn’t allow me to join there."
"Prince and Princess, we will rest here, and I will recover my strength first." Sha Huoran immediately sat under a large tree and began cultivating, with several demons standing guard to protect him.
Although her injuries were not as severe as Sha Huoran’s, Sha Minglan also sought an empty space to recover.
Sha Huo brought his sister to sit with him, protected by several other demons. "Sorry, Qingge. I couldn’t protect you from that man, and—"

"No need, Brother," Sha Qingge interrupted. "We didn’t know we’d encounter such a powerful young demon, and he could even defeat our grand elder. Although I’m upset about our situation, at least we’re still alive now, and he said he would release us once this Paradise Realm is at peace."

Sha Huo inwardly sighed and thought. "Do you think this Paradise Realm will be able to find peace with so many races in it? The chaotic situation in this realm has persisted for several generations, and many cultivators, including our parents, are focused on dominating everything."

"I don’t know." Sha Qingge supported her head with both hands. "I know that all races have lofty ambitions to be the best compared to others, and the situation in this realm will never be peaceful if they cannot put aside their ambitions. Even so, I will always hope that everything can be peaceful and that all races can live side by side without problems, but I don’t know if my hope will ever come true."
"Haha," Sha Huo embraced his sister. "You are indeed different from other demons, including me, and you have a kinder heart than us."

"Thank you for always understanding me, Brother." Sha Qingge laid her head on his shoulder. "Unlike you, our parents, especially our mother, always asked me to change my mindset and forced me to be cruel. She even forced me to kill several humans in the past, and I can’t forget their faces to this day, even though the incident happened long ago."

Sha Huo nodded slightly. "I understand how you feel, and I want you to stay true to yourself forever. As for me, I am our father’s successor, and I have a great responsibility to our demon race. Although I dislike killing as much as you do, I have no other choice but to do so, and I will do whatever it takes to ensure that our demon race does not become extinct like other demon races in the past."
"Are we really going to sacrifice those humans to fight the Celestial Demon Race, Brother?"
"That was the decision of our father, Demon God Ku Shenzu, and Demon God Qian Yan."
Sha Qingge sighed. "I truly pity those humans, Brother."
"Me too."

Unlike the other cultivators, Zhang Fei, Luo Yunxiao, Yue Xuelian, Nalan Wangzi, Helian Xun’er, and Tianshi Shengjie didn’t experience any significant obstacles from all the challenges. They were already getting closer to the stairs leading to the second floor, leaving others puzzled about their abilities, including those from the Divine Samsara Sect.

sentences.text: After the two female beasts freed the other six demons, they immediately went to help Sha Huoran and Sha Minglan.
"Are you really not going to stop us from doing anything to the members of the Divine Samsara Sect?" Sha Huo asked with a hint of surprise.
Zhang Fei [1] thought for a moment.
"I only ask you to let go of the old man named Yu Shan, and you can do whatever you want with the rest.
That old man is a good man, so I don’t want anything to happen to him.
Besides, I forbid you from capturing people from the Moonlit Passion Temple, the Celestial Moon Sect, the Hidden Moon Sect, and the Spring Zenith Sect because they are my people.
You should be able to recognize their identities from the symbols on their clothing, so you won’t be mistaken about them."
"What about other cultivators?"
Zhang Fei [1] touched Sha Huo’s forehead.
"Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi are my friends."
"I see." Sha Huo nodded in understanding.
"You should already know that members of the Torture Demon Race and the Thousand Eyes Demon Race are in the tower, and I can’t stop them from capturing your people."
"I will handle the members of both demon races myself, so you don’t need to worry about them." Zhang Fei [1] glanced at the timid Sha Qingge.
"Your sister is a princess, but she is so timid.
She keeps hiding behind you even though I don’t do anything else to you."
’Who wouldn’t be timid in front of you?

Your cultivation is still at the Celestial Emperor Realm, but you managed to defeat Grand Elder Huoran.’ Sha Qingge grumbled inwardly, but she immediately realized her mistake because Zhang Fei [1] could read her mind.
Zhang Fei [1] teased her directly.
"Hey, Princess Qingge, how about you become my woman?"
"W-what?" Sha Qingge stammered.
"No!
I don’t want to be your woman!"
"Haha," Zhang Fei [1] laughed and left them.

The other demons carried Sha Huoran, who was still weak after Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2] absorbed his life force and cultivation, to the front of their prince and princess, followed by Sha Minglan and the others.
"How is your condition, Grand Elder?"
Sha Huoran glanced at Zhang Fei [1] for a moment.
"Prince, I am not injured, but my condition is still weak after they used their abilities on me.
We should go to the next area, and I will recover there.
Once I recover, we will go to the tower to join the others, but you and my princess must remain careful."
"Alright, let’s move now." Sha Huo immediately led them.
Sha Qingge followed her brother, glancing at Zhang Fei [1] several times and wondering whether he could still read her mind if she returned to the Heavenly Fiend Demon later.
"Are you interested in that princess, Big Brother?"
Zhang Fei [1] shook his head at Zhang Lin.
"I’m not interested in her, and I was just teasing her just now.
Alright, you guys don’t need to worry about them and focus on your training in this area.
We’ll move on to the next area once you’re used to your new powers."
After that, all the women there spread out to various locations in the first forest area, supervised by Zhang Fei’s two clones, Yao Qilin, and Fei Lian.
"Grand Elder, what technique do you think he used to maintain his strength for so long?" Sha Qingge asked once they arrived at the second area.
Sha Huoran exhaled softly.
"I don’t know what kind of technique he used earlier, Princess.
I’ve fought Xie Yao and Xie Yan in the past, but they didn’t possess such abilities, even though they were lust demon gods.
Besides, that young demon’s strengthening technique was truly unusual because he could surpass my maximum strength, and his speed was also abnormal, surpassing the speed demon, Su Shentian."

"Fortunately, he didn’t intend to kill us from the start, or we would have been corpses by now." Sha Minglan spoke, but she was still aggrieved because Zhang Fei [1] duplicated her soul and merged it with his.
"I think I know his identity." They looked at Sha Huo.
"He said that the people from the Moonlit Passion Temple are his people, so I’m sure he’s the mysterious person behind the sect’s great changes.
However, I don’t know about his relationship with the members of the Celestial Moon Sect, the Hidden Moon Sect, and the Spring Zenith Sect."
"Isn’t the Celestial Moon Sect a women-only sect?
Why would they form a relationship with a dual cultivation sect like the Moonlit Passion Temple?"
Sha Huo spoke to his sister directly.
"Qingge, that sect is no longer a dual cultivation sect, and it transformed into a universal sect several years ago.
That man has managed to recruit many renowned cultivators and clans from this realm, including Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, Zhuxian Sheng, and many more.

Long before the changes that occurred in this realm, I thought about investigating that sect and seeing the situation there firsthand, but our mother forbade me from going there because Empress Huo protects the sect."
"You mean that young demon changed the sect, Brother?"
"Yes." Sha Huo nodded slightly.
"I’ve heard people from that sect in other domains talk about him, but they haven’t revealed his true identity to the public.
Judging by his previous battle with our grand elder, I’m certain that he’s the person they were referring to back then."
"Why did the sect members accept him if he’s a demon like us?"
Sha Huo sighed softly.
"Qingge, the sect accepts all races as members, including demons.
I heard rumors that Nalan Wangzi also joined the sect, but I don’t know if it’s true because I’ve never been there before."
"A sect that accepts members of all races," Sha Qingge mumbled in disbelief.
"That’s why I wanted to check the sect myself, but our mother wouldn’t allow me to join there."
"Prince and Princess, we will rest here, and I will recover my strength first." Sha Huoran immediately sat under a large tree and began cultivating, with several demons standing guard to protect him.

Sha Huo brought his sister to sit with him, protected by several other demons.
"Sorry, Qingge.
I couldn’t protect you from that man, and—"
"No need, Brother," Sha Qingge interrupted.
"We didn’t know we’d encounter such a powerful young demon, and he could even defeat our grand elder.
Although I’m upset about our situation, at least we’re still alive now, and he said he would release us once this Paradise Realm is at peace."
Sha Huo inwardly sighed and thought.
"Do you think this Paradise Realm will be able to find peace with so many races in it?

"I don’t know." Sha Qingge supported her head with both hands.

Even so, I will always hope that everything can be peaceful and that all races can live side by side without problems, but I don’t know if my hope will ever come true."
"Haha," Sha Huo embraced his sister.
"You are indeed different from other demons, including me, and you have a kinder heart than us."
"Thank you for always understanding me, Brother." Sha Qingge laid her head on his shoulder.

As for me, I am our father’s successor, and I have a great responsibility to our demon race.

Although I dislike killing as much as you do, I have no other choice but to do so, and I will do whatever it takes to ensure that our demon race does not become extinct like other demon races in the past."
"Are we really going to sacrifice those humans to fight the Celestial Demon Race, Brother?"

Sha Qingge sighed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1591: Second Floor
paragraphs: "Young Lord." Ku Yu looked at Ku Shan. "People from the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race had already arrived in this domain, but they were attacked by several cultivators. Sha Huoran suffered heavy injuries, and he needed several days to recover from them."
Ku Yu raised an eyebrow. "Who attacked them and injured Grand Elder Sha Huoran?"
"Sha Huoran couldn’t recognize them because they were much faster than him." Ku Shan looked at Feng Yao, Long Wuzhao, and the two dragons. "I thought they were their subordinates, Young Lord."
Ku Yu looked at the four people, and he had no doubt that their subordinates could do such a thing, especially Feng Yao’s subordinates. "What should we do now?"

"I’ve contacted my demon god, and he asked us to wait for the people from the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race to arrive, Young Lord. Long Wuzhao and the others will protect these people, and we won’t be able to face them."
"Alright."
Ku Shan ordered the demons of the Torture Demon Race to slow down their movements and wait for the people of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race.
"Prince."

Qian Yu looked at Qian Hufeng, who immediately told him about what had happened to the demons of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race. "Even if we don’t slow down our movements, all the challenges on this first floor will slow us down, so we’ll move as before and be wary of them."
"Yes."

Qian Yu immediately told his sister, Qian Qin, about the matter. "Qin, you must not move too fast, and you must be careful of Long Wuzhao and the others. If they capture you, even our father cannot save you from them."

"I understand, Brother." Qian Qin didn’t think much about Long Wuzhao and the two dragons; instead, she thought more about Zhang Fei because the influence of his abilities was becoming stronger with each passing second. ’Tch! Could it be that man and Xie Xiaolong are the same person?’

Meanwhile, Feng Yao stood leisurely in her spot, observing the movements of the demons of both races and calculating their movements. She knew that their targets were the people from the Samsara Divine Sect, but she couldn’t care less about them.
[Are you going to take action against them, Master?]

Feng Yao shook her head slightly. ’They haven’t started any trouble yet, so I won’t make a move against them. When they make a move, we will too, and you can kill them, including their four grand elders.’
[Okay! This tower and all the challenges within it are so boring! If it weren’t for the presence of those demons, we could just go straight to the third floor and wait for Zhang Fei there.]
Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei. ’All the challenges on the first floor are just child’s play to him, and he’ll be up to the second floor soon.’

[Tch! He’s lucky he got all his cheats from that young woman from another universe! If he didn’t have all that, he would be no different from other cultivators, and he’d still be in the Three Mortal Realms now.]
’Hahaha! Luck is an inseparable part of cultivators’ lives, right?’
[Humph! I want to burn all those demons to ashes so the situation in this Paradise Realm will be calmer, and we won’t be bothered by unimportant matters.]
’Be patient, okay? There will come a time for you to make a move, but not now, and you can burn them all then.’

Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3], Zhang Fei [4], and Zhang Fei [5] were already on the first floor of the Tower of Eternity. The three of them were already moving in three different directions, but they didn’t show themselves and used their invisibility.
One of them was protecting the women from the Celestial Moon Sect, one was protecting the people from the Spring Zenith Sect, and the other was protecting the women from the Hidden Moon Sect.

Three days passed quickly; Zhang Fei, Luo Yunxiao, Helian Xun’er, Nalan Wangzi, Tianshi Shengjie, and Yue Xuelian had already arrived at the stairs to the second floor, making them the fastest to complete the challenges on the first floor.

Zhang Fei saw that Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi were already by Feng Yao’s side, so he didn’t need to worry about them. Over the five days, the people from the three sects also made progress in their challenges, but they were still a long way from reaching the stairs to the second floor.

As for the others, they had considerable difficulty completing the challenges, and many of them decided to give up. First, the challenges were too difficult for them. Second, they feared the demons might capture or kill them.

Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, and Tianshi Bailong did not experience any significant difficulties in facing all the challenges, and they were already in the same position as Feng Yao. The three of them did not continue moving and waited for the demons, who deliberately slowed down their movements.

Li Guangyu and the core disciples of the Divine Samsara Sect also didn’t experience too much difficulty in facing those challenges, but their other disciples were very overwhelmed , making their progress slow.

Ku Yu, Qian Yu, and their group were annoyed by the presence of Feng Yao and the three dragons. They were slightly relieved when they saw the people from the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race had arrived, but they hadn’t yet begun their challenges.

After recuperating for three days, aided by the pills Zhang Fei had given them, Sha Huoran and Sha Minglan had fully recovered. They were a little surprised to see that Zhang Fei and the five women had arrived at the stairs leading to the second floor.
After he spoke with Ku Yu and Qian Yu, Sha Huo asked them to focus on the people of the Divine Samsara Sect, especially those outside the core disciples.

Sha Huo immediately led his sister and subordinates to begin their challenge, but they avoided the people from the Moonlit Passion Temple, the Celestial Moon Sect, the Hidden Moon Sect, and the Spring Zenith Sect.
"Won’t their presence bring trouble to our people?"

"Hehe," Luo Yunxiao giggled before answering Tianshi Shengjie. "You don’t need to worry about the demons of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race, Shengjie. Our husband has already done something to them, and they are on our side now, so they won’t do anything to our people."
Tianshi Shengjie nodded slightly. "Shall we go to the second floor now? The situation on the second floor is different from the first, and we won’t face as many challenges there."
"Challenges of the soul, right?"

"Yes," Yue Xuelian nodded. "We can’t predict the challenges that will appear on the second floor because it’s based on the most terrifying thing in our souls, so everyone will face challenges of varying difficulty."
Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow slightly. "Hmm? I’m curious about that, so we should head to the second floor now."
"Let’s go."
[Quest I: Clear the first floor.]
[Quest rank: Hard.]
[Status: Completed.]
[Reward: Eternity gift pack x 1 sent to the inventory.]
When they arrived at the second floor, Zhang Fei and the others saw dozens of people sitting cross-legged in the central area.
"They’re people from the War God Pavilion." Yue Xuelian pointed to a man sitting in front of the stairs leading to the third floor. "That man is Dugu Yuanshen, the sect master of the sect."

Without even checking their status, Zhang Fei knew they were extremely powerful, especially from the auras radiating from their bodies. Dugu Yuanshen’s cultivation had already reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, and many of his disciples had also reached that stage.
"That man is Dugu Xuanye, and he is a direct disciple of Dugu Yuanshen." Zhang Fei looked at the man Yue Xuelian had pointed to. "The woman next to him is his lover, Ru Feiyan."
"I see." Zhang Fei and the five women didn’t move immediately. "How many soul challenges will we face here?"
"Back then, I faced five challenges, and the last one was too strong for me, so I failed," Yue Xuelian answered him.
"How do we begin the challenge here?"

"We simply need to step forward, and our souls will be sent to the first test on their own. Once we complete the first challenge, our souls will be returned to our bodies so we can move on to the second challenge, and so on."
Zhang Fei looked at the area before them. "Now that I think about it, this second floor could be a mass grave."

"That’s right." Yue Xuelian nodded at him. "All cultivators who are not undergoing challenges can attack other cultivators, and they won’t notice if others attack them. That’s why we cannot step forward at the same time; we must take turns to protect each other’s backs."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "In that case, we should start the challenge on this floor while the demons are busy with their challenge on the first floor, and we need to reach the farthest area as quickly as possible."
"Let’s go." Zhang Fei immediately led them forward, and they sat down in the area before their souls were sent to the first challenge.

Dugu Yuanshen, who was sitting in the distance, immediately opened his eyes. His gaze focused on Zhang Fei’s group, and his eyes flashed golden before he frowned, realizing Nalan Wangzi’s identity. "That woman is the first princess of the Soul-Devouring Demon Race, and another woman is the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race. Why is Sect Master Yue Xuelian also with them? Is she not aware of that female demon’s identity?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1592: First Soul Challenge
paragraphs: "Why do you keep looking at them, Master?" Dugu Xuanye asked.
Dugu Yuanshen pointed his finger at Zhang Fei’s group. "Do you recognize two of those five women?"

"Hmm?" Just like his master, Dugu Xuanye flashed golden for a moment. "One of them is Nalan Wangzi, the first princess of the Soul-Devouring Demon Race. The other one is Tianshi Shengjie, the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race. One of the other three women is Yue Xuelian, the Sect Master of the Celestial Moon Sect, but I can’t recognize the other two."

"Yes," Dugu Yuanshen nodded. "I can’t recognize the woman in the green dress, but I’ve met the woman in the purple dress. If I remember correctly, her name is Helian Xun’er, and she is Wan Jiang’s disciple."

Dugu Xuanye looked at his master. "If I recall correctly, Wan Jiang relinquished his duty to guard the Star Tower a few years before the changes that occurred in this Paradise Realm, but I have never heard of his whereabouts since then."

"Several years ago, I heard from Li Tianyu that Wan Jiang decided to join the Moonlit Passion Temple, and he also told me that the sect was no longer a dual cultivation sect but a universal one." Dugu Yuanshen pointed at Zhang Fei. "Try observing that man and his relationship with those women."
Dugu Xuanye looked at Zhang Fei. "Eh? Master, I detected his yang qi within their bodies, except for Sect Master Yue Xuelian."

"Yes," Dugu Yuanshen nodded. "Although Helian Xun’er and Tianshi Shengjie are still virgins, they have already consumed a lot of that man’s yang qi. Nalan Wangzi and the woman in the green dress should be his wives, as I can sense their yin qi within his body."
"Who exactly is that young man? How could he take Nalan Wangzi as his wife? Moreover, Helian Xun’er and Tianshi Shengjie are also his women, even though their relationship is not yet official."

Dugu Yuanshen seriously observed Zhang Fei. "That young man is surely no ordinary man, and he might be the one who brought about the changes in the Moonlit Passion Temple. His age is still under a hundred, but his cultivation has already reached the Celestial Emperor Realm, and his soul power is already on par with mine."
"What?" Dugu Xuanye screamed. "Are you serious, Master? Is his soul power already on par with yours?"

Dugu Xuanye sighed. "Master, I don’t like dealing with complicated matters, so I’m not sure that I can lead our sect. I think you should choose my junior brother to replace you, and I’m sure he can bring our sect more success."
"Let’s talk about that in the future."
"What are you going to do to Nalan Wangzi, Master?"

"Nalan Wangzi is one of that man’s wives, and Tianshi Shengjie is one of them. Dugu Yuanshen looked up. "Your final challenge is about to descend, so you should prepare now, Xuanye. "Yes, Master." Dugu Xuanye closed his eyes and waited for his final challenge.

After he couldn’t find anything from Zhang Fei, Dugu Yuanshen took a look at his other disciples before closing his eyes again.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei’s soul was already somewhere else, a vast ancient residence. He was certain he had never seen that place before.

"What is this place? Why did the challenge send my soul here?" Soon, many people appeared in that place, but Zhang Fei had never seen the clothes they were wearing before. "Who are they? Why did they appear in my soul test?"
Zhang Fei tried to touch one of them, but his hand went right through his body. He walked to other areas while trying to touch the people, but he still couldn’t, confusing him.

When Zhang Fei arrived in the main hall of the residence, the sky above it quickly became completely dark. He looked up at the sky, where he saw a black-robed man riding a flaming horse with a black sword in his hand.

Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow when he heard the black-robed man muttering something, and everyone in the residence fell asleep by themselves. He saw their expressions quickly turn to horror, and they all screamed the same thing.

"What the hell happened to them? Why are they suddenly reacting like this?" Zhang Fei was shocked when the black-robed man swung his black sword, and everyone stopped screaming. Although he couldn’t touch them, he immediately realized that the people were dead without any physical injuries. "Shit!"

Zhang Fei shuddered when the black-robed man looked at him, and he could see that his eyes were jet black, similar to some demon races. He saw the man’s mouth move as if he was saying something to him, but he couldn’t hear the words.

After the man disappeared, the scene changed rapidly, and Zhang Fei saw that everyone inside had become dried corpses. As he wondered about the previous incident, he saw a very familiar woman appear there. "Yuan Xiajie."

Yuan Xiajie was completely shocked when she saw that all her clan members were dead. She ran to check the entire area of her clan, but she found only corpses everywhere she went. She fell to the ground limp, cried as hard as she could, and screamed hysterically.

Zhang Fei realized that all he saw before was the destruction of the Ancient Nether Race, and the black-robed man who appeared before was the nightmare lord, Meng Zhou. When he released Wang Yin and the others many years ago, he met Yuan Xiajie there, and Feng Yao appeared to force her to free the female demons.

Zhang Fei was confused by everything that appeared before him because he had no relationship with Yuan Xiajie, and he also didn’t see the events of the day of her Yuan Clan’s destruction, but the challenge in the tower displayed all those events for him.

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei frowned as he saw a pitch-black aura emanate from Yuan Xiajie’s body, and the woman’s appearance slowly transformed into a demon he had never seen before. "Shit! Why am I so unlucky to meet her here?"

Zhang Fei took several steps back as Yuan Xiajie rose to her feet and faced him. His heart tightened as he thought back to their first meeting in the past, and his body shook violently remembering the events of that day. Even though the incident had passed many years ago, he still remembered the horror she showed him, which made him unable to move in front of her.
Yuan Xiajie looked at Zhang Fei with hatred and resentment, and the pitch-black aura that enveloped her body spread throughout the residence. "I’ll kill you! I’ll dismember your corpse!"
"Shit!" Zhang Fei hurriedly flew away as Yuan Xiajie flew towards him. He was almost never afraid of anyone, but this woman terrified him.

"I’ll kill you!" Yuan Xiajie suddenly moved in front of Zhang Fei, forcing him to fly in another direction. However, her pitch-black aura immediately surrounded him and restricted his movement, followed by a powerful slash from her. "Die!"
"Gah!" Zhang Fei screamed in pain as soon as Yuan Xiajie’s attack hit his soul, plunging him to the ground. "Fuck!"

Zhang Fei immediately dodged as Yuan Xiajie charged toward him again, causing her attack to crash into the empty ground. She didn’t stop there and chased after him, with two pitch-black swords in both hands.

"Fuck! This woman is really scary!" Zhang Fei zigzagged to avoid Yuan Xiajie’s attacks. "What should I do to defeat her? If I used my body, I would definitely be able to fight her, but this is my soul."
[Calm yourself, Kid.]
"Old Fox! What should I do to deal with this crazy woman?"
[That woman isn’t real, and she’s the embodiment of the fear in your soul. The more you fear her, the stronger she will become, so you have to overcome your fear of her.]

Zhang Fei knew this, but he felt immense fear towards Yuan Xiajie. He continued running as he avoided her attacks. "Shit! I thought this challenge would be easy, but I ran into this damn woman instead."
[As long as you can’t overcome your fear of her, you can’t complete this challenge, Kid.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1593: Second Soul Challenge
paragraphs: Zhang Fei tried to calm himself as he dodged Yuan Xiajie’s attacks. He also tried to read the movements of the woman who continued to pursue him with hatred and murderous intent. "Hey! It wasn’t me who killed your entire clan but the nightmare lord, Meng Zhou!"
"A liar like you must die!" Yuan Xiajie shouted, continuing to chase and attack Zhang Fei.
"Tch! What a stubborn woman! Illusion or reality makes no difference!" Zhang Fei thought of several things to deal with Yuan Xiajie, and he used his soul manipulation ability to strengthen his soul.

[That’s it, kid. The woman chasing you is just a soul fragment, and her strength depends on your fear of her. As long as you’re not afraid of her, she will weaken on her own, and you can overcome her.]

After dodging Yuan Xiajie’s attacks for a while, Zhang Fei decided to stop and fight with her. Since he couldn’t use the demon extermination sword or any other weapon, he transformed both of his hands into swords and attacked her.

Their attacks collided quickly in midair, pushing both of them back. Zhang Fei realized that their strength was evenly matched, but he still had the upper hand over her because he had something else that she didn’t.

As Yuan Xiajie attacked him again, Zhang Fei looked at the white lotus in his soul, realizing that she didn’t have it. He pushed the white lotus out of his soul, enlarged it, and confined her within it.
"Bastard!" Yuan Xiajie shouted in anger and attacked the white lotus from within again and again, but it was not destroyed.
Zhang Fei was relieved that Yuan Xiajie couldn’t destroy his white lotus. Numerous soul threads emerged from the lotus, bound her, and absorbed her soul power.
"Argh! I’ll kill you!" Yuan Xiajie attacked the lotus faster and more brutally.
*Bam... Bam...*
"Phew." Zhang Fei breathed a sigh of relief, but he suddenly felt something in his soul. "This."
[Have you noticed, Kid? Although that woman isn’t real, she was born from the collection of soul power fragments within the tower, so you can absorb her and use her to increase your soul power.]
*Bam... Bam...*
"So, you’re saying I can use all the fragments on the second floor of the tower to strengthen my soul, Old Fox?"

[That’s right, Kid. The purpose of the challenge on the second floor is to strengthen your soul, and you can only strengthen it by absorbing the soul fragments there.] Zhang Fei’s eyes flashed with joy, but Hu Tianlang’s next words washed away his joy. [There are countless soul fragments on the second floor, but they will never be enough to help you reach the Immortal Soul Level.]
"How do I reach the Immortal Soul Level, Old Fox?" Zhang Fei asked, watching the furious Yuan Xiajie inside the white lotus.
*Bam... Bam...*

[First, you have to find my two souls and merge them with yours. Second, you have to defeat my wrath soul and absorb it. Third, you must become the next ten-tailed fox by taking the hearts of both heavenly foxes.]
"Can I reach the Immortal Soul Level by evolving into the next ten-tailed fox?"
[No.] Zhang Fei frowned. [To reach the Immortal Soul Level, you still need a few more things, which you can only find in the Ancient Realm.]
"What are they?"
[No need to rush, Kid. When you transform into the ten-tailed fox in the future, you’ll gain more information, and you’ll know all the items you need at that time.]

Zhang Fei sighed and looked at Yuan Xiajie, who was getting weaker and slower. He could feel an increase in his soul power, but the increase was only minor and barely noticeable. "What kind of challenges will I face next? Yue Xuelian told me that the challenges will become stronger the closer we get to the stairs leading to the third floor."
After some time, Yuan Xiajie had disappeared from within the lotus, and Zhang Fei immediately pulled the white lotus back into his soul.
When Zhang Fei opened his eyes, he saw Luo Yunxiao smiling at him. "What kind of challenge did you just face? Why did you have such a frightened expression earlier, Husband?"
"Yuan Xiajie."
"Oh! The woman from the Ancient Nether Race."

"That’s right." Zhang Fei stood up as he lifted Luo Yunxiao to her feet. "I was initially afraid of her, but the Old Fox immediately calmed me down; otherwise, I wouldn’t have been able to defeat her and absorb her. What kind of challenge have you just faced?"

"Nothing." Zhang Fei was confused by that. "Perhaps I have no fear in my soul, so I didn’t face any battles before. Instead, I saw our childhood on Earth, and they turned into soul fragments afterward, so I immediately absorbed them."
"You’re probably right; the Old Fox told me that the challenges that arise before us stem from our fears, and they will be even stronger if we harbor great fear within us."
Zhang Fei looked at Helian Xun’er, Nalan Wangzi, and Tianshi Shengjie, who had just completed their first challenge.

Meanwhile, Yue Xuelian had not completed her first challenge, but her expression did not show any fear. Instead, Zhang Fei saw something else on her face, and he could guess the challenge she was facing.
"Let’s continue." They nodded to Zhang Fei, and they stepped forward together. After they sat down in the second area, their souls were immediately sent to the second soul challenges.
Shortly after they started their second soul challenge, Dugu Yuanshen opened his eyes once again, but his gaze was focused solely on Luo Yunxiao.

"Who exactly is that young lady? Everyone who enters this second floor will inevitably face many tough soul challenges, but she was able to complete her first challenge in just a few minutes. She didn’t even have any difficulty completing it, which is something I couldn’t do." Du Yuanshen shifted his gaze to Zhang Fei and the other three women. "Who is the old fox that the young man is referring to? How can the fox help him overcome his challenges? I’m not surprised that the Celestial Dragon Princess and Helian Xun’er could pass their test, but I didn’t expect Nalan Wangzi to pass her test so quickly, and it seems she also didn’t experience any significant difficulties before."
Dugu Yuanshen watched them for some time before closing his eyes.

A few minutes later, Yue Xuelian opened her eyes, but her expression showed unease. She glanced at Zhang Fei and the others before standing up, and she immediately moved forward for the second challenge.
Zhang Fei was already on his second challenge, and he was once again sent to an unfamiliar place.
"What kind of place is this?" Zhang Fei wondered as he examined the place, but he saw nothing but a large mountain. "A mountain?"

Zhang Fei considered flying to the mountain, but he decided against it when a giant eye appeared from one side. The eye stared at him and exerted strong pressure on his soul, and he also felt that it was trying to probe him.

"What—" Zhang Fei shut his mouth and swallowed his words when he saw countless eyes appear on the mountain. Soon, the mountain moved and transformed into a gigantic demon beast, which made him realize his identity. "Shit! The Ten Thousand Eyes Demon Beast God, Qian Yan. His form is so gigantic!"
*Roar*
Qian Yan roared loudly, sending everything in the area flying. Even Zhang Fei was pushed back by his single, extremely loud roar.

"What the hell! His single roar can push me back so far!" Zhang Fei hurriedly fled as Qian Yan shot countless rays of darkness at him. "Damn! He was only born from the soul fragments in this tower, but his attack power is already so great, let alone the real him."
*Boom... Boom...*
Those countless rays of darkness rained down on the previous area, causing numerous loud explosions and massive earthquakes in the area.

Zhang Fei stood in mid-air and stared at Qian Yan, thinking of a way to defeat him. With the demon beast god’s gigantic size, his white lotus couldn’t possibly envelop him like it did to Yuan Xiajie earlier.
*Roar*

Zhang Fei rolled backwards as soon as Qian Yan released another loud roar, and the demon god beast once again shot countless rays of darkness at him, forcing him to flee. "Tch! I have to think of a way to get close to him; otherwise, I won’t be able to defeat him."
Zhang Fei suddenly realized that Qian Yan’s attacks were only perpendicular, making him certain that he would not be able to hit him if he approached him in a zigzag motion.
After the demon beast god’s attacks hit another area, Zhang Fei quickly flew towards Qian Yan by weaving in the air.
Once again, Qian Yan attacked him with his darkness rays, but the result was as Zhang Fei had expected, and he was able to dodge all of his attacks easily.
Zhang Fei accelerated his flight towards Qian Yan’s head. However, a darkness dome enveloped the body of the demon beast god as soon as he arrived, sending him flying back as soon as he attacked.

In the next instant, Qian Yan’s darkness dome enveloped Zhang Fei’s soul and absorbed his soul power at a rapid pace, causing him to weaken. "Damn it! This technique is similar to my Demon Absorbing ability!"

Zhang Fei decided to use his Demon Absorbing ability to absorb Qian Yan’s soul power, and he also used his Devouring ability that he mimicked from Ursula back then, making the two of them draw each other’s soul power.
