She glanced at Zhang Fei and the others before standing up, and she immediately moved forward for the second challenge.
Zhang Fei was already on his second challenge, and he was once again sent to an unfamiliar place.
"What kind of place is this?" Zhang Fei wondered as he examined the place, but he saw nothing but a large mountain.
"A mountain?"
Zhang Fei considered flying to the mountain, but he decided against it when a giant eye appeared from one side.
The eye stared at him and exerted strong pressure on his soul, and he also felt that it was trying to probe him.
"What—" Zhang Fei shut his mouth and swallowed his words when he saw countless eyes appear on the mountain.
Soon, the mountain moved and transformed into a gigantic demon beast, which made him realize his identity.
"Shit!
The Ten Thousand Eyes Demon Beast God, Qian Yan.
His form is so gigantic!"
*Roar*
Qian Yan roared loudly, sending everything in the area flying.
Even Zhang Fei was pushed back by his single, extremely loud roar.
"What the hell!
His single roar can push me back so far!" Zhang Fei hurriedly fled as Qian Yan shot countless rays of darkness at him.
"Damn!
He was only born from the soul fragments in this tower, but his attack power is already so great, let alone the real him."
*Boom...
Boom...*
Those countless rays of darkness rained down on the previous area, causing numerous loud explosions and massive earthquakes in the area.
Zhang Fei stood in mid-air and stared at Qian Yan, thinking of a way to defeat him.
With the demon beast god’s gigantic size, his white lotus couldn’t possibly envelop him like it did to Yuan Xiajie earlier.
*Roar*
Zhang Fei rolled backwards as soon as Qian Yan released another loud roar, and the demon god beast once again shot countless rays of darkness at him, forcing him to flee.
"Tch!
I have to think of a way to get close to him; otherwise, I won’t be able to defeat him."
Zhang Fei suddenly realized that Qian Yan’s attacks were only perpendicular, making him certain that he would not be able to hit him if he approached him in a zigzag motion.
After the demon beast god’s attacks hit another area, Zhang Fei quickly flew towards Qian Yan by weaving in the air.
Once again, Qian Yan attacked him with his darkness rays, but the result was as Zhang Fei had expected, and he was able to dodge all of his attacks easily.
Zhang Fei accelerated his flight towards Qian Yan’s head.
However, a darkness dome enveloped the body of the demon beast god as soon as he arrived, sending him flying back as soon as he attacked.
In the next instant, Qian Yan’s darkness dome enveloped Zhang Fei’s soul and absorbed his soul power at a rapid pace, causing him to weaken.
"Damn it!
This technique is similar to my Demon Absorbing ability!"

Zhang Fei decided to use his Demon Absorbing ability to absorb Qian Yan’s soul power, and he also used his Devouring ability that he mimicked from Ursula back then, making the two of them draw each other’s soul power.

chapters.title: Chapter 1594: Third Soul Challenge
paragraphs: On the first floor, people from the Moonlit Passion Temple, the Celestial Moon Sect, the Spring Zenith Sect, and the Hidden Moon Sect were already close together.

Feng Yao, Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng could have moved faster and climbed to the second floor to catch up with Zhang Fei, but they deliberately slowed down to protect the people from the four sects.
"This way, our people will be safe from those demons, right?"
Feng Yao nodded to Su Shentian. "For now, our job is to protect our people, and we don’t need to worry about other cultivators, especially those from the Divine Samsara Sect."
"Haha," Jian Kang laughed. "The people from that sect have always been arrogant, both their leaders and disciples, so let them take care of themselves."

Zhuxian Sheng looked at the group of other cultivators. "Emperor Long and the two senior dragons are protecting the other cultivators, and those demons seem to be deliberately slowing their steps, so they should be safe."
"They’re safe for now." The three men looked at Feng Yao. "Once they enter the second floor, things will get chaotic, especially if those demons manage to complete their challenges faster than them."

Jian Kuang clasped his hands together. "You are right, Empress Huo. When we face those challenges, our souls are sent to other places, so our bodies are vulnerable to any attack, and those demons will take advantage of that opportunity to attack these people at that time."

"Yes," Feng Yao nodded as she looked at Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi. "Aren’t you two going to move forward? You two don’t need to wait for us because we have to protect these people, so you guys should go to the second floor as soon as possible."
Wang Jingzhi nodded at her and immediately stepped forward to face the next challenge.
Meanwhile, Wang Yusheng asked Feng Yao. "How did Zhang Fei and the five women reach the second floor so quickly, Empress Huo?"

"They’ve been training hard for the past few decades, and all these challenges on the first floor were useless to them in the first place." Wang Yusheng knew from the start that all the challenges were useless for Zhang Fei, but he was truly surprised that the five women could keep up with his rhythm. "His main goal in this tower is on the third floor, but he won’t be able to pass all the challenges on the second floor easily because he holds a lot of fear in his heart."
"What exactly is on the third floor?"
"Hey, Yusheng! You have to go there to see for yourself, so you should move now and reach that floor."
Wang Yusheng rebutted Jian Kuang instantly. "Tch! You’ve never reached the third floor yourself!"
"Haha," Jian Kuang laughed. "If I wanted to, I could reach that floor this time, but I still have to protect these people."
Feng Yao spoke to Wang Yusheng again. "You don’t need to ask about those challenges on the third floor because it won’t be useful for you, so you should go there and see everything for yourself."
"Alright." Wang Yusheng nodded in resignation and continued with the next challenge.
"Tch! Those people are really annoying! They protect those human cultivators, preventing us from attacking them."
Ku Shan nodded slightly. "Young Lord, you don’t need to think about them now, and we should focus on reaching the second floor."
"The second floor? Won’t all the challenges there make it more difficult for us to move against them?"

"You are wrong, Young Lord." Ku Yu looked at Ku Yin, who told him about the challenges on the second floor. "We don’t need to move too hastily now, and we will capture them when their souls are facing those challenges."
Ku Yu himself had never challenged the tower before. "What about Long Wuzhao and the two dragons? I’m sure they won’t challenge the second floor right away, and they’ll be waiting for those people."
"Be patient for now, Young Lord. We’ll think of another way to capture those people, especially those from the Divine Samsara Sect."
"Alright."
"Are we going to keep moving slowly like this, Brother?"

Qian Yu nodded to his sister. "For now, we don’t need to think about them, and we’ll focus on all the challenges ahead of us because we can’t do anything to them right now, especially with Empress Huo and the three dragons present. Once we reach the second floor, we’ll search for a good opportunity to capture them."
"Is that really doable?" Qian Hufeng immediately explained to Qian Qin all the challenges they would face on the second floor. "Does that mean we won’t face those challenges and focus on them?"
"Princess, we’ll assess the situation first, and we’ll take the next step once we get there."
Qian Qin nodded to Qian Kuang before turning her gaze forward. ’What exactly happened to me? Why is this feeling still lingering in my heart?’
Unlike them, Sha Huo and his entourage were more relaxed, and they didn’t think much of those people.
"How are you, Qingge?"
Sha Qingge sighed. "I’ve never challenged this tower before, so I’m still overwhelmed by the challenges, Brother."
"It’s okay, you don’t need to rush, and you can rest first before starting the next challenge."
"How did that person get to the second floor so fast, Brother?"

Sha Huo looked at the stairs leading to the second floor. "Based on his fight with our grand elders three days ago, he is not an ordinary cultivator that we can see every day. I feel that he is still hiding his true strength and ability, so you don’t need to be surprised about that, and we have to focus on ourselves."
"Yeah." Sha Qingge thought for a moment before taking a step forward, and she was sent elsewhere directly.
Sha Huo and the others immediately followed Sha Qingge.

On the second floor, Luo Yunxiao had just completed her challenge. She saw that Zhang Fei seemed overwhelmed by his challenge, and she could sense that her husband was weakening, especially his soul power.

"Did he face any problems in his second challenge?" Luo Yunxiao moved to sit behind Zhang Fei, pressed her palms against his back, and used the ability of her Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique to assist him. "I don’t know what you’re going through there, but I’m not leaving you alone, Husband."

Before long, Nalan Wangzi, Helian Xun’er, Tianshi Shengjie, and Yue Xuelian had completed their challenges. They were shocked by Zhang Fei’s situation, but Luo Yunxiao asked them not to worry about him and move on to the next challenge.
After thinking about it, and since they couldn’t help Zhang Fei either, the four women immediately moved on to the next challenge.
"Don’t give up! You have to get through the challenge, and I will help you with that, Husband!"

Zhang Fei, who was facing Qian Yan in the second soul challenge, suddenly sensed Luo Yunxiao’s presence. He realized that his wife was trying to help him by using the abilities of her special physique.

Zhang Fei exhaled and inhaled a few breaths before counterattacking Qian Yan, absorbing the demon beast god’s soul power. He also released the white lotus from his soul, which immediately spun rapidly above the demon beast god.
*Roar*
Qian Yan roared loudly and tried to resist it, but Zhang Fei was absorbing his soul power much faster than before thanks to Luo Yunxiao’s help.
Slowly, Qian Yan’s body began to fade as Zhang Fei absorbed his soul power faster and faster.
Fortunately, the Qian Yan in front of Zhang Fei wasn’t the real one, and their soul power was on par, but Luo Yunxiao’s help gave him the upper hand over the demon beast god.
After some time, Zhang Fei had completely absorbed Qian Yan’s soul power, causing the demon beast god to disappear from the scene.
When he opened his eyes, Zhang Fei had already returned to his body and heaved a sigh of relief. "Thank you, Yunxiao. If you hadn’t helped me, it would have taken me much longer to defeat Qian Yan."
"Eh? Are you really facing the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon God, Husband? You’ve never met him before, right? How could he appear in your soul challenge?" Luo Yunxiao was confused.

"I don’t know how he could appear in the challenge of my soul." Zhang Fei helped her up. "Even though Qian Yan’s soul power is on par with mine, I would really have a hard time dealing with him without your help."
"If so, your next challenges may not be easy, Husband."
"Although those challenges won’t be easy, I have no choice but to face them; otherwise, I won’t be able to reach the third floor."
"Hehe," Luo Yunxiao hugged him. "Alright, you don’t need to worry about those challenges, okay? If I see you struggling with the next one, I’ll help you like I did just now."
"Thank you." Thereafter, they walked to the third area and sat down. "Let’s face the next one."
"Okay."
When Zhang Fei opened his eyes, he found himself in front of a luxurious house. He recognized the house because it was his father’s, but he saw no one there.
Zhang Fei explored the house in search of the next challenge. "Why did the challenge bring me back to this house?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei turned toward the sound of laughter and saw his little self standing opposite him. "Do you know why I appeared in front of you?
"Why?"
Little Zhang Fei pointed at him. "You’re afraid of yourself, aren’t you? The soul challenge manifests your fear of yourself, so I appear before you now."

chapters.title: Chapter 1595: Fourth Soul Challenge
paragraphs: "That’s right, I’m indeed afraid of myself." Zhang Fei nodded at him. "As you said, you are the embodiment of my fear, but you don’t understand my fear. My fear isn’t for myself, but rather, I’m afraid of losing everyone I love."
"Pathetic! You’re such a loser!"

"You can say whatever you want because you’re not real, so you’ll never be able to understand or feel what it’s like to lose everyone we love." Zhang Fei clenched his fist. "I’m still weak now, but I’ll never stop striving to strengthen myself. When I become strong in the future, I will possess ultimate power, and I will be unrivaled in this universe. I won’t be afraid of anyone at that point, and I’ll kill anyone who tries to harm my loved ones. If you want to fight with me, you can come forward now, and I will face you with all the strength of my soul."
The little Zhang Fei didn’t say anything, and he turned into soul fragments before entering Zhang Fei’s body, increasing his soul power.
Zhang Fei was both confused and relieved, but he knew the challenge wasn’t over yet, as his soul was still there. If the challenge was over, his soul should have returned to his body immediately.
Zhang Fei took a deep breath when Zhang Yue appeared there, staring at him with hatred. "I hate you, Fei’er!"
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed. "You can stop that because my big sister will never hate me. Even if I become evil, she will always trust me and love me, so this challenge is useless against me."
Just like that, Zhang Yue turned into soul fragments and entered Zhang Fei’s body, but the increase in his soul power was still not significant, which disappointed him.
The people who appeared next were Zhang Lin, Qing Yi, and Zhang Chen. Just like before, Zhang Fei had no trouble dealing with them because the three women would never hate him.

Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows slightly when three other people appeared before him, especially since they were black with demon-like appearances. The three people were none other than Zhang Hai, Zhang He, and Chen Xin.
"Heh." Zhang Fei snorted as he looked at his dead big brother and ex-lover. "I’ve killed you two several times in the past, so I have nothing to fear."
"Bastard!" Zhang He and Chen Xin immediately moved to attack him.

"Since you two have appeared before me again, I will absorb your soul fragments." Zhang Fei immediately took out the white lotuses from his soul, enveloped them in it, and absorbed their soul power. "Aren’t you going to attack me, my idiot father? You are my father, but I never regret my actions towards you. After all, you are the stupidest father in the entire universe, and you can’t see the truth before your eyes."

To Zhang Fei’s surprise, Zhang Hai just stared at him and turned into soul fragments before entering his body, making him sigh in relief. He looked at Zhang Fei and Chen Xin, who were trying to free themselves from the white lotus. "Weaklings! You two were not my opponents while you were alive, and you will never be my opponents after you die."
After waiting for some time, Zhang He and Chen Xin disappeared from the scene. Zhang Fei immediately withdrew the white lotus and put it back into his soul.
Zhang Fei exhaled as he opened his eyes, greeted by Luo Yunxiao’s smile. "You seemed to have no trouble in all your previous challenges, Yunxiao."
"Hehe," Luo Yunxiao giggled. "Do you believe that I have no fear in my heart?"
"Oh? Does that mean you’re not afraid of me dying?"

Luo Yunxiao shook her head slightly. "Naturally, I’m afraid of you dying, Husband. However, I believe you won’t die that easily, and you will continue to accompany me by my side until the end of time."
"Haha," Zhang Fei hugged her and briefly kissed her. "What was your challenge just now?"

"Just a few small things related to my childhood, but I was able to sort them out without much difficulty. What about you? What kind of challenges did you encounter just now?" Zhang Fei told Luo Yunxiao about it. "Zhang He and Chen Xin again, huh? This tower doesn’t know that you’ve already faced them several times in the past, so such a challenge won’t scare you."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei looked at Tianshi Shengjie, who had just opened her eyes. "What challenge do you just face, Shengjie?"

"Nothing special." Tianshi Shengjie told him a few things. "I’ve challenged this tower in the past, so those challenges won’t affect me. However, those challenges will become more frightening every time we move forward, especially after we pass half of the area on this second floor. As we get closer to the stairs to the third floor, we’ll face three of the most formidable challenges on this floor. I failed the first three, so we need to prepare ourselves now."
"I see." Zhang Fei looked at Nalan Wangzi and Helian Xun’er. "Did you also encounter obstacles in your two challenges?"
Nalan Wangzi shook her head slightly. "My challenge was a little daunting, but I managed to overcome it with little difficulty."
"As for me, my challenge just now was too easy, so I didn’t have any trouble with it," Helian Xun’er said.
"Alright, you guys should move on to the next challenge, and I’ll wait for Yue Xuelian to finish before I continue."
The four women agreed with that, and they immediately proceeded to the next area.

Zhang Fei wanted to move on to the next challenge, but he was worried that he would face a more difficult one than the first two. Since Yuan Xiajie and Qian Yan appeared in the first two challenges, he thought that the other demon gods or even the four perils might appear in the next challenges.
"What are you thinking? Why is your expression so complicated?"

Zhang Fei looked at Yue Xuelian, who had just opened her eyes. "I’m just thinking about the next challenge because two of the previous three put me against difficult opponents. Even though I managed to get past them, I’m a little worried that I will meet stronger challenges."
"Are you afraid you will fail in facing them?"
Zhang Fei looked at the stairs leading to the third floor. "I’m not afraid of them, but I don’t want to fail, and I have to reach the third floor in one go."

"So far, only the ten people mentioned by Tianshi Shengjie have managed to reach the third floor in one go. Since then, no cultivator has ever succeeded in reaching that floor, including me. I failed the last three challenges because they were too strong for me, but I’m confident that I can pass them this time, and I will ascend to the third floor." Zhang Fei was happy to hear Yue Xuelian so confident, but he was curious about her first three challenges. "If you feel afraid, you don’t need to rush to move forward, and you can wait until you are ready."
"Are you going straight to the next challenge?"
"Yes," Yue Xuelian immediately advanced to the next area. "I’ll start now."
Zhang Fei exhaled softly and moved to the next area, and his soul was sent to another place after he sat there.
This time, Zhang Fei arrived at a pitch-black place. He spread his power to the surrounding area to detect the place, but he found nothing there.

"What’s my next challenge?" As he thought about that, Zhang Fei felt something pressing on his soul. The more he tried to fight it, the stronger the pressure became. "What’s going on here? Where is this pressure coming from?"
"Gah!"
A powerful attack suddenly struck Zhang Fei, sending him reeling backward, but he couldn’t see or feel anything there.
"Gah!"
A powerful attack suddenly struck Zhang Fei again, but he was prepared and immediately stabilized himself. He continued to try to sense the presence of others, but he found only pitch-black darkness.

"Hehehe... Hahaha..." An eerie laugh suddenly echoed through the darkness, but Zhang Fei still couldn’t find anything there. "The heir of the ten-tailed fox! I didn’t expect to meet you here! The heavens have not disappointed me by bringing you here, and I will absorb your soul power clean."
Zhang Fei felt familiar with the voice, but he couldn’t remember where he’d heard it before. "Come out now."
"Hahaha! I’ve been out since your soul arrived here, but you couldn’t see me."
"Gah!" Zhang Fei was thrown back hard and hit the floor below. "Shit!"
Zhang Fei immediately stood up and raised his guard. He tried to use his Exorcismus ability, but the darkness swallowed the light.

"Hahaha! In my darkness, your light element and abilities are useless." Zhang Fei spun around and tried to detect the direction of the voice. "I wanted to play around with you first, but I don’t have much time right now, so I’ll just drain your soul power dry."

Zhang Fei suddenly felt rope-like objects tying his entire body, but he couldn’t touch them. Those objects quickly absorbed his soul power, causing him to fall to the ground. He tried to reabsorb the soul power from the objects’ owners, but he couldn’t, and his soul rapidly weakened. "Shit!"

"Hahaha! Is this the extent of the soul power of the successor of the ten-tailed fox? Disappointing! I expected a fierce fight from you, but you couldn’t even find me, and you’re completely powerless before me!"

Zhang Fei listened to the voice angrily, but his soul power was rapidly fading away. He tried using all his abilities, but he couldn’t absorb his soul power back, let alone the soul power of the voice’s owner.

"I’m still weak now, but I’ll never stop striving to strengthen myself.
When I become strong in the future, I will possess ultimate power, and I will be unrivaled in this universe.
I won’t be afraid of anyone at that point, and I’ll kill anyone who tries to harm my loved ones.
If you want to fight with me, you can come forward now, and I will face you with all the strength of my soul."
The little Zhang Fei didn’t say anything, and he turned into soul fragments before entering Zhang Fei’s body, increasing his soul power.
Zhang Fei was both confused and relieved, but he knew the challenge wasn’t over yet, as his soul was still there.
If the challenge was over, his soul should have returned to his body immediately.
Zhang Fei took a deep breath when Zhang Yue appeared there, staring at him with hatred.
"I hate you, Fei’er!"
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed.
"You can stop that because my big sister will never hate me.
Even if I become evil, she will always trust me and love me, so this challenge is useless against me."
Just like that, Zhang Yue turned into soul fragments and entered Zhang Fei’s body, but the increase in his soul power was still not significant, which disappointed him.
The people who appeared next were Zhang Lin, Qing Yi, and Zhang Chen.
Just like before, Zhang Fei had no trouble dealing with them because the three women would never hate him.
Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows slightly when three other people appeared before him, especially since they were black with demon-like appearances.
The three people were none other than Zhang Hai, Zhang He, and Chen Xin.
"Heh." Zhang Fei snorted as he looked at his dead big brother and ex-lover.
"I’ve killed you two several times in the past, so I have nothing to fear."
"Bastard!" Zhang He and Chen Xin immediately moved to attack him.
"Since you two have appeared before me again, I will absorb your soul fragments." Zhang Fei immediately took out the white lotuses from his soul, enveloped them in it, and absorbed their soul power.
"Aren’t you going to attack me, my idiot father?
You are my father, but I never regret my actions towards you.
After all, you are the stupidest father in the entire universe, and you can’t see the truth before your eyes."
To Zhang Fei’s surprise, Zhang Hai just stared at him and turned into soul fragments before entering his body, making him sigh in relief.
He looked at Zhang Fei and Chen Xin, who were trying to free themselves from the white lotus.
"Weaklings!
You two were not my opponents while you were alive, and you will never be my opponents after you die."
After waiting for some time, Zhang He and Chen Xin disappeared from the scene.
Zhang Fei immediately withdrew the white lotus and put it back into his soul.
Zhang Fei exhaled as he opened his eyes, greeted by Luo Yunxiao’s smile.
"You seemed to have no trouble in all your previous challenges, Yunxiao."
"Hehe," Luo Yunxiao giggled.
"Do you believe that I have no fear in my heart?"
"Oh?
Does that mean you’re not afraid of me dying?"
Luo Yunxiao shook her head slightly.
"Naturally, I’m afraid of you dying, Husband.
However, I believe you won’t die that easily, and you will continue to accompany me by my side until the end of time."
"Haha," Zhang Fei hugged her and briefly kissed her.
"What was your challenge just now?"
"Just a few small things related to my childhood, but I was able to sort them out without much difficulty.
What about you?
What kind of challenges did you encounter just now?" Zhang Fei told Luo Yunxiao about it.
"Zhang He and Chen Xin again, huh?
This tower doesn’t know that you’ve already faced them several times in the past, so such a challenge won’t scare you."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei looked at Tianshi Shengjie, who had just opened her eyes.
"What challenge do you just face, Shengjie?"
"Nothing special." Tianshi Shengjie told him a few things.
"I’ve challenged this tower in the past, so those challenges won’t affect me.
However, those challenges will become more frightening every time we move forward, especially after we pass half of the area on this second floor.
As we get closer to the stairs to the third floor, we’ll face three of the most formidable challenges on this floor.
I failed the first three, so we need to prepare ourselves now."
"I see." Zhang Fei looked at Nalan Wangzi and Helian Xun’er.
"Did you also encounter obstacles in your two challenges?"
Nalan Wangzi shook her head slightly.
"My challenge was a little daunting, but I managed to overcome it with little difficulty."
"As for me, my challenge just now was too easy, so I didn’t have any trouble with it," Helian Xun’er said.
"Alright, you guys should move on to the next challenge, and I’ll wait for Yue Xuelian to finish before I continue."
The four women agreed with that, and they immediately proceeded to the next area.
Zhang Fei wanted to move on to the next challenge, but he was worried that he would face a more difficult one than the first two.
Since Yuan Xiajie and Qian Yan appeared in the first two challenges, he thought that the other demon gods or even the four perils might appear in the next challenges.
"What are you thinking?
Why is your expression so complicated?"
Zhang Fei looked at Yue Xuelian, who had just opened her eyes.
"I’m just thinking about the next challenge because two of the previous three put me against difficult opponents.
Even though I managed to get past them, I’m a little worried that I will meet stronger challenges."
"Are you afraid you will fail in facing them?"
Zhang Fei looked at the stairs leading to the third floor.
"I’m not afraid of them, but I don’t want to fail, and I have to reach the third floor in one go."
"So far, only the ten people mentioned by Tianshi Shengjie have managed to reach the third floor in one go.
Since then, no cultivator has ever succeeded in reaching that floor, including me.

I failed the last three challenges because they were too strong for me, but I’m confident that I can pass them this time, and I will ascend to the third floor." Zhang Fei was happy to hear Yue Xuelian so confident, but he was curious about her first three challenges.
"If you feel afraid, you don’t need to rush to move forward, and you can wait until you are ready."
"Are you going straight to the next challenge?"
"Yes," Yue Xuelian immediately advanced to the next area.
"I’ll start now."
Zhang Fei exhaled softly and moved to the next area, and his soul was sent to another place after he sat there.
This time, Zhang Fei arrived at a pitch-black place.
He spread his power to the surrounding area to detect the place, but he found nothing there.
"What’s my next challenge?" As he thought about that, Zhang Fei felt something pressing on his soul.
The more he tried to fight it, the stronger the pressure became.
"What’s going on here?
Where is this pressure coming from?"
"Gah!"
A powerful attack suddenly struck Zhang Fei, sending him reeling backward, but he couldn’t see or feel anything there.
"Gah!"
A powerful attack suddenly struck Zhang Fei again, but he was prepared and immediately stabilized himself.
He continued to try to sense the presence of others, but he found only pitch-black darkness.
"Hehehe...
Hahaha..." An eerie laugh suddenly echoed through the darkness, but Zhang Fei still couldn’t find anything there.
"The heir of the ten-tailed fox!
I didn’t expect to meet you here!
The heavens have not disappointed me by bringing you here, and I will absorb your soul power clean."
Zhang Fei felt familiar with the voice, but he couldn’t remember where he’d heard it before.
"Come out now."
"Hahaha!
I’ve been out since your soul arrived here, but you couldn’t see me."
"Gah!" Zhang Fei was thrown back hard and hit the floor below.
"Shit!"
Zhang Fei immediately stood up and raised his guard.
He tried to use his Exorcismus ability, but the darkness swallowed the light.
"Hahaha!
In my darkness, your light element and abilities are useless." Zhang Fei spun around and tried to detect the direction of the voice.
"I wanted to play around with you first, but I don’t have much time right now, so I’ll just drain your soul power dry."
Zhang Fei suddenly felt rope-like objects tying his entire body, but he couldn’t touch them.
Those objects quickly absorbed his soul power, causing him to fall to the ground.
He tried to reabsorb the soul power from the objects’ owners, but he couldn’t, and his soul rapidly weakened.
"Shit!"
"Hahaha!
Is this the extent of the soul power of the successor of the ten-tailed fox?
Disappointing!
I expected a fierce fight from you, but you couldn’t even find me, and you’re completely powerless before me!"
Zhang Fei listened to the voice angrily, but his soul power was rapidly fading away.
He tried using all his abilities, but he couldn’t absorb his soul power back, let alone the soul power of the voice’s owner.

chapters.title: Chapter 1596: Zhang Fei - Dugu Yuanshen
paragraphs: Dugu Yuanshen opened his eyes and looked at Zhang Fei, whose body was beginning to be enveloped in a black aura.

"As expected, he’s a demon, but I couldn’t sense his demon aura until now, and it seems to have gone out of control due to his fourth soul challenge. I don’t know what he’s facing there, but he must be aware that the challenge before him isn’t real, or he’ll be affected by it." Dugu Yuanshen raised an eyebrow when Zhang Fei changed his form, which was a combination of his four forms. "What the hell? Who exactly is this young man? I sense four different auras from his body—a human aura, a beast aura, a demon aura, and a deadly aura."
*Boom*

As soon as the explosion occurred, it was followed by a powerful pressure spreading throughout the area. Dugu Yuanshen waved his hand and created a barrier to protect all his disciples who were undergoing their challenges.

Dugu Yuanshen took a deep breath as four shadows appeared behind Zhang Fei. "How is this possible? How can a single living being have four different forms? A human, a fox, a lust demon, and a dragon! If I’m not mistaken, the deadly aura I sensed earlier came from his dragon form, and his dragon form is truly terrifying even to me."
"Master, what happened here?"
"Look at him, Feiyan." Ru Feiyan looked at Zhang Fei, who was pointed at by Dugu Yuanshen. "Have you ever seen a living being like him?"
Ru Feiyan shook her head slightly. "How can he have four different forms, Master? I have never seen a single living being with four forms in one body before."

"I have never seen a living being like him in my entire life." Dugu Yuanshen thought for a moment before flicking his finger, and a golden light quickly shot into Zhang Fei’s body. "I don’t want to do this, but if he goes out of control due to his soul challenge, the situation will become even more dangerous, and we will face serious problems as a result."
Ru Feiyan looked at her master. "Are you sure it won’t cause him trouble? After all, we can’t help other cultivators in their challenges, or they’ll be disqualified by the tower."
"Don’t worry." Dugu Yuanshen pointed at Luo Yunxiao. "That young woman helped him in his second challenge, but the tower didn’t expel him, so I don’t think my help will cause him to fail."
"Could it be because he is different from other living beings?"

"Perhaps." Dugu Yuanshen himself didn’t have an answer for that because he had never encountered such a living being before. "Alright, you don’t need to worry about that man, and you can move on to the next challenge. Only the last three challenges remain for you, and you will come with me to the third floor after you complete them."
"Yes, Master."

Dugu Yuanshen focused his gaze on Zhang Fei’s fourth form. "What kind of dragon is that? I’ve met many dragons in the past, but I’ve never seen his dragon form before. If I look closely, his dragon form is a bit similar to Emperor Long, but he’s an evil dragon."
Naturally, Dugu Yuanshen had never seen Zhang Fei’s dragon form before. After all, there was only one Calamity Demon Dragon in the universe, just like the five-clawed golden dragon.

In the midst of the challenge, Zhang Fei suddenly felt something appear within his soul, and a bright golden light shot out of it, illuminating the darkness that even his light element couldn’t illuminate.
"No... No..." The voice screamed in panic as it happened. "This can’t be happening! I can’t let him get out of this place!"
*Boom*
An explosion occurred when the invisible creature was about to attack Zhang Fei, and the golden light quickly swept through the darkness, revealing the beast.
"I can see you now." Zhang Fei stood up and looked at the beast. "You must be Taotie, one of the four perils."
"I will kill you!" Taotie roared and attacked him again.

Unlike before, Zhang Fei could easily block his attack, and he grabbed his front paw. "I was never afraid of you, Taotie. Before, you could attack me because I couldn’t see you, but the situation has changed now, so I’ll end it now."
"Argh!" Taotie roared in pain as Zhang Fei used his devouring and absorbing abilities. "Bastard! You got lucky this time, but I’ll kill you the next time we meet!"

"Heh!" Zhang Fei snorted and sped up his actions, absorbing Taotie’s soul fragment. "You’re just a soul fragment, so you can’t fight me. When I’m ready, I’ll go meet you out there, and I’ll kill you then."
"Bastard! Don’t get cocky! You won’t be able to do anything without outside help!"
"I know." Zhang Fei nodded. "Now begone!"
After Taotie vanished and his soul absorbed the soul fragments, Zhang Fei exhaled with relief. "Phew."
The moment Zhang Fei opened his eyes, the four shadows of his four forms immediately disappeared. He looked at Dugu Yuanshen, who was also looking at him. "Thank you for your help, Senior."
"Don’t mind it." Then, Dugu Yuanshen asked him, "Who are you, Young Man? How can you have four different forms? What is your fourth dragon form?"
"My name is Zhang Fei from the Moonlit Passion Temple."
"Oh?" Dugu Yuanshen was taken aback. "Are you the mysterious person who brought great changes to the sect?"
"I am," Zhang Fei replied with a nod. "As for my dragon form, I can’t tell you about it for the safety of myself and everyone around me, Senior."
"But you can tell me about how you can have four different forms, right? A human, a fox beast, a lust demon, and a dragon."

"Long story short, a mysterious woman accidentally killed me in the past, and she revived me. However, I don’t know her identity because I never met or talked to her, and she had already disappeared when I opened my eyes. Since then, I have had three different forms, and I obtained my dragon form several years ago in the Three Mortal Realms." Since Dugu Yuanshen already knew everything, Zhang Fei did not cover it up and showed his four different forms to the old man, stunning him. "I was born as an ordinary human, but her actions made me have the identities of a fox beast and a lust demon."

"Honestly, your story is difficult to believe, but I have never seen another living being with four different forms like you, and I can’t sense your other auras when you use any of your forms." Dugu Yuanshen tried to sense Zhang Fei’s aura before continuing. "As of now, I can only sense your human aura, and I can’t sense your beast and beast auras."
"When I’m in my human form, my other three auras are always hidden, so other people don’t know my other three forms."

"I see." Dugu Yuanshen looked at Nalan Wangzi, Tianshi Shengji, Luo Yunxiao, and Helian Xue’er. "At first, I was confused about your relationship with those four women, but I finally got the answer to my confusion after seeing your four forms with my own eyes. No wonder you were able to bring about such big changes in the Moonlit Passion Temple, and you also succeeded in recruiting people from all races to join your sect."
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed. "Wouldn’t it be great if all races coexisted harmoniously without any problems, Senior?"

"However, peace among all races is very difficult to achieve, Young Man. Whether humans, beasts, winged races, demons, or demihumans, each has their ambitions, which have given rise to conflicts that have been passed down through generations."

"All the conflicts that occur in this universe stem from the ambition and greed of all living beings, and they will never end if those people don’t change their mindset. If they don’t control their ambitions, their actions will negatively impact this universe and slowly destroy it." Zhang Fei sighed. "This universe is too big, and I can’t do anything about it. At least, I can do something for those closest to me, and I want to make my sect the best place for all races to gather in peace."
"Can it really be done? I’ve heard about your sect from Li Tianyu, but I’ve never visited there before."

"You can see everything for yourself, Senior." Zhang Fei created several qi screens showing the situation in the Moonlit Passion Temple, where people of various races gathered and practiced together without thinking about their differences.
Dugu Yuanshen nodded repeatedly as he looked at everyone. "I never thought that all races could truly live together in one place. Have they never clashed with each other?"
"So far, there have never been any clashes between them, Senior. If they dare to do so within my sect, I will punish them severely, including killing them, depending on their offense."
"I see." Dugu Yuanshen nodded in understanding. "In that case, you can continue your challenge again, and we’ll have a good talk if you make it to the third floor."
Zhang Fei removed all the qi screens. "Thank you again for your help earlier, Senior."

"You don’t need to think about that, but you must always remember that all the challenges on this second floor are not real. All the challenges that appear before you stem from your fears, and you should be able to overcome them as easily as long as you can overcome your fears."
"Thank you for your advice, Senior." Zhang Fei looked at Luo Yunxiao and the others before moving forward. "I’ll start now."
Dugu Yuanshen looked at Zhang Fei, who had already begun his next challenge. "This kid is really interesting."

chapters.title: Chapter 1597: Fifth Soul Challenge
paragraphs: Luo Yunxiao opened her eyes and looked at her husband, who was already one step ahead of her. "He didn’t seem to have any difficulty in his previous challenge."
"That kid is different from other cultivators, but he still often struggles to overcome his fear." Luo Yunxiao looked at Dugu Yuanshen. "Can you tell me your true identity, Young Lady?"
Luo Yunxiao hesitated for a moment. "My name is Luo Yunxiao, the daughter of Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi."
"Oh?" Dugu Yuanshen was taken aback. "About ten years ago, I had heard rumors that Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi had a daughter, but I never tried to find out the truth."

"Hehe," Luo Yunxiao giggled. "My parents deliberately hid my identity because people from the Stygian Dusk Domain were targeting them, so no one knew about me until my marriage to my husband about ten years ago."
"Does the destruction of several heretical sects in the Stygian Dusk Domain, such as the Dusk Pavilion, have anything to do with your husband?"

"About six years ago, Hun Lingwu did something to two women on our side, but my husband managed to thwart his plans. However, that old man didn’t give up and enlisted the help of those people to attack our sect, so my husband destroyed them."

"They were evil cultivators who consistently caused trouble across many domains, and your husband was justified in destroying them." Dugu Yuanshen looked at Nalan Wangzi and Tianshi Shengjie. "How did your husband manage to get the first princess of the Soul-Devouring Demon Race and the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race as his wives?"

"Haha," Luo Yunxiao softly laughed before telling Dugu Yuanshen about Zhang Fei’s relationship with the Soul-Devouring Demon Race. "As for Tianshi Shengjie, she sent her avatar to the Three Mortal Realms, and they met on one of the planets there when my husband was just starting his cultivation path. They met for real after my husband ascended to this Paradise Realm, and their relationship developed to this extent."
"Your husband has shown me his four forms before, so I’m no longer surprised that he was able to get them as his wife."
"Eh?" Dugu Yuanshen explained to Luo Yunxiao the reasons behind Zhang Fei’s decision. "In that case, I have to thank you because you helped my husband, Senior."
"Your husband has already thanked me, so you don’t need to do it again. I won’t waste your time anymore, and you can continue your challenge."
"Yes, Senior." Luo Yunxiao walked over and sat by Zhang Fei’s side before her soul was sent to the challenge ground.

’Although I don’t have any concrete evidence, I feel that this young man is the mastermind behind the changes in this Paradise Realm. After all, he is the only living being with four identities, so he must have something special within him. If that’s true, he might be the key to bringing peace to all races, and I will wait until that day comes to witness all his actions.’ Dugu Yuanshen smiled to himself before closing his eyes again.
Soon, Nalan Wangzi, Tianshi Shengjie, Helian Xun’er, and Yue Xuelian had completed their challenges. They immediately moved to Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao’s side to take on the next challenge.

"Unfortunately, I only met Senior Shizu Jiao once, and the person who came from that realm kept changing since our last meeting."

"Other domains?"

"Not only have I heard of that place, but I’ve also entered it once. I heard that the Luo Clan of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary obtained their ultimate technique from there, but I didn’t find anything when I entered there. Have you entered that place before?"

"Alright, we have to discuss something else later, and you have to continue the challenges of your soul. "So, there are only ten soul challenges, right?"

"I know." Zhang Fei immediately moved to the side of the five women and began the next challenge.

This is your soul challenge, so you should already know what you have to do to fish in this sea, right?"

"Who built the tower?"
"This universe."
"So, the tower was created naturally, huh?"

"That’s right." The old man looked at Zhang Fei. "Since this tower was completed, I’ve seen countless cultivators from the Paradise Realm challenge it. Unfortunately, only ten cultivators managed to reach the third floor, but they couldn’t go beyond the gate."

"No one?"

"She is on the first floor now to protect my people."

"No one."

Zhang Fei furrowed his brows and considered the old man’s words.

"Then—" Zhang Fei didn’t finish his sentence because the old man suddenly disappeared, leaving him there alone. "How long do I have to stay here? Can I catch that fish faster if I use more of my soul power as bait?"
"Hehehe," Luo Yunxiao giggled after she lifted the biggest fish from the sea. "Old man, this challenge is too easy for me."
The old man nodded to her. "You are a patient woman, and you have no burdens in your heart and mind, unlike your husband."

"I’ll send you out now."

Be patient, and you will get the best results."
Zhang Fei sighed and started fishing again.
"Why couldn’t those people go beyond the gate in the past, Old Man?"
"They don’t have the key to open the gate."
"What is that key?
Where is it?"
"The key is always on the third floor, but none of them can see it."
"No one?"
"Yes."
Zhang Fei found this strange.
"Since you know about them, you should know about the woman named Huo Yanling, right?"
"I’ve met that woman in the past, and she managed to complete this challenge in one try.
However, she didn’t succeed in finding the key, and she has never challenged this tower again since then."
"She is on the first floor now to protect my people."
"I see."
"Have cultivators from across the gate ever come down to this Paradise Realm, Old Man?"
"No one."
"Why?"
"I don’t know." The old man looked up at the sky.
"They were never able to descend to the Paradise Realm in the past, and they were even less able to do so after the gate was sealed.
If you want to go there, you must find the key and open the gate, but you must first complete all the soul challenges on the second floor to go to the third floor."
"I know that."
"I warn you not to underestimate the final challenge; otherwise, you will die, and your body will be taken over by something."
"What do you mean by that?"
"Be patient, Young Man.
You will know what I mean when you reach the final challenge, and you must be careful because no one can help you in that challenge."
Zhang Fei furrowed his brows and considered the old man’s words.
"Then—" Zhang Fei didn’t finish his sentence because the old man suddenly disappeared, leaving him there alone.
"How long do I have to stay here?
Can I catch that fish faster if I use more of my soul power as bait?"
"Hehehe," Luo Yunxiao giggled after she lifted the biggest fish from the sea.
"Old man, this challenge is too easy for me."
The old man nodded to her.
"You are a patient woman, and you have no burdens in your heart and mind, unlike your husband."
"My husband has a big responsibility, so it’s natural that he has many burdens on his heart and mind, right?" Luo Yunxiao immediately absorbed the fish.
"I’m sure he will overcome all the challenges ahead, and we will go to the third floor together."
"I’ll send you out now."

chapters.title: Chapter 1599: Dugu Yuanshen’s Warning
paragraphs: When Luo Yunxiao’s soul returned to her body, she found Tianshi Shengjie had already opened her eyes. "You passed it easily, huh?"

"I’m a celestial dragon, so it wasn’t difficult for me to catch the biggest fish in the previous challenge." Tianshi Shengjie looked at Zhang Fei. "He’ll likely take a long time in that challenge, especially if he’s impatient and angry. The challenge isn’t difficult, and we only need patience and calm to catch that fish, but he doesn’t have either now."

"Yes." Luo Yunxiao looked towards the entrance, where Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi were standing. The two wasted no time and immediately began the first soul challenge. "It seems they’ve challenged this tower many times in the past; otherwise, they wouldn’t have been able to pass all the challenges on the first floor so quickly."

"Many cultivators have challenged this tower dozens or even hundreds of times in the past, but none of them have ever reached the third floor before." Tianshi Shengjie looked at Dugu Yuanshen and the people from the War God Pavilion. "It looks like the situation will be different this year, as they are just a few steps away from completing all the challenges on the second floor, and their master will be the first."

Luo Yunxiao agreed with her. "Unfortunately, none of the people from our domain have reached this floor yet, and they likely still need some time to complete all the challenges on the first floor, as will the demons of the three races."

"With my father and the others present on the first floor, those demons won’t dare move quickly, which is good for those people. If the demons arrive on the second floor too quickly, this place will become a battlefield, and those people will face serious trouble." Tianshi Shengjie moved on to the next challenge. "We don’t need to wait for them. We should proceed directly to the next challenge."
Luo Yunxiao followed behind Tianshi Shengjie, and the two were immediately sent to the location of the seventh challenge.

Not long after, Nalan Wangzi, Helian Xun’er, and Yue Xuelian had completed the sixth challenge. They looked at Zhang Fei, who was still undergoing his challenge, before following Luo Yunxiao and Tianshi Shengjie.

"Their speed in completing their soul challenges is truly astonishing, but I didn’t expect Yue Xuelian to be able to keep up with them. If everything continues smoothly, they should be able to reach the third floor faster than my disciples. Moreover, Empress Huo, Emperor Long, and the two dragons are in this tower to protect the people of their domain, so they don’t need to worry about their safety." Dugu Yuanshen looked at Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi. "Those two youngsters from the Wang Clan are still eager to challenge this tower, even though they’ve failed repeatedly. They seem to have prepared themselves better and managed to achieve this much faster, so they’ll probably make it to the third floor this time."
"Haha," Long Wuzhao laughed as he arrived at Feng Yao’s side. "Aren’t you going to continue to the second floor?"

Feng Yao shook her head slightly. "I can go straight up to the second floor if I like, but I have to wait for the people from the Twin Flames Domain to go up there first; otherwise, those demons will attack and capture them."

"I know." Long Wuzhao nodded as he looked at the people from the three demon races, who were still behind. "They likely don’t know that Mo Shentian has been trapped in the tower for years; otherwise, they wouldn’t have gone to the trouble of capturing these people. Do you think he would be able to break free from there? Without him and his subordinates’ presence, the Celestial Demon Race would not be able to fight the others, and they would probably be destroyed in their hands."

"Wouldn’t that be better?" Feng Yao asked back with a smile. "If the Celestial Demon Race is destroyed, there will be one less problem, and the other demon races will fight each other to determine Mo Shentian’s successor."

Long Wuzhao exhaled softly. "If the Celestial Demon Race is destroyed, the other demon races will lose control. They will target other domains, which will throw the situation in this Paradise Realm into chaos again. If that happens, the casualties from all races will be too great."
"Haha," Feng Yao chuckled. "Unlike you, I don’t really care about them, and I only care about Zhang Fei. Those people won’t be able to help me, so I won’t waste my time protecting them."
"You are still as selfish as ever, Empress Huo."
"If you were in my position, you would think the same as me." Long Wuzhao raised an eyebrow. "I won’t explain the details to you because you can’t help me, and Zhang Fei is my only hope."

Long Wuzhao wanted to ask Feng Yao something, but he immediately gave up because he was sure she wouldn’t give him an answer. He looked towards the stairs to the second floor, where several people from the Divine Samsara Sect were already preparing to ascend to the next floor. "Those young kids are much better than they were a few years ago, and the number of them who managed to overcome all the challenges on this floor is much greater than before."

"Yes," Feng Yao nodded at him. "The Divine Samsara Sect has more resources than other sects or clans, and three of their ancestors have reached the third floor in the past, so it’s natural that many of their disciples have made it to the second floor. If they can’t make it, they should give up their cultivation and live as ordinary people."
Long Wuzhao could only shake his head at Feng Yao’s remarks. "Why don’t you bring your subordinates to this tower? They should be able to reach the third floor easily, right?"
"Some of them, like Huo Mengyi and Huo Mingyi, should be able to reach the third floor. However, I ordered them to protect the Twin Flames Domain, as Zhang Fei will probably be gone long after this."
"Hmm?" Long Wuzhao looked at Feng Yao. "Has Zhang Fei decided to go to the Ancient Realm? Is he going there via the Ancient Desolation Domain?"
Feng Yao pointed her finger up. "Zhang Fei will probably go to the Ancient Realm through this tower."
"This tower? Are you saying the gate on the third floor can take us to the Ancient Realm?"

"If we can open the gate, we’ll arrive at another Tower of Eternity located in the Zhanlu Domain. However, the situation in that domain is extremely dangerous, and it’s become even more so after the appearance of those shadowy creatures."
"Shadowy creatures?"
Feng Yao nodded. "They appeared in the Ancient Realm about a year ago, and they control many living creatures there, especially demons and beasts."
"Where did they appear from? What is their purpose?"
"They emerged from the core of this universe, and I can’t confirm their final goal yet."
"Who exactly are you, Empress Huo? How can you know so many things that others don’t?"
Feng Yao shook her head slightly. "You’ll know everything in the future, so don’t worry about it and focus on the problems in front of you."
Long Wuzhao sighed and didn’t ask about the matter anymore; instead, they talked about other matters.

After struggling for several days, Li Guangyu and the core disciples of the Divine Samsara Sect finally reached the second floor. They were quite surprised to see Zhang Fei already in the sixth area and the five women in the area ahead.

"How can they move so fast, Vice Sect Master? Didn’t you say earlier that all the challenges on the second floor are much more difficult than those on the first?" Wang Tieshan asked as he looked at them.

"They seem to be soul cultivators with high soul power; otherwise, they wouldn’t have been able to complete their challenges so quickly." Li Guangyu looked at Dugu Yuanshen, who was sitting in front of the third step. "I already knew you would be here, Old Dugu."

Dugu Yuanshen opened his eyes and looked at them. "Hahaha! I have no other business in my pavilion, so I’m staying in this tower to reach the third floor, and I’ll go there after my disciples complete their challenges on this floor. By the way, you guys must not disturb that young man, or you won’t be able to leave this tower alive."
"Hmm?" Li Guangyu and his disciples frowned. "Do you see anything special about him, Old Dugu?"

Dugu Yuanshen nodded at him. "Old Li, I know what you’re thinking, but I warn you not to do anything to him. I don’t need to protect or help him, and he alone is more than enough to fight all of you."
"Aren’t you thinking too highly of him, Old Dugu? I mean, I know he’s special, but his cultivation is still far below ours, so—"

"You always think that cultivation level is everything." Dugu Yuanshen shook his head. "You don’t know anything about him, and he’s far stronger than he appears. I’ve already warned you about him, so it’s up to you, and I won’t interfere in your affairs."
After that, Dugu Yuanshen didn’t say anything more to them and closed his eyes, leaving Li Guangyu to think to himself.
"Vice Sect Master, I will begin the challenges on this floor." Hua Liuying and several disciples immediately went to the first area to begin their challenges.
Li Guangyu exhaled softly. "Tieshan, you should start too, and I will protect you all from here."
"Yes."

chapters.title: Chapter 1600: Passed Seventh Soul Challenge
paragraphs: Li Guangyu sat in front of the entrance and looked at Yue Xuelian sitting beside Luo Yunxiao and the others. "What exactly is her relationship with all those women? Why did she join them? Besides, Empress Huo clearly protects all the women of the Celestial Moon Sect, and she once announced that the Moonlit Passion Temple and the Twin Flames Domain are under her protection."

Li Guangyu turned his gaze to Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi. He felt that these two young cultivators, especially the woman, were far more talented than their cousin, Wang Tieshan. Unfortunately, they were unwilling to join his sect, so his sect had recruited their cousin in the past.

Li Guangyu recalled the incident that affected their family, including their parents’ deaths while saving Wang Tieshan. After their cousin joined the sect, he looked down on them and the rest of the Wang Clan. "They have wasted their talents! If they were willing to join my sect, they would definitely be much stronger than their cousin now, especially Wang Jingzhi."
Li Guangyu’s eyes fell on Zhang Fei, and he thought about doing something to him, but he remembered Dugu Yuanshen’s previous words.

Li Guangyu wasn’t afraid of Zhang Fei, but he was afraid of Feng Yao, who clearly supported and protected him. If he provoked her wrath, he and his sect would be unable to face her, which would make him think twice. ’I should wait for the others to arrive here and discuss him with them.’
Soon, the group of cultivators who had challenged the tower in the past entered the second floor, and they hurried to begin their first challenge there.

Dugu Yuanshen, who was sitting in front of the stairs to the third floor with his eyes closed, noticed their presence. He couldn’t care less about them, and he was completely focused on Zhang Fei, waiting for him to complete his sixth challenge.
In the sixth challenge, Zhang Fei finally managed to catch the biggest fish , and he immediately absorbed its soul fragment before his soul went back to his body.

When he opened his eyes, Zhang Fei saw that there were already countless cultivators on the second floor, but they were still struggling to pass the first challenge, including the Wang Siblings and people from the Divine Samsara Sect.

Zhang Fei saw Li Guangyu keeping an eye on him from the front door of the second floor. He activated his demon eyes to examine the old man’s soul, discovering something ominous within. ’Heh! Greed, jealousy, and envy are indeed terrifying! Even an old and experienced cultivator like him is not immune to the influence of these three.’
"You’ve finally completed your sixth challenge, husband," Luo Yunxiao spoke with a sweet smile on her face.
"What took you so long to complete your sixth challenge, Zhang Fei?"

"Do you even need to ask that, Xun’er?" Nalan Wangzi asked, shaking his head. "He must have been impatient and restless from catching the biggest fish before, so it took him so long to complete his sixth challenge."
"Haha," Tianshi Shengjie softly laughed. "How many fish did you catch before you caught the biggest one?"
Yue Xuelian didn’t say anything to Zhang Fei, but her expression showed that she couldn’t wait to hear his answer.
"Phew," Zhang Fei exhaled softly. "How many days have passed?"
"Three days! We finished our seventh challenge just now, but you still haven’t woken up."

"Three days, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered under his breath. "I can’t be patient when it comes to things like fishing, so it took me so long to finish it. Even so, it wasn’t in vain because I absorbed a lot of soul fragments from other soul fish, so I’m satisfied with that. Why don’t the five of you immediately proceed to the eighth challenge?"
"Apart from Luo Yunxiao, the seventh challenge consumed a lot of our soul power, so we want to recover it first before moving on to the eighth challenge," Yue Xuelian answered him.

Helian Xun’er also spoke. "Besides, the last three challenges are much more difficult than the first seven, especially the final one, which is the hardest of all. That’s why we don’t want to rush, and we want to prepare ourselves before taking on the next challenge."

Zhang Fei checked the soul power of each woman and discovered that it had dropped significantly for everyone except Luo Yunxiao. He gave them some pills, allowing them to recover their soul power faster.
"If you guys want to go first, you guys can do so after your soul power recovers, and you don’t need to wait for me." Zhang Fei immediately moved to the seventh location. "I’ll start now."
"How long will it take him to complete the seventh challenge?" Nalan Wangzi asked the others.
Helian Xun’er answered her. "If he can see the truth hidden within the challenge, he can complete it faster than us, but vice versa."

"The seventh challenge is actually easy, but we overlooked the truth, so it took us three days to complete it." The two women agreed with Tianshi Shengjie. "If he could find the truth sooner, he would finish faster than us."

Unlike the three women, Luo Yunxiao was not worried about Zhang Fei, and she was more worried about the cultivators who were increasingly filling the second floor. Unfortunately, the people from the sects of the Twin Flames Domain still had not reached that floor, and they were still struggling with all the challenges on the first floor.
Luo Yunxiao looked at Yue Xuelian, who seemed uneasy. "What happened to you, Sect Master Yue?"

"Sigh." Yue Xuelian released a soft sigh. "Ancestor Ningxue has been on her way to this domain since eight days ago, and she will probably arrive in two weeks or sooner. In fact, she is one of only three cultivators from the Divine Samsara Sect to have ever reached the third floor, so all the challenges on the first and second floors will be no significant obstacle for her."

Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding. "I don’t think you need to worry about her, Sect Master Yue. My husband’s two clones are out there accompanying my sisters in training, and they will definitely stop her."

After spending several years in the training space, Yue Xuelian naturally knew that Zhang Fei had the strength to defeat Yue Ningxue. However, she didn’t want him to interfere in their dispute, as it would negatively impact the Moonlit Passion Temple, and the people of the Divine Samsara Sect would consider them enemies who needed to be eliminated.

"Don’t worry, okay?" Luo Yunxiao embraced her. "Leave Yue Ningxue’s affairs to my husband, and he will do something to stop her from reaching this tower. He’s not a reckless person, and he’ll think of something to keep her from recognizing his identity, so she won’t know anything about him or the Moonlit Passion Temple."
Yue Xuelian nodded at her before looking at the other cultivators. "Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi have already reached the second challenge, but their cousin is faster than them."
"Hmm?" Luo Yunxiao looked at Wang Tieshan. "That man is stronger than them, and Liang Huizhong seems to have given him something to assist him in all these challenges."
"Yes," Yue Xuelian agreed with her, as she could feel that Wang Tieshan’s soul power was not that high, but he could pass the first soul challenge so easily.

"Yawn." Yue Xuelian and the four women turned to Zhang Fei, who had already completed the seventh challenge. "Why are you looking at me like that? The challenge just now was the easiest of all the previous ones, and I could see the truth behind it with a single glance."

"Haha," Dugu Yuanshen laughed from afar. "You’re right, Young Man. The seventh challenge is the easiest of the ten challenges, but not all cultivators can see the truth behind it as easily as you, so they spend a long time completing it. Even I took a year when I challenged this tower for the first time in the past, and I almost gave up then. However, you must not underestimate the eighth challenge because it is one of the three hardest challenges, and you will die if you are not careful and underestimate it."

Zhang Fei looked at him. "Senior, I never underestimate anything, even the smallest thing, let alone all the challenges in this tower. I must reach the third floor of this tower, so I will face the last three challenges seriously."

"It’s good that you have such a mentality." Dugu Yuanshen glanced at Yue Xuelian. "Since your soul power is still full, you should proceed to the eighth challenge. I will protect them for you, especially Sect Master Yue."
Yue Xuelian was surprised to hear that from Dugu Yuanshen, and Zhang Fei immediately spoke to the old man. "I entrust them to you, Senior."
"Leave everything to me, and you just need to focus on your eighth challenge."
"Yes," Zhang Fei immediately moved to the eighth area and started the challenge in that area.
"Why do you want to protect us, Sect Master Dugu?" Yue Xuelian asked him.

Dugu Yuanshen looked at her. "That young man is quite interesting, and he might succeed in opening the gate on the third floor. That’s why I decided to protect the five of you, so he can fully focus on the final three challenges."
"Do you know the mystery behind the tower, Senior?"

Dugu Yuanshen shook his head at Luo Yunxiao. "I’ve never been to the third floor before, but I’ve heard about the gate. No one, including Emperor Long, has been able to open it. Somehow I have a feeling that your husband can do it, and I want to watch him do it."

He couldn’t care less about them, and he was completely focused on Zhang Fei, waiting for him to complete his sixth challenge.
In the sixth challenge, Zhang Fei finally managed to catch the biggest fish , and he immediately absorbed its soul fragment before his soul went back to his body.

When he opened his eyes, Zhang Fei saw that there were already countless cultivators on the second floor, but they were still struggling to pass the first challenge, including the Wang Siblings and people from the Divine Samsara Sect.
Zhang Fei saw Li Guangyu keeping an eye on him from the front door of the second floor.
He activated his demon eyes to examine the old man’s soul, discovering something ominous within. ’Heh!
Greed, jealousy, and envy are indeed terrifying!
Even an old and experienced cultivator like him is not immune to the influence of these three.’
"You’ve finally completed your sixth challenge, husband," Luo Yunxiao spoke with a sweet smile on her face.
"What took you so long to complete your sixth challenge, Zhang Fei?"
"Do you even need to ask that, Xun’er?" Nalan Wangzi asked, shaking his head.
"He must have been impatient and restless from catching the biggest fish before, so it took him so long to complete his sixth challenge."
"Haha," Tianshi Shengjie softly laughed.
"How many fish did you catch before you caught the biggest one?"
Yue Xuelian didn’t say anything to Zhang Fei, but her expression showed that she couldn’t wait to hear his answer.
"Phew," Zhang Fei exhaled softly.
"How many days have passed?"
"Three days!
We finished our seventh challenge just now, but you still haven’t woken up."
"Three days, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered under his breath.
"I can’t be patient when it comes to things like fishing, so it took me so long to finish it.
Even so, it wasn’t in vain because I absorbed a lot of soul fragments from other soul fish, so I’m satisfied with that.
Why don’t the five of you immediately proceed to the eighth challenge?"
"Apart from Luo Yunxiao, the seventh challenge consumed a lot of our soul power, so we want to recover it first before moving on to the eighth challenge," Yue Xuelian answered him.
Helian Xun’er also spoke.
"Besides, the last three challenges are much more difficult than the first seven, especially the final one, which is the hardest of all.
That’s why we don’t want to rush, and we want to prepare ourselves before taking on the next challenge."
Zhang Fei checked the soul power of each woman and discovered that it had dropped significantly for everyone except Luo Yunxiao.
He gave them some pills, allowing them to recover their soul power faster.
"If you guys want to go first, you guys can do so after your soul power recovers, and you don’t need to wait for me." Zhang Fei immediately moved to the seventh location.
"I’ll start now."
"How long will it take him to complete the seventh challenge?" Nalan Wangzi asked the others.
Helian Xun’er answered her.
"If he can see the truth hidden within the challenge, he can complete it faster than us, but vice versa."
"The seventh challenge is actually easy, but we overlooked the truth, so it took us three days to complete it." The two women agreed with Tianshi Shengjie.
"If he could find the truth sooner, he would finish faster than us."
Unlike the three women, Luo Yunxiao was not worried about Zhang Fei, and she was more worried about the cultivators who were increasingly filling the second floor.
Unfortunately, the people from the sects of the Twin Flames Domain still had not reached that floor, and they were still struggling with all the challenges on the first floor.
Luo Yunxiao looked at Yue Xuelian, who seemed uneasy.
"What happened to you, Sect Master Yue?"
"Sigh." Yue Xuelian released a soft sigh.
"Ancestor Ningxue has been on her way to this domain since eight days ago, and she will probably arrive in two weeks or sooner.

In fact, she is one of only three cultivators from the Divine Samsara Sect to have ever reached the third floor, so all the challenges on the first and second floors will be no significant obstacle for her."
Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding.
"I don’t think you need to worry about her, Sect Master Yue.
My husband’s two clones are out there accompanying my sisters in training, and they will definitely stop her."
After spending several years in the training space, Yue Xuelian naturally knew that Zhang Fei had the strength to defeat Yue Ningxue.

However, she didn’t want him to interfere in their dispute, as it would negatively impact the Moonlit Passion Temple, and the people of the Divine Samsara Sect would consider them enemies who needed to be eliminated.
"Don’t worry, okay?" Luo Yunxiao embraced her.
"Leave Yue Ningxue’s affairs to my husband, and he will do something to stop her from reaching this tower.
He’s not a reckless person, and he’ll think of something to keep her from recognizing his identity, so she won’t know anything about him or the Moonlit Passion Temple."
Yue Xuelian nodded at her before looking at the other cultivators.
"Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi have already reached the second challenge, but their cousin is faster than them."
"Hmm?" Luo Yunxiao looked at Wang Tieshan.
"That man is stronger than them, and Liang Huizhong seems to have given him something to assist him in all these challenges."
"Yes," Yue Xuelian agreed with her, as she could feel that Wang Tieshan’s soul power was not that high, but he could pass the first soul challenge so easily.
"Yawn." Yue Xuelian and the four women turned to Zhang Fei, who had already completed the seventh challenge.
"Why are you looking at me like that?
The challenge just now was the easiest of all the previous ones, and I could see the truth behind it with a single glance."
"Haha," Dugu Yuanshen laughed from afar.
"You’re right, Young Man.
The seventh challenge is the easiest of the ten challenges, but not all cultivators can see the truth behind it as easily as you, so they spend a long time completing it.
Even I took a year when I challenged this tower for the first time in the past, and I almost gave up then.
However, you must not underestimate the eighth challenge because it is one of the three hardest challenges, and you will die if you are not careful and underestimate it."
Zhang Fei looked at him.
"Senior, I never underestimate anything, even the smallest thing, let alone all the challenges in this tower.
I must reach the third floor of this tower, so I will face the last three challenges seriously."
"It’s good that you have such a mentality." Dugu Yuanshen glanced at Yue Xuelian.
"Since your soul power is still full, you should proceed to the eighth challenge.
I will protect them for you, especially Sect Master Yue."
Yue Xuelian was surprised to hear that from Dugu Yuanshen, and Zhang Fei immediately spoke to the old man.
"I entrust them to you, Senior."
"Leave everything to me, and you just need to focus on your eighth challenge."
"Yes," Zhang Fei immediately moved to the eighth area and started the challenge in that area.
"Why do you want to protect us, Sect Master Dugu?" Yue Xuelian asked him.
Dugu Yuanshen looked at her.
"That young man is quite interesting, and he might succeed in opening the gate on the third floor.
That’s why I decided to protect the five of you, so he can fully focus on the final three challenges."
"Do you know the mystery behind the tower, Senior?"
Dugu Yuanshen shook his head at Luo Yunxiao.
"I’ve never been to the third floor before, but I’ve heard about the gate.
No one, including Emperor Long, has been able to open it.
Somehow I have a feeling that your husband can do it, and I want to watch him do it."
